1: # Kế hoạch triển khai mở rộng admin qua OpenCode — 01/11/2026
2: 
3: ## Yêu cầu thực hiện
4: 
5: Người dùng yêu cầu lập kế hoạch, giao OpenCode CLI dùng **`google/antigravity-gemini-3.8-flash`**, **`--variant high`**, thực hiện và tiếp tục nhận sửa lỗi đến khi hoàn tất. Codex điều phối, review và kiểm thử độc lập. Không thay model nếu chưa được người dùng yêu cầu.
6: 
7: Phạm vi là 12 nhóm chức năng trong kết luận nghiên cứu: thành viên nâng cao; tra cứu nhiệm vụ/credit; carryover; chiến dịch tập trung; hàng đợi báo cáo test; hỗ trợ; cấu hình thưởng/phạt; cấu hình phí; phân quyền/cảnh báo; audit; thông báo nâng cao; giám sát hệ thống. Làm đầy đủ frontend/backend cho chức năng đã nhận, không tạo nút giả hoặc form lưu nhưng nghiệp vụ không sử dụng.
8: 
9: Giữ nguyên thứ tự năm thẻ hiện có; mở rộng hai thẻ thành viên/nhiệm vụ và đặt công cụ mới sau nhóm năm thẻ. Giữ các sửa đổi trước trong workspace. Bản sửa nút credit bằng FlowRow hiện tại phải được giữ và kiểm tra hồi quy.
10: 
11: Không thuộc phạm vi: kích hoạt nạp tiền đang tắt, tích hợp nhà thanh toán mới, Auth Admin xóa tài khoản, thay hạ tầng cloud hoặc tự deploy Supabase production. Đây là tính năng có điều kiện trong bản nghiên cứu, không nằm trong 12 nhóm được chọn ở kết luận. Tạo migrations và hướng dẫn triển khai để có bản thay đổi review được; không dùng secret production để thử nghiệp vụ.
12: 
13: ## Quy tắc nền tảng
14: 
15: - Checkpoint toàn bộ source/config không chứa secrets trước chỉnh sửa; so sánh với checkpoint, không dùng git HEAD để kết luận về các sửa đổi vốn đã có.
16: - Active migrations hiện là 062–069. Chỉ thêm migration kế tiếp, không sửa baseline/archive/migration cũ.
17: - RPC mới kiểm tra UID, role và admin chưa bị khóa ở backend; thu hẹp EXECUTE và RLS. Không mở các hàm service-role trực tiếp cho tất cả authenticated.
18: - Mutations quan trọng có audit actor/reason/target/before/after/request ID. Credit và phát thông báo phải chống xử lý lại request. Audit chỉ backend ghi.
19: - Cursor pagination, tìm kiếm server-side; xóa giới hạn giả 500 thành viên. Không tải mọi trang/lịch sử vào một response.
20: - Policy có revision, ngày hiệu lực giờ Việt Nam, giới hạn giá trị và snapshot để giao dịch/lịch sử cũ không đổi theo cấu hình mới. Default behavior giữ nguyên đến khi admin đặt policy mới.
21: - Giữ các guard race/session generation/cache publication đang có; nội dung UI VI/EN và hỗ trợ chữ lớn/màn hình nhỏ.
22: - Không commit/push/deploy, không đọc/xuất secrets, không reset hoặc xóa file ngoài phạm vi. Không thay test để che lỗi.
23: 
24: ## Các chặng và đầu ra nghiệm thu
25: 
26: ### A. Backend quản trị và hợp đồng API
27: 
28: 1. Đặt hợp đồng DTO/RPC rõ trong `audit/admin-expansion-2026-11-01/api-contract.md`.
29: 2. Admin audit dùng chung; member search có cursor và detail/credit/daily-task history; carryover get/schedule/cancel/history với revision.
30: 3. Campaign/report queue/search có cursor; dùng lại RPC lifecycle/approve/reject hiện có. Contact support dùng lại module hiện tại.
31: 4. Role management: admin quản lý member/moderator; bổ nhiệm/hạ admin chỉ qua quyền bổ nhiệm riêng được bootstrap bởi database owner, bảo vệ admin cuối cùng và không tự nâng quyền. Nếu chưa bootstrap, backend trả lỗi rõ và UI giải thích đúng. Warning revoke lưu sự kiện và cập nhật toàn bộ phép đếm liên quan; không xóa lịch sử gốc.
32: 5. Compensation/request ID chống trùng, liên kết giao dịch/khiếu nại khi có; audit các mutation mới và thao tác admin hiện có.
33: 6. Summary/job monitor: dữ liệu thực từ database, không giả số lượng công việc nằm trên điện thoại. Retry settlement chỉ ID/batch cho phép, kiểm tra quyền, audit, không arbitrary SQL/cloud secrets.
34: 7. Notification campaigns: draft, VI/EN, audience all/role/selected users, schedule/cancel future, preview counts, cursor history, request id chống gửi lặp. Server worker an toàn khi chạy đồng thời; không gọi broadcast hiện có nhiều lần. Tách sent/read/popup-confirmed đúng nghĩa. Có cơ chế scheduler migration hoặc hướng dẫn vận hành worker cụ thể.
35: 
36: Nghiệm thu A: runner PGlite nạp active migrations mới, test admin/member/moderator/locked/anon; pagination >500 profiles, không lặp/bỏ trang với cursor; cross-user access; request replay và request ID payload mismatch; policy revision/history/date; warning/role rules và finance/audit invariants.
37: 
38: ### B. Android cho nghiệp vụ quản trị
39: 
40: 1. Repository/DTO cho hợp đồng A, thêm ViewModel chuyên biệt thay vì dồn toàn bộ vào một file.
41: 2. Tìm kiếm thành viên từ server có pagination; member detail gồm nhiệm vụ/credit/warnings/campaigns/slots, xử lý compensation và role phù hợp quyền.
42: 3. Carryover trong thẻ Nhiệm vụ ngày; campaign search, pending report queue, audit, notification composer/history và monitor; điều hướng thẻ hỗ trợ vào màn hình đã có.
43: 4. Xử lý empty/loading/error/retry, giữ selection theo ID, chống double-submit, stale search và phản hồi sau đổi phiên. Không tự retry mutation không có request ID.
44: 5. Không để screen lớn, chữ lớn hoặc nested scrolling che thao tác.
45: 
46: Nghiệm thu B: compile/assembleDebug, các test admin/popup/session/cache hiện có và tests hành vi mới cho phân trang/race/request ID; probe layout phù hợp. UI và resource không chứa text mới hardcode.
47: 
48: ### C. Policy thưởng/phạt và phí dùng thật
49:

## Quy tắc nền tảng

- Checkpoint toàn bộ source/config không chứa secrets trước chỉnh sửa; so sánh với checkpoint, không dùng git HEAD để kết luận về các sửa đổi vốn đã có.
- Active migrations hiện là 062–069. Chỉ thêm migration kế tiếp, không sửa baseline/archive/migration cũ.

1: -- Migration 067: Admin Direct Notification In-App Popup
2: -- Atomic transaction for deploying popup states, receipts, security constraints, and RPCs.
3: 
4: BEGIN;
5: 
6: -- ============================================================================
7: -- 1. NOTIFICATION POPUP STATES (Server-managed display counters)
8: -- ============================================================================
9: 
10: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.notification_popup_states (
11:     notification_id uuid PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES public.notifications(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
12:     display_count smallint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (display_count >= 0 AND display_count <= 5),
13:     last_display_at timestamptz,
14:     created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
15: );
16: 
17: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_popup_states_display_count
18:     ON public.notification_popup_states (display_count);
19: 
20: ALTER TABLE public.notification_popup_states ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
21: ALTER TABLE public.notification_popup_states NO FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
22: REVOKE ALL ON TABLE public.notification_popup_states FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
23: GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON TABLE public.notification_popup_states TO service_role;
24: 
25: -- ============================================================================
26: -- 2. NOTIFICATION POPUP RECEIPTS (Session idempotency & replay ledger)
27: -- ============================================================================
28: 
29: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.notification_popup_receipts (
30:     id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
31:     user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.profiles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
32:     foreground_session_id uuid NOT NULL,
33:     notification_id uuid REFERENCES public.notifications(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
34:     display_number smallint NOT NULL CHECK (display_number >= 1 AND display_number <= 5),
35:     claimed_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
36:     CONSTRAINT uq_notification_popup_receipts UNIQUE (user_id, foreground_session_id)
37: );
38: 
39: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_popup_receipts_user_session
40:     ON public.notification_popup_receipts (user_id, foreground_session_id);
41: 
42: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_popup_receipts_notif
43:     ON public.notification_popup_receipts (notification_id);
44: 
45: ALTER TABLE public.notification_popup_receipts ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
46: ALTER TABLE public.notification_popup_receipts NO FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
47: REVOKE ALL ON TABLE public.notification_popup_receipts FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
48: GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON TABLE public.notification_popup_receipts TO service_role;
49: 
50: -- ============================================================================
51: -- 3. INDEX FOR POPUP CANDIDATE LOOKUP ON NOTIFICATIONS
52: -- ============================================================================
53: 
54: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_notifications_popup_lookup
55:     ON public.notifications (user_id, is_read, created_at ASC, id ASC);
56: 
57: -- ============================================================================
58: -- 4. TRIGGER: PREVENT CLIENT FORGERY / TAMPERING OF POPUP NOTIFICATIONS
59: -- ============================================================================
60: 
61: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.protect_popup_notification_update()
62: RETURNS trigger
63: LANGUAGE plpgsql
64: SECURITY DEFINER
65: SET search_path TO 'public'
66: AS $$
67: BEGIN
68:     -- Only protect rows registered in notification_popup_states
69:     IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.notification_popup_states WHERE notification_id = OLD.id) THEN
70:         -- Prevent changing immutable fields (id, user_id, title, message, type, data, created_at)
71:         IF NEW.id <> OLD.id OR NEW.user_id <> OLD.user_id OR NEW.title <> OLD.title OR NEW.message <> OLD.message OR NEW.type <> OLD.type OR NEW.data IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.data OR NEW.created_at <> OLD.created_at THEN
72:             RAISE EXCEPTION 'CANNOT_MODIFY_PROTECTED_NOTIFICATION';
73:         END IF;
74: 
75:         -- Prevent unmarking read (switching is_read from true back to false)
76:         IF OLD.is_read = true AND NEW.is_read = false THEN
77:             RAISE EXCEPTION 'CANNOT_UNREAD_POPUP_NOTIFICATION';
78:         END IF;
79:     END IF;
80:     RETURN NEW;
81: END;

Document version: `1.0.0`
Date: `2026-11-01`
Target: Supabase PostgreSQL RPCs & Android Admin Notification Management (`072_admin_notification_campaigns.sql`)

---

## 1. Architectural Principles & Security Rules

1. **Authentication & Authorization**:
   - All admin-facing RPCs strictly enforce unlocked administrator credentials using `public._assert_daily_task_admin()`.
   - Denied callers (`anon`, standard `member`, `moderator`, locked `admin`, or missing credentials) immediately raise `FORBIDDEN: Admin access required` or `UNAUTHORIZED: Authentication required`.
   - Client roles (`PUBLIC`, `anon`, `authenticated`) have **NO DIRECT PERMISSIONS** on internal campaign tables (`notification_campaigns`, `notification_campaign_recipients`, `notification_campaign_requests`, `notification_campaign_events`). All direct modifications are blocked via RLS and revoked privileges.
   - Core background worker functions (`service_process_notification_campaigns`, `service_process_notification_campaign_batch`) are restricted to `service_role` execution only. A bounded, authenticated wrapper (`admin_process_due_notification_campaigns`) is provided for manual admin operation and testing.

2. **Idempotency & Replay Protection**:
   - All state-mutating RPCs require a client-generated UUID `p_request_id`.
   - Replaying the same `p_request_id` with an identical payload returns the previous response with `"replayed": true` and **does NOT emit duplicate audit events**.
   - Replaying the same `p_request_id` with a mismatched payload or action fails with `REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT` (or `PAYLOAD_MISMATCH`).

3. **Concurrency & Safe Optimistic Locking (CAS)**:
   - Campaign scheduling, updating, sending, and cancelling require `p_expected_revision integer`.
   - If the database revision has advanced, the call fails immediately with `REVISION_CONFLICT`.

4. **Recipient Snapshot & Delivery Semantics**:
   - Recipient snapshots are taken deterministically at campaign scheduling / send-now into `public.notification_campaign_recipients`.
   - Recipient fanout uses `FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED` on recipient rows to guarantee that concurrent workers and worker restarts never duplicate notifications.
   - Batch inserts create rows in `public.notifications` with:
     ```json
     {
       "campaign_id": "uuid",
       "broadcast": true,
       "sender": "admin"
     }
     ```
   - **No popup states** (`notification_popup_states`) are registered for campaign mass broadcasts, preserving compatibility with 067/069 direct single-user notifications.
   - `sent_count` is tracked per recipient receipt. When a user deletes their notification (`public.notifications` row deleted, setting `receipt.notification_id` to NULL), `sent_count` remains stable.
   - `read_count` is computed dynamically by joining `notification_campaign_recipients.notification_id` with `public.notifications.is_read = true`.

5. **Locale Fallback & Content Structure**:
   - Campaigns define `title_vi`, `title_en`, `body_vi`, `body_en`, and `default_locale` (`'vi'`, `'en'`, or `'bilingual'`).
   - Profile table has no `locale` column; delivered text is resolved from `default_locale`:
     - `'vi'`: delivers Vietnamese text (falls back to English if empty).
     - `'en'`: delivers English text (falls back to Vietnamese if empty).
     - `'bilingual'`: delivers formatted composite text (`title_vi / title_en` and `body_vi \n\n---\n\n body_en`).
     - Localized variants are also attached inside `notifications.data`.

---

## 2. DTO Specifications & Endpoints

### 2.1 `admin_create_notification_campaign`

Creates a new notification campaign in `draft` status.

#### Signature
```sql
public.admin_create_notification_campaign(
    p_request_id uuid,
    p_title_vi text,
    p_title_en text,
    p_body_vi text,
    p_body_en text,
    p_default_locale text DEFAULT 'vi',
    p_audience_type text DEFAULT 'all',
    p_target_role text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_selected_user_ids uuid[] DEFAULT NULL,
    p_reason text DEFAULT NULL
) RETURNS jsonb
```

#### Parameters
| Parameter | Type | Required | Constraints |
|---|---|---|---|
| `p_request_id` | `uuid` | Yes | Non-null UUID idempotency key |
| `p_title_vi` | `text` | Yes | 1..200 characters |
| `p_title_en` | `text` | Yes | 1..200 characters |
| `p_body_vi` | `text` | Yes | 1..2000 characters |
| `p_body_en` | `text` | Yes | 1..2000 characters |
| `p_default_locale` | `text` | No | `'vi'`, `'en'`, or `'bilingual'`. Default `'vi'` |
| `p_audience_type` | `text` | No | `'all'`, `'role'`, or `'selected_users'`. Default `'all'` |
| `p_target_role` | `text` | Cond. | `'member'`, `'moderator'`, or `'admin'`. Required if `audience_type = 'role'`, must be null otherwise |
| `p_selected_user_ids` | `uuid[]` | Cond. | 1..1000 UUIDs. Required if `audience_type = 'selected_users'`, must be null/empty otherwise. All IDs must exist in `profiles` |
| `p_reason` | `text` | No | Audit note |

  "success": true,

### 2.2 `admin_update_notification_campaign`

Updates content and audience criteria of a campaign in `draft` or pending `queued` status. Requires optimistic locking revision check.

#### Signature
```sql
public.admin_update_notification_campaign(
    p_request_id uuid,
    p_campaign_id uuid,
    p_expected_revision integer,
    p_title_vi text,
    p_title_en text,
    p_body_vi text,
    p_body_en text,
    p_default_locale text DEFAULT 'vi',
    p_audience_type text DEFAULT 'all',
    p_target_role text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_selected_user_ids uuid[] DEFAULT NULL,
    p_reason text DEFAULT NULL
) RETURNS jsonb
```

#### Parameters
| Parameter | Type | Required | Constraints |
|---|---|---|---|
| `p_request_id` | `uuid` | Yes | Idempotency key |
| `p_campaign_id` | `uuid` | Yes | Existing campaign ID |
| `p_expected_revision` | `integer` | Yes | Expected current `revision` |
| ... | ... | ... | Content & audience parameters matching `create` |

#### Error Cases
- `CAMPAIGN_NOT_FOUND`: Target ID does not exist.
- `REVISION_CONFLICT`: Expected revision does not match database revision.
- `CAMPAIGN_NOT_MODIFIABLE`: Status is `'sending'`, `'completed'`, `'cancelled'`, or `'failed'`.
- `CAMPAIGN_ALREADY_DUE`: Status is `'queued'` and `scheduled_for <= clock_timestamp()`.

### 2.4 `admin_schedule_notification_campaign`

Transitions a draft or queued campaign into `queued` with a future `scheduled_for` timestamp. Freezes deterministic recipient snapshot in `notification_campaign_recipients`.

#### Signature
```sql
public.admin_schedule_notification_campaign(
    p_request_id uuid,
    p_campaign_id uuid,
    p_expected_revision integer,
    p_scheduled_for timestamptz,
    p_reason text DEFAULT NULL
) RETURNS jsonb
```

#### Constraints
- `p_scheduled_for` must be strictly in the future (`> clock_timestamp()`). Otherwise raises `SCHEDULE_TIME_MUST_BE_IN_FUTURE`.
- Status must be `'draft'` or `'queued'`.
- If previously `'queued'` but already due (`scheduled_for <= clock_timestamp()`), raises `CAMPAIGN_ALREADY_DUE`.

### 2.6 `admin_cancel_notification_campaign`

Cancels a campaign. Only future scheduled campaigns or drafts can be cancelled; past or in-flight campaigns reject cancellation.

#### Signature
```sql
public.admin_cancel_notification_campaign(
    p_request_id uuid,
    p_campaign_id uuid,
    p_expected_revision integer,
    p_reason text
) RETURNS jsonb
```

#### Validation & Constraints
- `p_reason` is required (non-empty).
- Allowed only when status is `'draft'` OR status is `'queued'` and `scheduled_for > clock_timestamp()`.
- If status is `'sending'`, `'completed'`, `'cancelled'`, or `scheduled_for <= clock_timestamp()`, raises `CANNOT_CANCEL_IN_FLIGHT_OR_PAST_CAMPAIGN`.

-- Migration 072: Admin Notification Campaigns Backend & Batch Fanout Worker
--
-- Features:
-- 1. Campaign schema: title_vi/en, body_vi/en, default_locale, audience (all/role/selected_users)
-- 2. Recipient snapshot taken deterministically at schedule / send-now
-- 3. Optimistic concurrency control (CAS) via campaign revision
-- 4. Idempotency ledger for mutations (same request_id replays outcome; mismatch fails)
-- 5. Atomic batch fanout worker using SKIP LOCKED; per-campaign/user unique receipts
-- 6. No popup states for mass broadcasts (preserves 067/069 direct popup flow)
-- 7. Stable sent counts even if user deletes notifications; live read count based on notifications.is_read
-- 8. Service-only batch worker + admin-guarded bounded manual trigger
-- 9. Keyset cursor pagination for campaigns and recipient delivery results
-- 10. Conditional pg_cron registration with safe fallback
-- ============================================================================

BEGIN;

-- ============================================================================
-- 1. NOTIFICATION CAMPAIGNS CORE TABLES
-- ============================================================================

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.notification_campaigns (
    id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    title_vi text NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(title_vi)) >= 1 AND length(title_vi) <= 200),
    title_en text NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(title_en)) >= 1 AND length(title_en) <= 200),
    body_vi text NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(body_vi)) >= 1 AND length(body_vi) <= 2000),
    body_en text NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(body_en)) >= 1 AND length(body_en) <= 2000),
    default_locale text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'vi' CHECK (default_locale IN ('vi', 'en', 'bilingual')),
    audience_type text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'all' CHECK (audience_type IN ('all', 'role', 'selected_users')),
    target_role text CHECK (target_role IS NULL OR target_role IN ('member', 'moderator', 'admin')),
    selected_user_ids uuid[] DEFAULT '{}'::uuid[],
    status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'queued', 'sending', 'completed', 'cancelled', 'failed')),
    revision integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (revision >= 1),
    total_recipients integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (total_recipients >= 0),
    sent_count integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (sent_count >= 0),
    failed_count integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (failed_count >= 0),
    scheduled_for timestamptz,
    started_at timestamptz,
    completed_at timestamptz,
    cancelled_at timestamptz,
    cancelled_by uuid REFERENCES public.profiles(id),
    cancel_reason text,
    created_by uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.profiles(id),
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(),
    updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(),
    CONSTRAINT chk_audience_role CHECK (
        (audience_type = 'role' AND target_role IS NOT NULL) OR
        (audience_type <> 'role' AND target_role IS NULL)
    ),
    CONSTRAINT chk_audience_selected CHECK (
        (audience_type = 'selected_users' AND cardinality(selected_user_ids) > 0 AND cardinality(selected_user_ids) <= 1000) OR
        (audience_type <> 'selected_users' AND (selected_user_ids IS NULL OR cardinality(selected_user_ids) = 0))
    )
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_notif_campaigns_status_sched
    ON public.notification_campaigns (status, scheduled_for ASC);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_notif_campaigns_created_cursor
    ON public.notification_campaigns (created_at DESC, id DESC);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_notif_campaigns_created_by
    ON public.notification_campaigns (created_by);

ALTER TABLE public.notification_campaigns ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public.notification_campaigns NO FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
REVOKE ALL ON TABLE public.notification_campaigns FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON TABLE public.notification_campaigns TO service_role;


-- ============================================================================
-- 2. NOTIFICATION CAMPAIGN RECIPIENTS (Deterministic snapshot & delivery receipts)
-- ============================================================================

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.notification_campaign_recipients (
    id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    campaign_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.notification_campaigns(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.profiles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'sent', 'failed')),
    notification_id uuid REFERENCES public.notifications(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
    sent_at timestamptz,
    error_message text,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(),
    CONSTRAINT uq_notification_campaign_recipients UNIQUE (campaign_id, user_id)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_notif_recipients_camp_status
    ON public.notification_campaign_recipients (campaign_id, status);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_notif_recipients_user
    ON public.notification_campaign_recipients (user_id);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_notif_recipients_notif_id
    ON public.notification_campaign_recipients (notification_id);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_notif_recipients_cursor
    ON public.notification_campaign_recipients (campaign_id, created_at ASC, id ASC);

ALTER TABLE public.notification_campaign_recipients ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public.notification_campaign_recipients NO FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
REVOKE ALL ON TABLE public.notification_campaign_recipients FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON TABLE public.notification_campaign_recipients TO service_role;


-- ============================================================================
-- 3. NOTIFICATION CAMPAIGN REQUESTS (Mutation Idempotency & Replay Ledger)
-- ============================================================================

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.notification_campaign_requests (
    request_id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
    admin_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.profiles(id),
    action text NOT NULL,
    campaign_id uuid REFERENCES public.notification_campaigns(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    payload_hash text NOT NULL,
    response_json jsonb NOT NULL,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_notif_requests_actor
    ON public.notification_campaign_requests (admin_id, action);

ALTER TABLE public.notification_campaign_requests ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public.notification_campaign_requests NO FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
REVOKE ALL ON TABLE public.notification_campaign_requests FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON TABLE public.notification_campaign_requests TO service_role;


-- ============================================================================
-- 4. NOTIFICATION CAMPAIGN EVENTS (Append-only Audit Log)
-- ============================================================================

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.notification_campaign_events (
    id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    campaign_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.notification_campaigns(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    admin_id uuid REFERENCES public.profiles(id),
    action text NOT NULL,

-- Compute delivered title and message according to default_locale
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._notif_resolve_delivered_content(
    p_title_vi text,
    p_title_en text,
    p_body_vi text,
    p_body_en text,
    p_locale text,
    OUT delivered_title text,
    OUT delivered_message text
)
LANGUAGE plpgsql
IMMUTABLE
AS $$
BEGIN
    IF p_locale = 'en' THEN
        delivered_title := COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p_title_en), ''), p_title_vi);
        delivered_message := COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p_body_en), ''), p_body_vi);
    ELSIF p_locale = 'bilingual' THEN
        delivered_title := TRIM(p_title_vi) || ' / ' || TRIM(p_title_en);
        delivered_message := TRIM(p_body_vi) || E'\n\n---\n\n' || TRIM(p_body_en);
    ELSE -- 'vi' or fallback
        delivered_title := COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p_title_vi), ''), p_title_en);
        delivered_message := COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p_body_vi), ''), p_body_en);
    END IF;
END;
$$;

-- Format campaign row into consistent JSON DTO
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._notif_campaign_to_jsonb(
    p_camp public.notification_campaigns
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
STABLE
AS $$
DECLARE
    v_live_read_count bigint;
BEGIN
    SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_live_read_count
    FROM public.notification_campaign_recipients r
    JOIN public.notifications n ON n.id = r.notification_id
    WHERE r.campaign_id = p_camp.id AND n.is_read = true;

    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
        'id', p_camp.id,
        'title_vi', p_camp.title_vi,
        'title_en', p_camp.title_en,
        'body_vi', p_camp.body_vi,
        'body_en', p_camp.body_en,
        'default_locale', p_camp.default_locale,
        'audience_type', p_camp.audience_type,
        'target_role', p_camp.target_role,
        'selected_user_ids', to_jsonb(COALESCE(p_camp.selected_user_ids, '{}'::uuid[])),
        'status', p_camp.status,
        'revision', p_camp.revision,
        'total_recipients', p_camp.total_recipients,
        'sent_count', p_camp.sent_count,
        'read_count', COALESCE(v_live_read_count, 0),
        'failed_count', p_camp.failed_count,
        'scheduled_for', CASE WHEN p_camp.scheduled_for IS NOT NULL THEN to_char(p_camp.scheduled_for AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') ELSE NULL END,
        'started_at', CASE WHEN p_camp.started_at IS NOT NULL THEN to_char(p_camp.started_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') ELSE NULL END,
        'completed_at', CASE WHEN p_camp.completed_at IS NOT NULL THEN to_char(p_camp.completed_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') ELSE NULL END,
        'cancelled_at', CASE WHEN p_camp.cancelled_at IS NOT NULL THEN to_char(p_camp.cancelled_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') ELSE NULL END,
        'cancelled_by', p_camp.cancelled_by,
        'cancel_reason', p_camp.cancel_reason,
        'created_by', p_camp.created_by,
        'created_at', to_char(p_camp.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"'),
        'updated_at', to_char(p_camp.updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"')
    );
END;
$$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public._notif_campaign_to_jsonb(public.notification_campaigns) FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public._notif_campaign_to_jsonb(public.notification_campaigns) TO service_role;

-- Take deterministic recipient snapshot
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._notif_snapshot_recipients(
    p_campaign_id uuid
)
RETURNS integer
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $$
DECLARE
    v_camp public.notification_campaigns;
    v_count integer := 0;
BEGIN
    SELECT * INTO v_camp
    FROM public.notification_campaigns
    WHERE id = p_campaign_id
    FOR UPDATE;

    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'CAMPAIGN_NOT_FOUND';
    END IF;

    -- Delete any un-sent recipients if re-snapshotting pending draft/queued
    DELETE FROM public.notification_campaign_recipients
    WHERE campaign_id = p_campaign_id AND status = 'pending';

    IF v_camp.audience_type = 'all' THEN
        INSERT INTO public.notification_campaign_recipients (campaign_id, user_id, status)
        SELECT v_camp.id, p.id, 'pending'
        FROM public.profiles p
        ORDER BY p.id ASC
        ON CONFLICT (campaign_id, user_id) DO NOTHING;

    ELSIF v_camp.audience_type = 'role' THEN
        INSERT INTO public.notification_campaign_recipients (campaign_id, user_id, status)
        SELECT v_camp.id, p.id, 'pending'
        FROM public.profiles p
        WHERE p.role = v_camp.target_role
        ORDER BY p.id ASC
        ON CONFLICT (campaign_id, user_id) DO NOTHING;

    ELSIF v_camp.audience_type = 'selected_users' THEN
        INSERT INTO public.notification_campaign_recipients (campaign_id, user_id, status)
        SELECT v_camp.id, u.user_id, 'pending'
        FROM (SELECT DISTINCT unnest(v_camp.selected_user_ids) AS user_id) u
        JOIN public.profiles p ON p.id = u.user_id
        ORDER BY u.user_id ASC
        ON CONFLICT (campaign_id, user_id) DO NOTHING;
    END IF;

    SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_count
    FROM public.notification_campaign_recipients
    WHERE campaign_id = p_campaign_id;

    UPDATE public.notification_campaigns
    SET total_recipients = v_count,
        updated_at = clock_timestamp()
    WHERE id = p_campaign_id;

    RETURN v_count;
END;
$$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public._notif_snapshot_recipients(uuid) FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public._notif_snapshot_recipients(uuid) TO service_role;


-- ============================================================================
-- 7. ADMIN RPC: ADMIN_CREATE_NOTIFICATION_CAMPAIGN
-- ============================================================================

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_create_notification_campaign(
    p_request_id uuid,
    p_title_vi text,
    p_title_en text,
    p_body_vi text,
    p_body_en text,
    p_default_locale text DEFAULT 'vi',
    p_audience_type text DEFAULT 'all',
    p_target_role text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_selected_user_ids uuid[] DEFAULT NULL,
    p_reason text DEFAULT NULL
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $$
DECLARE
    v_admin_id uuid;
    v_payload_hash text;
    v_existing_req public.notification_campaign_requests;
    v_new_campaign public.notification_campaigns;
    v_clean_selected uuid[] := '{}';
    v_missing_count integer;
    v_response jsonb;
BEGIN
    v_admin_id := public._assert_daily_task_admin();

    IF p_request_id IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_REQUEST_ID';
    END IF;

    -- Clean selected user IDs
    IF p_selected_user_ids IS NOT NULL AND cardinality(p_selected_user_ids) > 0 THEN
        SELECT array_agg(DISTINCT u) INTO v_clean_selected
        FROM unnest(p_selected_user_ids) AS u
        WHERE u IS NOT NULL;
    END IF;

    v_payload_hash := md5(concat_ws('|',
        'create',
        COALESCE(p_title_vi, ''),
        COALESCE(p_title_en, ''),
        COALESCE(p_body_vi, ''),
        COALESCE(p_body_en, ''),
        COALESCE(p_default_locale, 'vi'),
        COALESCE(p_audience_type, 'all'),
        COALESCE(p_target_role, ''),
        COALESCE(v_clean_selected::text, '{}'),
        COALESCE(p_reason, '')
    ));

    -- Check idempotency
    SELECT * INTO v_existing_req
    FROM public.notification_campaign_requests
    WHERE request_id = p_request_id;

    IF v_existing_req.request_id IS NOT NULL THEN
        IF v_existing_req.payload_hash <> v_payload_hash OR v_existing_req.action <> 'create' THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT: Request ID already used with different payload';
        END IF;
        RETURN v_existing_req.response_json || jsonb_build_object('replayed', true);
    END IF;

    -- Validate string bounds
    IF p_title_vi IS NULL OR TRIM(p_title_vi) = '' OR length(p_title_vi) > 200 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_TITLE_VI: Title must be between 1 and 200 characters';
    END IF;
    IF p_title_en IS NULL OR TRIM(p_title_en) = '' OR length(p_title_en) > 200 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_TITLE_EN: Title must be between 1 and 200 characters';
    END IF;
    IF p_body_vi IS NULL OR TRIM(p_body_vi) = '' OR length(p_body_vi) > 2000 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_BODY_VI: Body must be between 1 and 2000 characters';
    END IF;
    IF p_body_en IS NULL OR TRIM(p_body_en) = '' OR length(p_body_en) > 2000 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_BODY_EN: Body must be between 1 and 2000 characters';
    END IF;

    IF p_default_locale NOT IN ('vi', 'en', 'bilingual') THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_LOCALE: default_locale must be vi, en, or bilingual';
    END IF;

    IF p_audience_type NOT IN ('all', 'role', 'selected_users') THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_AUDIENCE_TYPE';
    END IF;

    IF p_audience_type = 'role' THEN
        IF p_target_role IS NULL OR p_target_role NOT IN ('member', 'moderator', 'admin') THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_TARGET_ROLE: Must specify valid role for role audience';
        END IF;
        v_clean_selected := '{}';
    ELSIF p_audience_type = 'selected_users' THEN
        p_target_role := NULL;
        IF v_clean_selected IS NULL OR cardinality(v_clean_selected) = 0 THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'EMPTY_SELECTED_USERS: At least one user ID required';
        END IF;
        IF cardinality(v_clean_selected) > 1000 THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'TOO_MANY_SELECTED_USERS: Maximum 1000 users allowed';
        END IF;

        -- Verify all selected users exist
        SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_missing_count
        FROM unnest(v_clean_selected) AS u
        WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles WHERE id = u);

        IF v_missing_count > 0 THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_RECIPIENT_USER: One or more selected user IDs do not exist';
        END IF;
    ELSE
        p_target_role := NULL;
        v_clean_selected := '{}';
    END IF;

    INSERT INTO public.notification_campaigns (
        title_vi,
        title_en,
        body_vi,
        body_en,
        default_locale,
        audience_type,
        target_role,
        selected_user_ids,
        status,
        revision,
        created_by
    ) VALUES (
        TRIM(p_title_vi),
        TRIM(p_title_en),
        TRIM(p_body_vi),
        TRIM(p_body_en),
        p_default_locale,
        p_audience_type,
        p_target_role,
        v_clean_selected,
        'draft',
        1,
        v_admin_id
    ) RETURNING * INTO v_new_campaign;

    -- Append audit event
    INSERT INTO public.notification_campaign_events (
        campaign_id,
        admin_id,
        action,
        reason,
        details
    ) VALUES (
        v_new_campaign.id,
        v_admin_id,
        'created',
        p_reason,
        jsonb_build_object(
            'audience_type', p_audience_type,
            'default_locale', p_default_locale
        )
    );

    v_response := jsonb_build_object(
        'success', true,
        'replayed', false,
        'campaign', public._notif_campaign_to_jsonb(v_new_campaign)
    );

    INSERT INTO public.notification_campaign_requests (
        request_id,
        admin_id,
        action,
        campaign_id,
        payload_hash,
        response_json
    ) VALUES (
        p_request_id,
        v_admin_id,
        'create',
        v_new_campaign.id,
        v_payload_hash,
        v_response
    );

    RETURN v_response;
END;
$$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.admin_create_notification_campaign(uuid, text, text, text, text, text, text, text, uuid[], text) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.admin_create_notification_campaign(uuid, text, text, text, text, text, text, text, uuid[], text) TO authenticated, service_role;


-- ============================================================================
-- 8. ADMIN RPC: ADMIN_UPDATE_NOTIFICATION_CAMPAIGN
-- ============================================================================

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_update_notification_campaign(
    p_request_id uuid,
    p_campaign_id uuid,
    p_expected_revision integer,
    p_title_vi text,
    p_title_en text,
    p_body_vi text,
    p_body_en text,
    p_default_locale text DEFAULT 'vi',
    p_audience_type text DEFAULT 'all',
    p_target_role text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_selected_user_ids uuid[] DEFAULT NULL,
    p_reason text DEFAULT NULL
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $$
DECLARE
    v_admin_id uuid;
    v_payload_hash text;
    v_existing_req public.notification_campaign_requests;
    v_camp public.notification_campaigns;
    v_clean_selected uuid[] := '{}';
    v_missing_count integer;
    v_response jsonb;
BEGIN
    v_admin_id := public._assert_daily_task_admin();

    IF p_request_id IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_REQUEST_ID';
    END IF;
    IF p_campaign_id IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_CAMPAIGN_ID';
    END IF;
    IF p_expected_revision IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'REVISION_REQUIRED';
    END IF;

    IF p_selected_user_ids IS NOT NULL AND cardinality(p_selected_user_ids) > 0 THEN
        SELECT array_agg(DISTINCT u) INTO v_clean_selected
        FROM unnest(p_selected_user_ids) AS u
        WHERE u IS NOT NULL;
    END IF;

    v_payload_hash := md5(concat_ws('|',
        'update',
        p_campaign_id::text,
        p_expected_revision::text,
        COALESCE(p_title_vi, ''),
        COALESCE(p_title_en, ''),
        COALESCE(p_body_vi, ''),
        COALESCE(p_body_en, ''),
        COALESCE(p_default_locale, 'vi'),
        COALESCE(p_audience_type, 'all'),
        COALESCE(p_target_role, ''),
        COALESCE(v_clean_selected::text, '{}'),
        COALESCE(p_reason, '')
    ));

    SELECT * INTO v_existing_req
    FROM public.notification_campaign_requests
    WHERE request_id = p_request_id;

    IF v_existing_req.request_id IS NOT NULL THEN
        IF v_existing_req.payload_hash <> v_payload_hash OR v_existing_req.action <> 'update' THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT: Request ID already used with different payload';
        END IF;
        RETURN v_existing_req.response_json || jsonb_build_object('replayed', true);
    END IF;

    SELECT * INTO v_camp
    FROM public.notification_campaigns
    WHERE id = p_campaign_id
    FOR UPDATE;

    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'CAMPAIGN_NOT_FOUND';
    END IF;

    IF v_camp.status NOT IN ('draft', 'queued') THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'CAMPAIGN_NOT_MODIFIABLE: Only draft or queued campaigns can be modified';
    END IF;

    IF v_camp.status = 'queued' AND v_camp.scheduled_for <= clock_timestamp() THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'CAMPAIGN_ALREADY_DUE: Campaign is already due for processing';
    END IF;

    IF v_camp.revision <> p_expected_revision THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'REVISION_CONFLICT: Expected revision % but found %', p_expected_revision, v_camp.revision;
    END IF;

    -- Validation
    IF p_title_vi IS NULL OR TRIM(p_title_vi) = '' OR length(p_title_vi) > 200 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_TITLE_VI';
    END IF;
    IF p_title_en IS NULL OR TRIM(p_title_en) = '' OR length(p_title_en) > 200 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_TITLE_EN';
    END IF;
    IF p_body_vi IS NULL OR TRIM(p_body_vi) = '' OR length(p_body_vi) > 2000 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_BODY_VI';
    END IF;
    IF p_body_en IS NULL OR TRIM(p_body_en) = '' OR length(p_body_en) > 2000 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_BODY_EN';
    END IF;

    IF p_default_locale NOT IN ('vi', 'en', 'bilingual') THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_LOCALE';
    END IF;

    IF p_audience_type NOT IN ('all', 'role', 'selected_users') THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_AUDIENCE_TYPE';
    END IF;

    IF p_audience_type = 'role' THEN
        IF p_target_role IS NULL OR p_target_role NOT IN ('member', 'moderator', 'admin') THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_TARGET_ROLE';
        END IF;
        v_clean_selected := '{}';
    ELSIF p_audience_type = 'selected_users' THEN
        p_target_role := NULL;
        IF v_clean_selected IS NULL OR cardinality(v_clean_selected) = 0 THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'EMPTY_SELECTED_USERS';
        END IF;
        IF cardinality(v_clean_selected) > 1000 THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'TOO_MANY_SELECTED_USERS';
        END IF;

        SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_missing_count
        FROM unnest(v_clean_selected) AS u
        WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles WHERE id = u);

        IF v_missing_count > 0 THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_RECIPIENT_USER';
        END IF;
    ELSE
        p_target_role := NULL;
        v_clean_selected := '{}';
    END IF;

    UPDATE public.notification_campaigns
    SET title_vi = TRIM(p_title_vi),
        title_en = TRIM(p_title_en),
        body_vi = TRIM(p_body_vi),
        body_en = TRIM(p_body_en),
        default_locale = p_default_locale,
        audience_type = p_audience_type,
        target_role = p_target_role,
        selected_user_ids = v_clean_selected,
        revision = revision + 1,
        updated_at = clock_timestamp()
    WHERE id = p_campaign_id
    RETURNING * INTO v_camp;

    -- If campaign was queued, re-take recipient snapshot
    IF v_camp.status = 'queued' THEN
        PERFORM public._notif_snapshot_recipients(v_camp.id);
        SELECT * INTO v_camp FROM public.notification_campaigns WHERE id = v_camp.id;
    END IF;

    INSERT INTO public.notification_campaign_events (
        campaign_id,
        admin_id,
        action,
        reason,
        details
    ) VALUES (
        v_camp.id,
        v_admin_id,
        'updated',
        p_reason,
        jsonb_build_object('revision', v_camp.revision)
    );

    v_response := jsonb_build_object(
        'success', true,
        'replayed', false,
        'campaign', public._notif_campaign_to_jsonb(v_camp)
    );

    INSERT INTO public.notification_campaign_requests (
        request_id,
        admin_id,
        action,
        campaign_id,
        payload_hash,
        response_json
    ) VALUES (
        p_request_id,
        v_admin_id,
        'update',
        v_camp.id,
        v_payload_hash,
        v_response
    );

    RETURN v_response;
END;
$$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.admin_update_notification_campaign(uuid, uuid, integer, text, text, text, text, text, text, text, uuid[], text) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.admin_update_notification_campaign(uuid, uuid, integer, text, text, text, text, text, text, text, uuid[], text) TO authenticated, service_role;


-- ============================================================================
-- 9. ADMIN RPC: ADMIN_PREVIEW_NOTIFICATION_CAMPAIGN
-- ============================================================================

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_preview_notification_campaign(
    p_campaign_id uuid DEFAULT NULL,
    p_audience_type text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_target_role text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_selected_user_ids uuid[] DEFAULT NULL,
    p_default_locale text DEFAULT 'vi',
    p_title_vi text DEFAULT '',
    p_title_en text DEFAULT '',
    p_body_vi text DEFAULT '',
    p_body_en text DEFAULT ''
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $$
DECLARE
    v_admin_id uuid;
    v_camp public.notification_campaigns;
    v_aud text;
    v_role text;
    v_selected uuid[] := '{}';
    v_locale text;
    v_title_vi text;
    v_title_en text;
    v_body_vi text;
    v_body_en text;
    v_count integer := 0;
    v_prev_vi_title text;
    v_prev_vi_body text;
    v_prev_en_title text;
    v_prev_en_body text;
    v_eff_title text;
    v_eff_body text;
BEGIN
    v_admin_id := public._assert_daily_task_admin();

    IF p_campaign_id IS NOT NULL THEN
        SELECT * INTO v_camp
        FROM public.notification_campaigns
        WHERE id = p_campaign_id;

        IF NOT FOUND THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'CAMPAIGN_NOT_FOUND';
        END IF;

        v_aud := v_camp.audience_type;
        v_role := v_camp.target_role;
        v_selected := COALESCE(v_camp.selected_user_ids, '{}'::uuid[]);
        v_locale := v_camp.default_locale;
        v_title_vi := v_camp.title_vi;
        v_title_en := v_camp.title_en;
        v_body_vi := v_camp.body_vi;
        v_body_en := v_camp.body_en;

        -- If campaign has already snapshotted recipients, use that exact count
        IF v_camp.status IN ('queued', 'sending', 'completed') AND v_camp.total_recipients > 0 THEN
            v_count := v_camp.total_recipients;
        END IF;
    ELSE
        v_aud := COALESCE(p_audience_type, 'all');
        v_role := p_target_role;
        IF p_selected_user_ids IS NOT NULL THEN
            SELECT array_agg(DISTINCT u) INTO v_selected FROM unnest(p_selected_user_ids) AS u WHERE u IS NOT NULL;
        END IF;
        v_locale := COALESCE(p_default_locale, 'vi');
        v_title_vi := COALESCE(p_title_vi, '');
        v_title_en := COALESCE(p_title_en, '');
        v_body_vi := COALESCE(p_body_vi, '');
        v_body_en := COALESCE(p_body_en, '');
    END IF;

    -- If count not yet derived from snapshot
    IF v_count = 0 AND (v_camp.id IS NULL OR v_camp.status = 'draft') THEN
        IF v_aud = 'all' THEN
            SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_count FROM public.profiles;
        ELSIF v_aud = 'role' THEN
            IF v_role NOT IN ('member', 'moderator', 'admin') THEN
                RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_TARGET_ROLE';
            END IF;
            SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_count FROM public.profiles WHERE role = v_role;
        ELSIF v_aud = 'selected_users' THEN
            IF v_selected IS NOT NULL AND cardinality(v_selected) > 0 THEN
                SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_count
                FROM public.profiles
                WHERE id = ANY(v_selected);
            ELSE
                v_count := 0;
            END IF;
        END IF;
    END IF;

    -- Compute previews
    SELECT delivered_title, delivered_message INTO v_prev_vi_title, v_prev_vi_body
    FROM public._notif_resolve_delivered_content(v_title_vi, v_title_en, v_body_vi, v_body_en, 'vi');

    SELECT delivered_title, delivered_message INTO v_prev_en_title, v_prev_en_body
    FROM public._notif_resolve_delivered_content(v_title_vi, v_title_en, v_body_vi, v_body_en, 'en');

    SELECT delivered_title, delivered_message INTO v_eff_title, v_eff_body
    FROM public._notif_resolve_delivered_content(v_title_vi, v_title_en, v_body_vi, v_body_en, v_locale);

    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
        'success', true,
        'recipient_count', v_count,
        'audience_type', v_aud,
        'target_role', v_role,
        'default_locale', v_locale,
        'preview_vi', jsonb_build_object('title', v_prev_vi_title, 'body', v_prev_vi_body),
        'preview_en', jsonb_build_object('title', v_prev_en_title, 'body', v_prev_en_body),
        'preview_effective', jsonb_build_object('locale', v_locale, 'title', v_eff_title, 'body', v_eff_body)
    );
END;
$$;

-- ============================================================================
-- 10. ADMIN RPC: ADMIN_SCHEDULE_NOTIFICATION_CAMPAIGN
-- ============================================================================

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_schedule_notification_campaign(
    p_request_id uuid,
    p_campaign_id uuid,
    p_expected_revision integer,
    p_scheduled_for timestamptz,
    p_reason text DEFAULT NULL
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $$
DECLARE
    v_admin_id uuid;
    v_payload_hash text;
    v_existing_req public.notification_campaign_requests;
    v_camp public.notification_campaigns;
    v_response jsonb;
BEGIN
    v_admin_id := public._assert_daily_task_admin();

    IF p_request_id IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_REQUEST_ID';
    END IF;
    IF p_campaign_id IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_CAMPAIGN_ID';
    END IF;
    IF p_expected_revision IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'REVISION_REQUIRED';
    END IF;
    IF p_scheduled_for IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'SCHEDULE_TIME_REQUIRED';
    END IF;

    IF p_scheduled_for <= clock_timestamp() THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'SCHEDULE_TIME_MUST_BE_IN_FUTURE: Scheduled delivery must be strictly in the future';
    END IF;

    v_payload_hash := md5(concat_ws('|',
        'schedule',
        p_campaign_id::text,
        p_expected_revision::text,
        to_char(p_scheduled_for AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"'),
        COALESCE(p_reason, '')
    ));

    SELECT * INTO v_existing_req
    FROM public.notification_campaign_requests
    WHERE request_id = p_request_id;

    IF v_existing_req.request_id IS NOT NULL THEN
        IF v_existing_req.payload_hash <> v_payload_hash OR v_existing_req.action <> 'schedule' THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT: Request ID already used with different payload';
        END IF;
        RETURN v_existing_req.response_json || jsonb_build_object('replayed', true);
    END IF;

    SELECT * INTO v_camp
    FROM public.notification_campaigns
    WHERE id = p_campaign_id
    FOR UPDATE;

    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'CAMPAIGN_NOT_FOUND';
    END IF;

    IF v_camp.status NOT IN ('draft', 'queued') THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'CAMPAIGN_NOT_MODIFIABLE: Only draft or queued campaigns can be scheduled';
    END IF;

    IF v_camp.status = 'queued' AND v_camp.scheduled_for <= clock_timestamp() THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'CAMPAIGN_ALREADY_DUE: Campaign is already due for processing';
    END IF;

    IF v_camp.revision <> p_expected_revision THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'REVISION_CONFLICT: Expected revision % but found %', p_expected_revision, v_camp.revision;
    END IF;

    -- Take deterministic recipient snapshot
    PERFORM public._notif_snapshot_recipients(v_camp.id);

    UPDATE public.notification_campaigns
    SET status = 'queued',
        scheduled_for = p_scheduled_for,
        revision = revision + 1,
        updated_at = clock_timestamp()
    WHERE id = p_campaign_id
    RETURNING * INTO v_camp;

    INSERT INTO public.notification_campaign_events (
        campaign_id,
        admin_id,
        action,
        reason,
        details
    ) VALUES (
        v_camp.id,
        v_admin_id,
        'scheduled',
        p_reason,
        jsonb_build_object(
            'scheduled_for', to_char(p_scheduled_for AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"'),
            'total_recipients', v_camp.total_recipients,
            'revision', v_camp.revision
        )
    );

    v_response := jsonb_build_object(
        'success', true,
        'replayed', false,
        'campaign', public._notif_campaign_to_jsonb(v_camp)
    );

    INSERT INTO public.notification_campaign_requests (
        request_id,
        admin_id,
        action,
        campaign_id,
        payload_hash,
        response_json
    ) VALUES (
        p_request_id,
        v_admin_id,
        'schedule',
        v_camp.id,
        v_payload_hash,
        v_response
    );

    RETURN v_response;
END;
$$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.admin_schedule_notification_campaign(uuid, uuid, integer, timestamptz, text) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.admin_schedule_notification_campaign(uuid, uuid, integer, timestamptz, text) TO authenticated, service_role;

-- ============================================================================
-- 12. ADMIN RPC: ADMIN_CANCEL_NOTIFICATION_CAMPAIGN
-- ============================================================================

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_cancel_notification_campaign(
    p_request_id uuid,
    p_campaign_id uuid,
    p_expected_revision integer,
    p_reason text
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $$
DECLARE
    v_admin_id uuid;
    v_payload_hash text;
    v_existing_req public.notification_campaign_requests;
    v_camp public.notification_campaigns;
    v_response jsonb;
BEGIN
    v_admin_id := public._assert_daily_task_admin();

    IF p_request_id IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_REQUEST_ID';
    END IF;
    IF p_campaign_id IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_CAMPAIGN_ID';
    END IF;
    IF p_expected_revision IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'REVISION_REQUIRED';
    END IF;
    IF p_reason IS NULL OR TRIM(p_reason) = '' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'REASON_REQUIRED: Cancellation reason is required';
    END IF;

    v_payload_hash := md5(concat_ws('|',
        'cancel',
        p_campaign_id::text,
        p_expected_revision::text,
        TRIM(p_reason)
    ));

    SELECT * INTO v_existing_req
    FROM public.notification_campaign_requests
    WHERE request_id = p_request_id;

    IF v_existing_req.request_id IS NOT NULL THEN
        IF v_existing_req.payload_hash <> v_payload_hash OR v_existing_req.action <> 'cancel' THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT: Request ID already used with different payload';
        END IF;
        RETURN v_existing_req.response_json || jsonb_build_object('replayed', true);
    END IF;

    SELECT * INTO v_camp
    FROM public.notification_campaigns
    WHERE id = p_campaign_id
    FOR UPDATE;

    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'CAMPAIGN_NOT_FOUND';
    END IF;

    IF v_camp.revision <> p_expected_revision THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'REVISION_CONFLICT: Expected revision % but found %', p_expected_revision, v_camp.revision;
    END IF;

    -- Only draft or future queued campaigns can be cancelled
    IF v_camp.status = 'draft' THEN
        -- Allowed
        NULL;
    ELSIF v_camp.status = 'queued' AND v_camp.scheduled_for > clock_timestamp() THEN
        -- Future queued: Allowed
        NULL;
    ELSE
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'CANNOT_CANCEL_IN_FLIGHT_OR_PAST_CAMPAIGN: Cannot cancel campaign that is sending, completed, cancelled, or already due';
    END IF;

    -- Remove any unsent recipients
    DELETE FROM public.notification_campaign_recipients
    WHERE campaign_id = p_campaign_id AND status = 'pending';

    UPDATE public.notification_campaigns
    SET status = 'cancelled',
        cancelled_at = clock_timestamp(),
        cancelled_by = v_admin_id,
        cancel_reason = TRIM(p_reason),
        revision = revision + 1,
        updated_at = clock_timestamp()
    WHERE id = p_campaign_id
    RETURNING * INTO v_camp;

    INSERT INTO public.notification_campaign_events (
        campaign_id,
        admin_id,
        action,
        reason,
        details
    ) VALUES (
        v_camp.id,
        v_admin_id,
        'cancelled',
        TRIM(p_reason),
        jsonb_build_object('revision', v_camp.revision)
    );

    v_response := jsonb_build_object(
        'success', true,
        'replayed', false,
        'campaign', public._notif_campaign_to_jsonb(v_camp)
    );

    INSERT INTO public.notification_campaign_requests (
        request_id,
        admin_id,
        action,
        campaign_id,
        payload_hash,
        response_json
    ) VALUES (
        p_request_id,
        v_admin_id,
        'cancel',
        v_camp.id,
        v_payload_hash,
        v_response
    );

    RETURN v_response;
END;
$$;

GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.admin_cancel_notification_campaign(uuid, uuid, integer, text) TO authenticated, service_role;


-- ============================================================================
-- 13. CORE BATCH FANOUT WORKER (Service-only execution)
-- ============================================================================

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.service_process_notification_campaigns(
    p_batch_size integer DEFAULT 500,
    p_max_campaigns integer DEFAULT 10,
    p_campaign_id uuid DEFAULT NULL
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $$
DECLARE
    v_camp RECORD;
    v_campaigns_processed integer := 0;
    v_total_notifications_sent integer := 0;
    v_camp_batch_sent integer := 0;
    v_deliv_title text;
    v_deliv_message text;
    v_pending_remaining integer;
    v_batch_limit integer;
    v_details jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
BEGIN
    v_batch_limit := GREATEST(1, LEAST(COALESCE(p_batch_size, 500), 1000));

    FOR v_camp IN
        SELECT c.*
        FROM public.notification_campaigns c
        WHERE (p_campaign_id IS NULL OR c.id = p_campaign_id)
          AND c.status IN ('queued', 'sending')
          AND c.scheduled_for <= clock_timestamp()
        ORDER BY c.scheduled_for ASC, c.id ASC
        LIMIT p_max_campaigns
        FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
    LOOP
        -- If campaign was queued, transition to sending and ensure snapshot
        IF v_camp.status = 'queued' THEN
            IF v_camp.total_recipients = 0 THEN
                PERFORM public._notif_snapshot_recipients(v_camp.id);
            END IF;

            UPDATE public.notification_campaigns
            SET status = 'sending',
                started_at = COALESCE(v_camp.started_at, clock_timestamp()),
                updated_at = clock_timestamp()
            WHERE id = v_camp.id;

            INSERT INTO public.notification_campaign_events (campaign_id, action, details)
            VALUES (v_camp.id, 'worker_started', jsonb_build_object('batch_size', v_batch_limit));
        END IF;

        -- Resolve delivered content
        SELECT delivered_title, delivered_message INTO v_deliv_title, v_deliv_message
        FROM public._notif_resolve_delivered_content(
            v_camp.title_vi,
            v_camp.title_en,
            v_camp.body_vi,
            v_camp.body_en,
            v_camp.default_locale
        );

        -- Atomically lock pending recipient rows with SKIP LOCKED,
        -- create notifications rows without popup states,
        -- and update recipient receipts to 'sent'
        WITH target_recipients AS (
            SELECT r.id AS recipient_id, r.user_id
            FROM public.notification_campaign_recipients r
            WHERE r.campaign_id = v_camp.id
              AND r.status = 'pending'
            ORDER BY r.user_id ASC
            LIMIT v_batch_limit
            FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
        ),
        created_notifications AS (
            INSERT INTO public.notifications (
                user_id,
                title,
                message,
                type,
                data,
                created_at
            )
            SELECT
                tr.user_id,
                v_deliv_title,
                v_deliv_message,
                'admin',
                jsonb_build_object(
                    'campaign_id', v_camp.id,
                    'broadcast', true,
                    'sender', 'admin',
                    'locale', v_camp.default_locale,
                    'title_vi', v_camp.title_vi,
                    'title_en', v_camp.title_en
                ),
                clock_timestamp()
            FROM target_recipients tr
            RETURNING id AS notification_id, user_id
        ),
        updated_recipients AS (
            UPDATE public.notification_campaign_recipients r
            SET status = 'sent',
                notification_id = cn.notification_id,
                sent_at = clock_timestamp()
            FROM created_notifications cn
            WHERE r.campaign_id = v_camp.id
              AND r.user_id = cn.user_id
              AND r.status = 'pending'
            RETURNING r.id
        )
        SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_camp_batch_sent FROM updated_recipients;

        v_total_notifications_sent := v_total_notifications_sent + v_camp_batch_sent;
        v_campaigns_processed := v_campaigns_processed + 1;

        -- Update sent count on campaign
        UPDATE public.notification_campaigns
        SET sent_count = (
                SELECT COUNT(*)
                FROM public.notification_campaign_recipients
                WHERE campaign_id = v_camp.id AND status = 'sent'
            ),
            updated_at = clock_timestamp()
        WHERE id = v_camp.id;

        -- Check remaining pending recipients
        SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_pending_remaining
        FROM public.notification_campaign_recipients
        WHERE campaign_id = v_camp.id AND status = 'pending';

        IF v_pending_remaining = 0 THEN
            UPDATE public.notification_campaigns
            SET status = 'completed',
                completed_at = clock_timestamp(),
                updated_at = clock_timestamp()
            WHERE id = v_camp.id;

            INSERT INTO public.notification_campaign_events (campaign_id, action, details)
            VALUES (v_camp.id, 'worker_completed', jsonb_build_object(
                'total_recipients', v_camp.total_recipients,
                'sent_count', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.notification_campaign_recipients WHERE campaign_id = v_camp.id AND status = 'sent')
            ));
        END IF;

        v_details := v_details || jsonb_build_object(
            'campaign_id', v_camp.id,
            'sent_in_batch', v_camp_batch_sent,
            'pending_remaining', v_pending_remaining,
            'completed', (v_pending_remaining = 0)
        );
    END LOOP;

    -- Update heartbeat
    INSERT INTO public.notification_worker_heartbeats (
        worker_key,
        last_run_at,
        campaigns_processed,
        notifications_sent,
        status
    ) VALUES (
        'service_cron',
        clock_timestamp(),
        v_campaigns_processed,
        v_total_notifications_sent,
        'idle'
    )
    ON CONFLICT (worker_key) DO UPDATE SET
        last_run_at = excluded.last_run_at,
        campaigns_processed = public.notification_worker_heartbeats.campaigns_processed + excluded.campaigns_processed,
        notifications_sent = public.notification_worker_heartbeats.notifications_sent + excluded.notifications_sent,
        status = excluded.status;

    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
        'success', true,
        'campaigns_processed', v_campaigns_processed,
        'notifications_sent', v_total_notifications_sent,
        'details', v_details
    );
END;
$$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.service_process_notification_campaigns(integer, integer, uuid) FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.service_process_notification_campaigns(integer, integer, uuid) TO service_role;

-- ============================================================================
-- 15. ADMIN RPC: ADMIN_LIST_NOTIFICATION_CAMPAIGNS (Cursor paginated)
-- ============================================================================

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_list_notification_campaigns(
    p_status text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_audience_type text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_limit integer DEFAULT 20,
    p_cursor text DEFAULT NULL
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $$
DECLARE
    v_admin_id uuid;
    v_limit integer;
    v_cursor_created_at timestamptz;
    v_cursor_id uuid;
    v_items jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
    v_has_more boolean := false;
    v_next_cursor text := NULL;
    v_last_created_at timestamptz;
    v_last_id uuid;
    v_row RECORD;
    v_count integer := 0;
BEGIN
    v_admin_id := public._assert_daily_task_admin();

    v_limit := GREATEST(1, LEAST(COALESCE(p_limit, 20), 100));

    IF p_cursor IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(p_cursor) <> '' THEN
        BEGIN
            v_cursor_created_at := split_part(p_cursor, '|', 1)::timestamptz;
            v_cursor_id := split_part(p_cursor, '|', 2)::uuid;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_CURSOR: Cursor format must be ISO8601|uuid';
        END EXCEPTION;
    END IF;

    FOR v_row IN
        SELECT c.*,
            COALESCE((
                SELECT COUNT(*)
                FROM public.notification_campaign_recipients r
                JOIN public.notifications n ON n.id = r.notification_id
                WHERE r.campaign_id = c.id AND n.is_read = true
            ), 0) AS live_read_count
        FROM public.notification_campaigns c
        WHERE (p_status IS NULL OR c.status = p_status)
          AND (p_audience_type IS NULL OR c.audience_type = p_audience_type)
          AND (
              v_cursor_created_at IS NULL OR
              (c.created_at, c.id) < (v_cursor_created_at, v_cursor_id)
          )
        ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.id DESC
        LIMIT v_limit + 1
    LOOP
        v_count := v_count + 1;
        IF v_count <= v_limit THEN
            v_items := v_items || jsonb_build_object(
                'id', v_row.id,
                'title_vi', v_row.title_vi,
                'title_en', v_row.title_en,
                'body_vi', v_row.body_vi,
                'body_en', v_row.body_en,
                'default_locale', v_row.default_locale,
                'audience_type', v_row.audience_type,
                'target_role', v_row.target_role,
                'status', v_row.status,
                'revision', v_row.revision,
                'total_recipients', v_row.total_recipients,
                'sent_count', v_row.sent_count,
                'read_count', v_row.live_read_count,
                'failed_count', v_row.failed_count,
                'scheduled_for', CASE WHEN v_row.scheduled_for IS NOT NULL THEN to_char(v_row.scheduled_for AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') ELSE NULL END,
                'started_at', CASE WHEN v_row.started_at IS NOT NULL THEN to_char(v_row.started_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') ELSE NULL END,
                'completed_at', CASE WHEN v_row.completed_at IS NOT NULL THEN to_char(v_row.completed_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') ELSE NULL END,
                'created_by', v_row.created_by,
                'created_at', to_char(v_row.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"'),
                'updated_at', to_char(v_row.updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"')
            );

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_get_notification_campaign_detail(
    p_campaign_id uuid
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $$
DECLARE
    v_admin_id uuid;
    v_camp public.notification_campaigns;
    v_events jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
    v_preview jsonb;
    v_ev RECORD;
BEGIN
    v_admin_id := public._assert_daily_task_admin();

    IF p_campaign_id IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_CAMPAIGN_ID';
    END IF;

    SELECT * INTO v_camp
    FROM public.notification_campaigns
    WHERE id = p_campaign_id;

    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'CAMPAIGN_NOT_FOUND';
    END IF;

    v_preview := public.admin_preview_notification_campaign(p_campaign_id => p_campaign_id);

    FOR v_ev IN
        SELECT e.id, e.action, e.admin_id, e.reason, e.details,
               to_char(e.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') AS created_at_iso
        FROM public.notification_campaign_events e
        WHERE e.campaign_id = p_campaign_id
        ORDER BY e.created_at ASC, e.id ASC
    LOOP
        v_events := v_events || jsonb_build_object(
            'id', v_ev.id,
            'action', v_ev.action,
            'admin_id', v_ev.admin_id,
            'reason', v_ev.reason,
            'details', v_ev.details,
            'created_at', v_ev.created_at_iso
        );
    END LOOP;

    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
        'campaign', public._notif_campaign_to_jsonb(v_camp),
        'preview', v_preview,
        'events', v_events
    );
END;
$$;

-- ============================================================================
-- 17. ADMIN RPC: ADMIN_LIST_NOTIFICATION_CAMPAIGN_RECIPIENTS (Cursor paginated)
-- ============================================================================

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_list_notification_campaign_recipients(
    p_campaign_id uuid,
    p_status text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_limit integer DEFAULT 50,
    p_cursor text DEFAULT NULL
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $$
DECLARE
    v_admin_id uuid;
    v_limit integer;
    v_cursor_created_at timestamptz;
    v_cursor_id uuid;
    v_items jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
    v_has_more boolean := false;
    v_next_cursor text := NULL;
    v_last_created_at timestamptz;
    v_last_id uuid;
    v_row RECORD;
    v_count integer := 0;
BEGIN
    v_admin_id := public._assert_daily_task_admin();

    IF p_campaign_id IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_CAMPAIGN_ID';
    END IF;

    v_limit := GREATEST(1, LEAST(COALESCE(p_limit, 50), 100));

    IF p_cursor IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(p_cursor) <> '' THEN
        BEGIN
            v_cursor_created_at := split_part(p_cursor, '|', 1)::timestamptz;
            v_cursor_id := split_part(p_cursor, '|', 2)::uuid;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_CURSOR: Cursor format must be ISO8601|uuid';
        END EXCEPTION;
    END IF;

    FOR v_row IN
        SELECT r.id AS recipient_id,
               r.user_id,
               p.email AS user_email,
               p.display_name AS user_display_name,
               p.role AS user_role,
               r.status,
               r.notification_id,
               r.sent_at,
               r.error_message,
               r.created_at,
               COALESCE(n.is_read, false) AS is_read
        FROM public.notification_campaign_recipients r
        JOIN public.profiles p ON p.id = r.user_id
        LEFT JOIN public.notifications n ON n.id = r.notification_id
        WHERE r.campaign_id = p_campaign_id
          AND (p_status IS NULL OR r.status = p_status)
          AND (
              v_cursor_created_at IS NULL OR
              (r.created_at, r.id) > (v_cursor_created_at, v_cursor_id)
          )
        ORDER BY r.created_at ASC, r.id ASC
        LIMIT v_limit + 1
    LOOP
        v_count := v_count + 1;
        IF v_count <= v_limit THEN
            v_items := v_items || jsonb_build_object(
                'recipient_id', v_row.recipient_id,
                'user_id', v_row.user_id,
                'user_email', v_row.user_email,
                'user_display_name', v_row.user_display_name,
                'user_role', v_row.user_role,
                'status', v_row.status,
                'notification_id', v_row.notification_id,
                'sent_at', CASE WHEN v_row.sent_at IS NOT NULL THEN to_char(v_row.sent_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') ELSE NULL END,
                'is_read', v_row.is_read,
                'error_message', v_row.error_message
            );
            v_last_created_at := v_row.created_at;
            v_last_id := v_row.recipient_id;
        ELSE
            v_has_more := true;
        END IF;
    END LOOP;

    IF v_has_more AND v_last_created_at IS NOT NULL THEN
        v_next_cursor := to_char(v_last_created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') || '|' || v_last_id::text;
    END IF;

    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
        'items', v_items,
        'has_more', v_has_more,
        'next_cursor', v_next_cursor
    );
END;
$$;

-- ============================================================================
-- 18. ADMIN RPC: ADMIN_GET_NOTIFICATION_SCHEDULER_HEALTH
-- ============================================================================

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_get_notification_scheduler_health()
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $$
DECLARE
    v_admin_id uuid;
    v_cron_available boolean := false;
    v_cron_job_active boolean := false;
    v_pending_due_count integer := 0;
    v_in_flight_count integer := 0;
    v_heartbeat RECORD;
    v_health_status text := 'healthy';
BEGIN
    v_admin_id := public._assert_daily_task_admin();

    -- Check pg_cron
    IF to_regclass('cron.job') IS NOT NULL THEN
        v_cron_available := true;
        BEGIN
            EXECUTE 'SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cron.job WHERE jobname = ''process_due_notification_campaigns'' AND active = true)'
            INTO v_cron_job_active;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
            v_cron_job_active := false;
        END;
    END IF;

    -- Count pending due campaigns
    SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_pending_due_count
    FROM public.notification_campaigns
    WHERE status IN ('queued', 'sending')
      AND scheduled_for <= clock_timestamp();

    -- Count in flight
    SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_in_flight_count
    FROM public.notification_campaigns
    WHERE status = 'sending';

    -- Retrieve last heartbeat
    SELECT * INTO v_heartbeat
    FROM public.notification_worker_heartbeats
    WHERE worker_key = 'service_cron';

    IF v_pending_due_count > 10 THEN
        v_health_status := 'degraded';
    ELSIF NOT v_cron_available AND v_heartbeat.last_run_at IS NULL THEN
        v_health_status := 'scheduler_manual_fallback_required';
    ELSIF v_pending_due_count = 0 AND v_in_flight_count = 0 THEN
        v_health_status := 'idle';
    END IF;

    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
        'pg_cron_available', v_cron_available,
        'pg_cron_job_active', v_cron_job_active,
        'pending_due_campaigns_count', v_pending_due_count,
        'in_flight_campaigns_count', v_in_flight_count,
        'last_worker_run_at', CASE WHEN v_heartbeat.last_run_at IS NOT NULL THEN to_char(v_heartbeat.last_run_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') ELSE NULL END,
        'lifetime_campaigns_processed', COALESCE(v_heartbeat.campaigns_processed, 0),
        'lifetime_notifications_sent', COALESCE(v_heartbeat.notifications_sent, 0),
        'health_status', v_health_status
    );
END;
$$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.admin_get_notification_scheduler_health() FROM PUBLIC, anon;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.admin_get_notification_scheduler_health() TO authenticated, service_role;


-- ============================================================================
-- 19. CONDITIONAL PG_CRON REGISTRATION WITH SAFE FALLBACK
-- ============================================================================

DO $cron_setup$
BEGIN
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM pg_extension WHERE extname = 'pg_cron'
    ) OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM pg_available_extensions WHERE name = 'pg_cron'
    ) THEN
        BEGIN
            CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pg_cron;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
            RAISE NOTICE 'pg_cron extension creation skipped: %', SQLERRM;
        END;

        IF to_regclass('cron.job') IS NOT NULL THEN
            IF NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM cron.job WHERE jobname = 'process_due_notification_campaigns'
            ) THEN
                PERFORM cron.schedule(
                    'process_due_notification_campaigns',
                    '* * * * *',
                    'SELECT public.service_process_notification_campaigns(500, 10);'
                );
            END IF;
        END IF;
    END IF;
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
    RAISE NOTICE 'pg_cron conditional scheduling skipped (environment without pg_cron): %', SQLERRM;
END;
$cron_setup$;

COMMIT;

/**
 * Service Worker Runner for Notification Campaigns (Fallback Scheduler)
 *
 * Usage:
 *   DATABASE_URL="postgres://postgres:password@localhost:5432/postgres" node worker-runner.mjs [--once] [--interval=60]
 *
 * In environments where pg_cron extension cannot be installed or enabled,
 * run this script as a background daemon (e.g., via systemd, PM2, or Docker container)
 * to continuously process due notification campaigns.
 */

import { parseArgs } from 'node:util';

const options = {
  once: { type: 'boolean', default: false },
  interval: { type: 'string', default: '60' },
  batch: { type: 'string', default: '500' },
  campaigns: { type: 'string', default: '10' }
};

const { values } = parseArgs({ options, allowPositionals: true });
const runOnce = values.once;
const intervalSec = Math.max(5, parseInt(values.interval, 10) || 60);
const batchSize = Math.max(1, parseInt(values.batch, 10) || 500);
const maxCampaigns = Math.max(1, parseInt(values.campaigns, 10) || 10);

async function runWorkerIteration() {
  const dbUrl = process.env.DATABASE_URL || process.env.SUPABASE_DB_URL;
  if (!dbUrl) {
    console.error('[worker-runner] ERROR: DATABASE_URL or SUPABASE_DB_URL environment variable is required.');
    process.exit(1);
  }

  // Dynamic import of pg driver when used in production service
  let Client;
  try {
    const pg = await import('pg');
    Client = pg.default?.Client || pg.Client;
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('[worker-runner] ERROR: pg package not installed. Install with npm install pg or run via psql.');
    process.exit(1);
  }

  const client = new Client({ connectionString: dbUrl });
  await client.connect();

  try {
    const res = await client.query(
      'SELECT public.service_process_notification_campaigns($1, $2) as result',
      [batchSize, maxCampaigns]
    );
    const result = res.rows[0]?.result;
    const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
    console.log(`[worker-runner ${nowIso}] Iteration completed:`, JSON.stringify(result));
    return result;
  } finally {
    await client.end();
  }
}

if (runOnce) {
  runWorkerIteration().catch(err => {
    console.error('[worker-runner] Fatal error during iteration:', err);
    process.exit(1);
  });
} else {
  console.log(`[worker-runner] Starting background worker loop (interval: ${intervalSec}s, batchSize: ${batchSize})...`);
  
  const tick = async () => {
    try {
      await runWorkerIteration();
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('[worker-runner] Iteration error:', err);
    }
  };

  await tick();
  setInterval(tick, intervalSec * 1000);
}

async function asUser(uid, role = 'authenticated', fn) {
  if (uid === null) {
    await db.exec(`savepoint sp_user; select set_config('request.jwt.claim.sub', '', true); set local role anon;`);
  } else {
    await db.exec(`savepoint sp_user; select set_config('request.jwt.claim.sub', '${uid}', true); set local role ${role};`);
  }
  try {
    const result = await fn();
    await db.exec(`release savepoint sp_user;`);
    return result;
  } catch (err) {
    await db.exec(`rollback to savepoint sp_user;`);
    throw err;
  } finally {
    try {
      await db.exec(`reset role; select set_config('request.jwt.claim.sub', '', true);`);
    } catch {
      // ignore
    }
  }
}

}
