CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_campaign_detail(p_campaign_id uuid)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
    v_uid uuid := auth.uid();
    v_camp record;
    v_is_member boolean := false;
    v_is_owner boolean := false;
    v_is_actual_owner boolean := false;
    v_member_joined_at timestamptz := null;
    v_feedbacks jsonb;
    v_my_dates jsonb;
    v_campaign jsonb;
    v_unread jsonb;
    v_weekly int := 0;
    v_today date := (now() at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date;
    v_caller_role text;
    v_caller_locked boolean := false;
    v_can_manage boolean := false;
    v_my_profile jsonb;
    v_rel record;
    v_claim record;
    v_app_update jsonb := null;
    v_is_eligible boolean := true;
    v_ineligible_reason text := null;
    v_total_reports int := 0;
    v_pending_reports int := 0;
begin
    if v_uid is null then
        raise exception 'NOT_AUTHENTICATED';
    end if;

    select role, coalesce(is_locked, false)
    into v_caller_role, v_caller_locked
    from public.profiles
    where id = v_uid;

    select * into v_camp from public.campaigns where id = p_campaign_id;
    if v_camp.id is null then
        raise exception 'CAMPAIGN_NOT_FOUND';
    end if;

    select exists(
        select 1 from public.campaign_members
        where campaign_id = p_campaign_id and user_id = v_uid
    ) into v_is_member;

    if v_is_member then
        select joined_at into v_member_joined_at
        from public.campaign_members
        where campaign_id = p_campaign_id and user_id = v_uid;
    end if;

    v_is_actual_owner := (v_camp.owner_id = v_uid);
    v_is_owner := v_is_actual_owner;

    if v_caller_locked = false then
        if v_caller_role in ('admin', 'moderator') then
            v_can_manage := true;
        elsif v_is_actual_owner then
            v_can_manage := true;
        end if;
    end if;

    if v_can_manage then
        select count(*), count(*) filter (where tr.status = 'pending' and tr.created_at >= now() - interval '8 hours')
        into v_total_reports, v_pending_reports
        from public.tester_reports tr
        where tr.campaign_id = p_campaign_id;
    else
        select count(*), count(*) filter (where tr.status = 'pending' and tr.created_at >= now() - interval '8 hours')
        into v_total_reports, v_pending_reports
        from public.tester_reports tr
        where tr.campaign_id = p_campaign_id and tr.user_id = v_uid;
    end if;

    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'rating', f.rating,
        'content', f.content,
        'created_at', to_char(f.created_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"'),
        'display_name', coalesce(p.display_name, 'Tester')
    ) order by f.created_at desc), '[]'::jsonb)
    into v_feedbacks
    from public.feedbacks f
    left join public.profiles p on p.id = f.user_id
    where f.campaign_id = p_campaign_id;

    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_char(ci.checkin_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') order by ci.checkin_date asc), '[]'::jsonb)
    into v_my_dates
    from public.checkins ci
    where ci.campaign_id = p_campaign_id and ci.user_id = v_uid;

    v_campaign := row_to_json(v_camp);

    select public._profile_json(p) into v_my_profile
    from public.profiles p where p.id = v_uid;

    -- Consistent warning counts excluding revocations
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'id', w.id,
        'user_id', w.user_id,
        'message', w.message,
        'warning_date', to_char(w.warning_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
        'created_at', to_char(w.created_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"'),
        'acknowledged', w.acknowledged
    ) order by w.created_at desc), '[]'::jsonb)
    into v_unread
    from public.user_warnings w
    where w.user_id = v_uid and w.acknowledged = false
      and not exists (
          select 1 from public.user_warning_revocations r

$function$;","newString":"-- Override get_campaign_detail to exclude revoked warnings from v_unread and v_weekly
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_campaign_detail(p_campaign_id uuid)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
    v_uid              uuid := auth.uid();
    v_today            date := (now() at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date;
    v_camp             public.campaigns%rowtype;
    v_is_owner         boolean := false;
    v_is_actual_owner  boolean := false;
    v_can_manage       boolean := false;
    v_is_member        boolean := false;
    v_member_joined_at timestamptz;
    v_confirmed        boolean := false;
    v_campaign         jsonb;
    v_testers          jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
    v_feedbacks        jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
    v_reports          jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
    v_profiles         jsonb := '{}'::jsonb;
    v_today_tested     int := 0;
    v_reports_count    int := 0;
    v_tester_reports_count int := 0;
    v_pending_reports_count int := 0;
    v_avg              float;
    v_my_dates         jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
    v_my_profile       jsonb;
    v_unread           jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
    v_weekly           int := 0;
    v_rel              record;
    v_app_update       jsonb := null;
    v_claim            record;
    v_is_eligible      boolean := true;
    v_ineligible_reason text := null;
begin
    if v_uid is null then
        raise exception 'NOT_AUTHENTICATED';
    end if;

    select * into v_camp from public.campaigns where id = p_campaign_id;
    if v_camp.id is null then
        raise exception 'CAMPAIGN_NOT_FOUND';
    end if;

    perform public.auto_accept_expired_reports();

    v_is_actual_owner := (v_camp.owner_id = v_uid);

    v_can_manage := (
        v_is_actual_owner
        or exists (
            select 1 from public.profiles p
            where p.id = v_uid and lower(p.role) in ('admin', 'moderator')
        )
    ) and not exists (
        select 1 from public.profiles p
        where p.id = v_uid and coalesce(p.is_locked, false) = true
    );

    v_is_owner := v_can_manage;

    select joined_at into v_member_joined_at
    from public.campaign_members m
    where m.campaign_id = p_campaign_id and m.user_id = v_uid;

    v_is_member := (v_member_joined_at is not null);

    v_confirmed := exists (
        select 1 from public.checkins ci
        where ci.campaign_id = p_campaign_id
          and ci.user_id = v_uid
          and ci.checkin_date = v_today
          and coalesce(ci.note, '') not like '%tạm tính%'
    );

    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'user_id', t.user_id,
        'joined_at', t.joined_at,
        'days', t.days,
        'checkin_count', t.checkin_count,
        'last_checkin_date', t.last_checkin_date
    ) order by t.days desc), '[]'::jsonb)
    into v_testers
    from (
        select m.user_id,
               to_char(m.joined_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') as joined_at,
               coalesce(s.days, 0) as days,
               coalesce(s.cnt, 0) as checkin_count,
               to_char(s.last_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as last_checkin_date
        from public.campaign_members m
        left join (
            select user_id,
                   count(distinct checkin_date) as days,
                   count(*) as cnt,
                   max(checkin_date) as last_date
            from public.checkins
            where campaign_id = p_campaign_id
            group by user_id
        ) s on s.user_id = m.user_id
        where m.campaign_id = p_campaign_id
    ) t;

    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'id', f.id,
        'campaign_id', f.campaign_id,
        'user_id', f.user_id,
        'rating', f.rating,
        'comment', f.comment,
        'created_at', to_char(f.created_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"'),
        'updated_at', to_char(f.updated_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"')
    ) order by f.created_at desc), '[]'::jsonb)
    into v_feedbacks
    from public.feedbacks f
    where f.campaign_id = p_campaign_id;

    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'id', tr.id,
        'campaign_id', tr.campaign_id,
        'user_id', tr.user_id,
        'report_type', tr.report_type,
        'content', tr.content,
        'screenshot_url', tr.screenshot_url,
        'thumbnail_url', tr.thumbnail_url,
        'rating', tr.rating,
        'status', tr.status,
        'bonus_awarded', tr.bonus_awarded,
        'created_at', to_char(tr.created_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"'),
        'reviewed_at', to_char(tr.reviewed_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"'),
        'rejection_reason', tr.rejection_reason,
        'image_hash', tr.image_hash,
        'submission_context', tr.submission_context,
        'mission_id', tr.mission_id,
        'mission_participant_id', tr.mission_participant_id,
        'mission_title', tr.mission_title,
        'mission_reward_credits', tr.mission_reward_credits,
        'mission_ends_at', to_char(tr.mission_ends_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"'),
        'mission_submitted_at', to_char(tr.mission_submitted_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"')
    ) order by tr.created_at desc), '[]'::jsonb)
    into v_reports
    from (
        select * from public.tester_reports
        where campaign_id = p_campaign_id
          and (v_can_manage or user_id = v_uid)
        order by created_at desc
        limit 200
    ) tr;

    select count(*),
           count(*) filter (where status = 'pending')
    into v_tester_reports_count, v_pending_reports_count
    from public.tester_reports
    where campaign_id = p_campaign_id
      and (v_can_manage or user_id = v_uid);

    select coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(t.id::text, public._profile_json(p)), '{}'::jsonb)
    into v_profiles
    from public.profiles p
    join (
        select v_camp.owner_id as id
        union
        select m.user_id from public.campaign_members m where m.campaign_id = p_campaign_id
        union
        select f.user_id from public.feedbacks f where f.campaign_id = p_campaign_id
        union
        select tr.user_id from public.tester_reports tr
        where tr.campaign_id = p_campaign_id and (v_can_manage or tr.user_id = v_uid)
    ) t on t.id = p.id;

    select count(distinct user_id) into v_today_tested
    from public.checkins
    where campaign_id = p_campaign_id and checkin_date = v_today;

    select count(*), coalesce(round(avg(rating)::numeric, 1), 0.0)
    into v_reports_count, v_avg
    from public.feedbacks
    where campaign_id = p_campaign_id;

    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_char(ci.checkin_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') order by ci.checkin_date asc), '[]'::jsonb)
    into v_my_dates
    from public.checkins ci
    where ci.campaign_id = p_campaign_id and ci.user_id = v_uid;

    v_campaign := row_to_json(v_camp);

    select public._profile_json(p) into v_my_profile
    from public.profiles p where p.id = v_uid;

    -- Consistent warning counts excluding revocations
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'id', w.id,
        'user_id', w.user_id,
        'message', w.message,
        'warning_date', to_char(w.warning_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
        'created_at', to_char(w.created_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"'),
        'acknowledged', w.acknowledged
    ) order by w.created_at desc), '[]'::jsonb)
    into v_unread
    from public.user_warnings w
    where w.user_id = v_uid and w.acknowledged = false
      and not exists (
          select 1 from public.user_warning_revocations r
          where r.warning_id = w.id
      );

    select count(*) into v_weekly
    from public.user_warnings w
    where w.user_id = v_uid
      and (w.created_at at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date >= (v_today - 6)
      and not exists (
          select 1 from public.user_warning_revocations r
          where r.warning_id = w.id
      );

    select * into v_rel
    from public.app_update_releases
    where campaign_id = p_campaign_id and status in ('active', 'exhausted')
    order by published_at desc, target_version_code desc
    limit 1;

    if v_rel.id is not null then
        if v_is_actual_owner then
            v_app_update := jsonb_build_object(
                'id', v_rel.id,
                'campaign_id', v_rel.campaign_id,
                'owner_id', coalesce(v_rel.owner_id, v_rel.owner_id_snapshot),
                'package_name', v_rel.package_name,
                'app_name', v_rel.app_name,
                'version_name', v_rel.version_name,
                'target_version_code', v_rel.target_version_code,
                'release_notes', v_rel.release_notes,
                'status', v_rel.status,
                'reward_per_claim', v_rel.reward_per_claim,
                'max_claims', v_rel.max_claims,
                'reserved_credits', v_rel.reserved_credits,
                'paid_count', v_rel.paid_count,
                'remaining_credits', v_rel.remaining_credits,
                'spent_credits', v_rel.paid_count * v_rel.reward_per_claim,
                'published_at', to_char(v_rel.published_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"')
            );
        else
            if v_rel.paid_count < v_rel.max_claims and v_rel.remaining_credits >= v_rel.reward_per_claim then
                select * into v_claim
                from public.app_update_claims
                where release_id = v_rel.id and tester_id = v_uid;

                if not v_is_member then
                    v_is_eligible := false;
                    v_ineligible_reason := 'not_member';
                elsif v_member_joined_at > v_rel.published_at then
                    v_is_eligible := false;
                    v_ineligible_reason := 'joined_after_release';
                elsif v_camp.status = 'paused' then
                    v_is_eligible := false;
                    v_ineligible_reason := 'campaign_paused';
                elsif v_camp.status <> 'open' then
                    v_is_eligible := false;
                    v_ineligible_reason := 'campaign_not_open';
                elsif exists (select 1 from public.profiles p where p.id = v_uid and coalesce(p.is_locked, false) = true) then
                    v_is_eligible := false;
                    v_ineligible_reason := 'user_locked';
                end if;

                v_app_update := jsonb_build_object(
                    'id', v_rel.id,
                    'campaign_id', v_rel.campaign_id,
                    'package_name', v_rel.package_name,
                    'app_name', v_rel.app_name,
                    'version_name', v_rel.version_name,
                    'target_version_code', v_rel.target_version_code,
                    'release_notes', v_rel.release_notes,
                    'status', v_rel.status,
                    'reward_per_claim', v_rel.reward_per_claim,
                    'max_claims', v_rel.max_claims,
                    'paid_count', v_rel.paid_count,
                    'has_claimed', (v_claim.id is not null),
                    'is_eligible', v_is_eligible,
                    'ineligibility_reason', v_ineligible_reason,
                    'claim_receipt', case when v_claim.id is not null then jsonb_build_object(
                        'claim_id', v_claim.id,
                        'release_id', v_claim.release_id,
                        'ordinal', v_claim.ordinal,
                        'reward_credits', v_claim.reward_credits,
                        'confirmed_at', to_char(v_claim.confirmed_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"')
                    ) else null end
                );
            end if;
        end if;
    end if;

    return jsonb_build_object(
        'campaign', v_campaign,
        'is_owner', v_is_owner,
        'is_actual_owner', v_is_actual_owner,
        'can_manage', v_can_manage,
        'is_member', v_is_member,
        'checked_in_confirmed_today', v_confirmed,
        'testers', v_testers,
        'feedbacks', v_feedbacks,
        'reports', v_reports,
        'profiles', v_profiles,
        'today_tested_count', v_today_tested,
        'reports_count', v_reports_count,
        'pending_reports_count', v_pending_reports_count,
        'tester_reports_count', v_tester_reports_count,
        'avg_rating', v_avg,
        'my_checkin_dates', v_my_dates,
        'my_profile', v_my_profile,
        'unread_warnings', v_unread,
        'weekly_warnings_count', v_weekly,
        'app_update', v_app_update
    );
end;

    end if;

    from public.profiles
    where id = v_report.user_id
    for update;

        greatest(0, least(10, coalesce(v_report.provisional_granted_credits, 2)))
    );

    if v_deduct > 0 then

        set credits = credits - v_deduct
        where id = v_report.user_id

        values (

            'test_rejected_clawback',
            format('Thu hồi %s Credit tạm nhận do báo cáo bị từ chối: %s', v_deduct, coalesce(p_reason, 'Chưa đạt yêu cầu')),
            v_new_balance,
            jsonb_build_object('report_id', v_report.id, 'campaign_id', v_camp.id, 'reason_code', v_final_reason_code)
        );
    else
        v_new_balance := coalesce(v_tester_credits, 0);
    end if;

    update public.tester_reports
    set status = 'rejected',
        rejection_reason = p_reason,
        reason_code = v_final_reason_code,
        bonus_awarded = 0,
        provisional_clawed = v_deduct,
        reviewed_at = now()

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.reject_tester_report(
    p_report_id uuid,
    p_reason text DEFAULT NULL::text,
    p_reason_code text DEFAULT NULL::text
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
    v_caller_id uuid := auth.uid();
    v_caller_role text;
    v_caller_locked boolean;
    v_report record;
    v_camp record;
    v_tester_credits int;
    v_deduct int := 0;
    v_new_balance int;
    v_report_date date;
    v_vn_today date := (now() at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date;

    v_extracted_code text;
    v_final_reason_code text;

    v_tester_warned boolean := false;
    v_tester_warning_msg text := null;
    v_tester_weekly_warnings int := 0;
    v_is_tester_locked boolean := false;

    v_owner_today_rejections int := 0;
    v_owner_warned boolean := false;
    v_owner_warning_msg text := null;
    v_owner_weekly_warnings int := 0;
    v_is_owner_locked boolean := false;

    v_msg_tester text := 'Hệ thống ghi nhận bạn tham gia kiểm thử chưa nghiêm túc, đề nghị test app nghiêm túc và chụp ảnh màn hình không trùng với ảnh đã chụp hôm trước (nên chụp các tính năng khác của ứng dụng kiểm thử). Nếu trong 1 tuần bạn bị 3 lần cảnh báo như thế này thì tài khoản của bạn sẽ bị tạm khóa';
    v_msg_owner text := 'Hệ thống ghi nhận bạn xác nhận kết quả của người kiểm thử chưa nghiêm túc, đề nghị đối chiếu kỹ ảnh chụp của người kiểm thử chụp các ngày khác nhau để duyệt cho chính xác. Nếu trong 1 tuần bạn bị 3 lần cảnh báo như thế này thì tài khoản của bạn sẽ bị tạm khóa';
begin
    if v_caller_id is null then
        raise exception 'NOT_AUTHENTICATED';
    end if;

    select role, coalesce(is_locked, false)
    into v_caller_role, v_caller_locked
    from public.profiles
    where id = v_caller_id;

    if v_caller_locked = true then
        raise exception 'ACCOUNT_LOCKED: Tài khoản của bạn đã bị khóa';
    end if;

    select * into v_report
    from public.tester_reports
    where id = p_report_id
    for update;

    if v_report.id is null then
        raise exception 'REPORT_NOT_FOUND';
    end if;

    if v_report.status <> 'pending' then
        raise exception 'REPORT_ALREADY_REVIEWED';
    end if;

    select * into v_camp
    from public.campaigns
    where id = v_report.campaign_id;

    if v_camp.owner_id <> v_caller_id
       and lower(coalesce(v_caller_role, '')) not in ('admin', 'moderator') then
        raise exception 'PERMISSION_DENIED';
    end if;

    if v_report.created_at <= (now() - interval '8 hours') then
        raise exception 'REPORT_EXPIRED';

                  where r.warning_id = w.id

  const ids1 = new Set(p1.items.map(x => x.id));
  const ids2 = new Set(p2.items.map(x => x.id));
  for (const id of ids1) {
    assert.equal(ids2.has(id), false, `Item ID ${id} duplicated across pages!`);
  }

  // Exact UUID search
  const uuidSearch = (await asActor(admin1, `select public.admin_search_members('${member1}') as r`)).rows[0].r;
  assert.equal(uuidSearch.items.length, 1);
  assert.equal(uuidSearch.items[0].id, member1);

  // Wildcard escaping: search '%_' should not match all
  const wildSearch = (await asActor(admin1, `select public.admin_search_members('%_no_match_%') as r`)).rows[0].r;
  assert.equal(wildSearch.items.length, 0);
});

// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Test Group 5: Carryover Policy Management
// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

await test('Carryover policy: active/future/history, revision conflict and cancellation', async () => {
  // Empty state check
  const initPolicies = (await asActor(admin1, `select public.admin_get_carryover_policies() as r`)).rows[0].r;
  assert.ok(initPolicies.active);
  assert.ok(initPolicies.revision);

  const rev0 = Number(initPolicies.revision);

  // Reject historical or today date
  await assert.rejects(
    asActor(admin1, `select public.admin_schedule_carryover_policy(current_date, false, 'Retro policy')`),
    /CANNOT_MODIFY_HISTORICAL_POLICY/
  );

  // Schedule future policy
  const schedRes = (await asActor(admin1, `select public.admin_schedule_carryover_policy(current_date + 7, false, 'Scheduled maintenance', ${rev0}) as r`)).rows[0].r;
  assert.equal(schedRes.success, true);
  assert.equal(schedRes.is_enabled, false);

  const rev1 = Number(schedRes.revision);
  assert.ok(rev1 > rev0);

  // Revision conflict on stale schedule attempt
  await assert.rejects(
    asActor(admin1, `select public.admin_schedule_carryover_policy(current_date + 8, true, 'Stale write', ${rev0})`),
    /REVISION_CONFLICT/
  );

  // Future policy now appears in future list
  const polList = (await asActor(admin1, `select public.admin_get_carryover_policies() as r`)).rows[0].r;
  assert.equal(polList.future.length, 1);
  assert.equal(polList.future[0].is_enabled, false);

  // Cancel non-future policy is blocked
  await assert.rejects(
    asActor(admin1, `select public.admin_cancel_future_carryover_policy(current_date, 'Cancel today')`),
    /CANNOT_CANCEL_NON_FUTURE_POLICY/
  );

  // Cancel future policy with valid revision
  const cancelRes = (await asActor(admin1, `select public.admin_cancel_future_carryover_policy(current_date + 7, 'No longer needed', ${rev1}) as r`)).rows[0].r;
  assert.equal(cancelRes.success, true);

  // Future list is now empty again
  const afterCancel = (await asActor(admin1, `select public.admin_get_carryover_policies() as r`)).rows[0].r;
  assert.equal(afterCancel.future.length, 0);
});

await test('Credit compensation: safe retry replay, mismatch rejection, bounded delta', async () => {
  const reqId = '88888888-8888-8888-8888-888888888881';
  const prevCredits = (await db.query(`select credits from public.profiles where id = '${member1}'`)).rows[0].credits;

  // 1. Compensate +15 credits
  const c1 = (await asActor(admin1, `select public.admin_compensate_credits('${reqId}', '${member1}', 15, 'Compensation for delay') as r`)).rows[0].r;
  assert.equal(c1.success, true);
  assert.equal(c1.amount, 15);
  assert.equal(c1.new_credits, prevCredits + 15);
  assert.equal(c1.is_replay, false);

  // Verify audit event
  const audit = (await db.query(`select action, new_state from public.admin_action_events where request_id = '${reqId}'`)).rows[0];
  assert.ok(audit);
  assert.equal(audit.action, 'compensate_credits');
  assert.equal(audit.new_state.amount, 15);

  // 2. Exact replay returns original result without adding again
  const c2 = (await asActor(admin1, `select public.admin_compensate_credits('${reqId}', '${member1}', 15, 'Compensation for delay') as r`)).rows[0].r;
  assert.equal(c2.success, true);
  assert.equal(c2.is_replay, true);

  const curCredits = (await db.query(`select credits from public.profiles where id = '${member1}'`)).rows[0].credits;
  assert.equal(curCredits, prevCredits + 15, 'Balance must not increase on replay!');

  // 3. Payload mismatch with same request_id is rejected
  await assert.rejects(
    asActor(admin1, `select public.admin_compensate_credits('${reqId}', '${member1}', 25, 'Different amount')`),
    /REQUEST_ID_PAYLOAD_MISMATCH/
  );

  // 4. Overdraft deduction clamps to 0
  const reqId2 = '88888888-8888-8888-8888-888888888882';
  const c3 = (await asActor(admin1, `select public.admin_compensate_credits('${reqId2}', '${member1}', -9999, 'Clawback overdraft') as r`)).rows[0].r;
  assert.equal(c3.success, true);
  assert.equal(c3.new_credits, 0);
  assert.equal(c3.amount, -curCredits);
});

await test('Warning revocation append-only, consistency across get_unread_warnings and get_campaign_detail', async () => {
  const warningId = '99999999-9999-9999-9999-999999999999';

  // Insert a warning for member2
  await db.exec(`
    insert into public.user_warnings (id, user_id, warning_type, message, warning_date, created_at, acknowledged)
    values ('${warningId}', '${member2}', 'tester_rejection_streak', 'Test warning message', current_date, now(), false);
  `);

  // Unread warnings returns it for member2
  const unreadBefore = (await asActor(member2, `select * from public.get_unread_warnings()`)).rows;
  assert.equal(unreadBefore.length, 1);
  assert.equal(unreadBefore[0].id, warningId);

  // Campaign detail includes warning in unread and weekly_warnings_count
  const campBefore = (await asActor(member2, `select public.get_campaign_detail('${testCampaign}') as r`)).rows[0].r;
  assert.equal(campBefore.unread_warnings.length, 1);
  assert.equal(campBefore.weekly_warnings_count, 1);

  // Revoke warning as admin
  const revRes = (await asActor(admin1, `select public.admin_revoke_warning('${warningId}', 'Revoked due to app crash') as r`)).rows[0].r;
  assert.equal(revRes.success, true);
  assert.equal(revRes.revoked, true);

  // Revoke again idempotently
  const reRev = (await asActor(admin1, `select public.admin_revoke_warning('${warningId}', 'Duplicate revoke') as r`)).rows[0].r;
  assert.equal(reRev.success, true);
  assert.equal(reRev.already_revoked, true);

  // Original warning still persists in table (append-only)
  const warnCheck = (await db.query(`select 1 from public.user_warnings where id = '${warningId}'`)).rows;
  assert.equal(warnCheck.length, 1);

  // get_unread_warnings now EXCLUDES revoked warning
  const unreadAfter = (await asActor(member2, `select * from public.get_unread_warnings()`)).rows;
  assert.equal(unreadAfter.length, 0);

  // Campaign detail now EXCLUDES revoked warning from weekly_warnings_count and unread
  const campAfter = (await asActor(member2, `select public.get_campaign_detail('${testCampaign}') as r`)).rows[0].r;
  assert.equal(campAfter.unread_warnings.length, 0);
  assert.equal(campAfter.weekly_warnings_count, 0);

  // Admin warning list shows is_revoked = true with revocation details
  const adminWarnList = (await asActor(admin1, `select public.admin_get_member_warnings('${member2}') as r`)).rows[0].r;
  assert.equal(adminWarnList.items.length, 1);
  assert.equal(adminWarnList.items[0].is_revoked, true);
  assert.ok(adminWarnList.items[0].revocation);
  assert.equal(adminWarnList.items[0].revocation.reason, 'Revoked due to app crash');
});

## 3. Database Schema and Architecture

### 3.1 Tables Added in Staged 072
1. `public.notification_campaigns`:
   - Stores draft, queued, sending, completed, and cancelled campaigns.
   - Enforces content lengths (`title_vi/en`: 1..200 chars; `body_vi/en`: 1..2000 chars), valid locales (`vi`, `en`, `bilingual`), audience types (`all`, `role`, `selected_users`), and optimistic locking via `revision`.
   - Stores immutable administrative attribution (`created_by`, `cancelled_by`, `cancel_reason`, timestamps).
2. `public.notification_campaign_recipients`:
   - Deterministic recipient snapshot populated at scheduling / send-now.
   - Unique constraint `(campaign_id, user_id)` ensures idempotent fanout.
   - Foreign key to `public.notifications(id) ON DELETE SET NULL` preserves delivery receipts even if individual notification rows are deleted by users.
3. `public.notification_campaign_requests`:
   - Mutation idempotency ledger storing `request_id`, `admin_id`, `action`, `payload_hash`, and cached `response_json`.
   - Replayed requests return previous outcome with `"replayed": true` and do not emit duplicate audit events.
   - Mismatched payloads fail with `REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT`.
4. `public.notification_campaign_events`:
   - Append-only audit trail logging all lifecycle actions (`created`, `updated`, `scheduled`, `send_now_requested`, `cancelled`, `worker_started`, `worker_completed`).
5. `public.notification_worker_heartbeats`:
   - Records execution metrics and timestamp for scheduler health monitoring.

### 3.2 Security and RLS
- All new tables have Row Level Security enabled.
- All direct privileges (`SELECT`, `INSERT`, `UPDATE`, `DELETE`) on campaign tables are revoked from `PUBLIC`, `anon`, and `authenticated`.

## 2. Tóm tắt 8 nhóm chức năng backend đã hoàn thiện

### Nhóm 1: Helper kiểm tra Quản trị viên & Nhật ký kiểm toán thao tác (`admin_action_events`)
- **`public.assert_unlocked_admin(p_required_capability)`**: Helper dùng chung kiểm tra `auth.uid() IS NOT NULL`, `role = 'admin'` và `is_locked = false`. Nếu truyền `p_required_capability`, kiểm tra quyền hạn tương ứng trong bảng `admin_capabilities`.
- **`public.admin_action_events`**: Bảng append-only ghi nhận: `actor_id`, `action`, `target_type`, `target_id`, `reason`, `old_state`, `new_state`, `request_id`, `created_at`.
- **`public.admin_get_action_events`**: RPC đọc nhật ký kiểm toán có phân trang keyset `(created_at DESC, id DESC)`, lọc theo `action`, `target_type`, `actor_id`. Chặn client spoofing thông qua RLS và revoke quyền ghi từ client.

### Nhóm 2: Tìm kiếm thành viên phía Server & Hồ sơ tổng quan
- **`public.admin_search_members`**: Tìm kiếm trên toàn bộ cơ sở dữ liệu (vượt qua giới hạn 500 hồ sơ cũ) theo tên, email, UUID; lọc vai trò (`member`, `moderator`, `admin`) và trạng thái khóa; phân trang keyset ổn định `(created_at, id)` và giới hạn 1..100; escape ký tự đại diện (`%`, `_`, `\`).
- **`public.admin_get_member_overview`**: Gom chiến dịch (`total`, `open`), slot (`total`, `active`), cảnh báo (`active`, `revoked`), và số lượng báo cáo (`tester_reports`, `contact_reports`).
- **`public.admin_get_member_credit_history`**: Lịch sử credit có phân trang con trỏ keyset.
- **`public.admin_get_member_daily_tasks`**: Lấy lịch sử và giải thích chi tiết trạng thái nhiệm vụ ngày qua hàm nội bộ `get_daily_task_status`, bảo toàn dữ liệu snapshot bất biến đã chốt và chỉ rõ ngày chưa chốt hoặc `incomplete_history`.

### Nhóm 3: Quản lý chính sách cộng dồn nhiệm vụ (`carryover`)
- **`public.admin_get_carryover_policies`**: Đọc chính sách active (hỗ trợ trạng thái rỗng mặc định `default_active`), danh sách tương lai (`future`), lịch sử (`history`) và `revision`.
- **`public.admin_schedule_carryover_policy`**: Wrapper kiểm tra admin, lock ghi đồng thời, kiểm tra `expected_revision`, chỉ cho phép lên lịch ngày tương lai (`> VN today`), gọi hàm nội bộ và ghi nhật ký kiểm toán.
- **`public.admin_cancel_future_carryover_policy`**: Hủy lịch tương lai với lý do rõ ràng, ghi nhận lịch sử hủy vào cả `daily_task_carryover_policy_audit` và `admin_action_events`.

### Nhóm 4: Quản lý chiến dịch tập trung & Hàng đợi báo cáo tester
- **`public.admin_search_campaigns`**: Tìm kiếm chiến dịch mọi trạng thái (`open`, `paused`, `completed`, v.v.) theo tên app, package, UUID, chủ app; join tên/email chủ app và số lượng báo cáo chờ.
- **`public.admin_get_tester_reports_queue`**: Hàng đợi duyệt báo cáo tester toàn hệ thống gom từ nhiều chiến dịch với bộ lọc `status`, `campaign_id`, `tester_id`, `owner_id`, `submission_context`; join thông tin hiển thị của chiến dịch, chủ app và tester. Các RPC duyệt/từ chối hiện có vẫn là nguồn kiểm soát vòng đời thẩm quyền.

### Nhóm 5: Bồi hoàn Credit an toàn & Chống xử lý lặp
- **`public.admin_compensate_credits`**:
  - Nhận UUID `request_id`, `target_user_id`, `amount`, `reason`, cùng liên kết tùy chọn tới `original_credit_log_id` hoặc `contact_report_id`.
  - Bảng quản lý yêu cầu `public.admin_operation_requests` phạm vi `(actor_id, operation, id)`.
  - Khóa hàng và khóa giao dịch chống race condition.
  - Tái sử dụng `admin_adjust_credits` để tính toán số dư thực tế (effective delta), không sửa trực tiếp sổ cái quá khứ.
  - Gửi lại cùng `request_id` và payload: trả về kết quả ban đầu kèm `"is_replay": true`.
  - Gửi lại cùng `request_id` nhưng khác payload: từ chối với lỗi `REQUEST_ID_PAYLOAD_MISMATCH`.

### Nhóm 6: Phân quyền vai trò & Bảo vệ Quản trị viên cuối cùng
- **`public.admin_get_my_capabilities`**: Trả về quyền hạn của admin đang đăng nhập (`can_manage_admins`, `can_manage_moderators`).
- **`public.admin_set_user_role`**:
  - Quản lý vai trò `member`, `moderator` thông qua admin chưa bị khóa.
  - Bổ nhiệm hoặc hạ quyền `admin` chỉ cho phép khi người gọi sở hữu capability `admin_management` (quản lý bootstrap qua `bootstrap_admin_capability`).
  - Chặn người dùng tự thay đổi vai trò hoặc tự leo thang quyền hạn (`CANNOT_CHANGE_OWN_ROLE`).
  - Bảo vệ Quản trị viên chưa bị khóa cuối cùng trong hệ thống dưới điều kiện đồng thời (`CANNOT_REMOVE_LAST_ADMIN`).
  - Không dùng thay đổi vai trò để xóa phạt quá khứ.

### Nhóm 7: Xử lý & Thu hồi cảnh báo (Warning Revocation & Consistency)
- **`public.user_warning_revocations`**: Bảng append-only lưu các sự kiện thu hồi cảnh báo (không xóa dòng cảnh báo gốc).
- **`public.admin_revoke_warning`**: Thu hồi cảnh báo idempotent kèm lý do, request ID và kiểm toán.
- **`public.admin_get_member_warnings`**: Đọc danh sách cảnh báo kèm trạng thái `is_revoked` và chi tiết thu hồi.
- **Cập nhật đồng bộ toàn bộ hàm đếm cảnh báo hiệu lực**:
  - `public.get_unread_warnings()`: Loại trừ các cảnh báo đã bị thu hồi.
  - `public.get_campaign_detail()`: Loại trừ các cảnh báo đã bị thu hồi khỏi `unread_warnings` và `weekly_warnings_count`.
  - `public.reject_tester_report()`: Loại trừ cảnh báo đã bị thu hồi khỏi ngưỡng tính khóa tài khoản theo tuần và streak từ chối trong ngày.
  - Mở khóa tài khoản là thao tác riêng biệt (`admin_set_user_lock`), không tự ý xóa lịch sử phạt nhiệm vụ ngày đã chốt.

### Nhóm 8: Giám sát vận hành thời gian thực & Retry chi trả nhiệm vụ
- **`public.admin_get_system_monitor_summary`**: Dữ liệu thực từ database tổng hợp số lượng thành viên (tổng, khóa, admin, mod), chiến dịch (mở, tạm dừng, hoàn tất), báo cáo tester (chờ, duyệt, từ chối), báo cáo khiếu nại liên hệ, hàng đợi công việc chi trả (`mission_settlement_jobs`), và lần dọn dẹp storage gần nhất (`cleanup_runs`). Không tạo dữ liệu giả trên thiết bị, không gọi trực tiếp GCS.
- **`public.admin_get_job_runs_queue`**: Hàng đợi công việc nền có phân trang (`mission_settlement` hoặc `cleanup`).
- **`public.admin_retry_mission_settlement_jobs`**: Wrapper retry công việc chi trả theo ID hoặc theo lô giới hạn (tối đa 50) có kiểm tra quyền admin, audit và request ID.

- **`public.admin_search_campaigns`**: Tìm kiếm chiến dịch mọi trạng thái (`open`, `paused`, `completed`, v.v.) theo tên app, package, UUID, chủ app; join tên/email chủ app và số lượng báo cáo chờ.
- **`public.admin_get_tester_reports_queue`**: Hàng đợi duyệt báo cáo tester toàn hệ thống gom từ nhiều chiến dịch với bộ lọc `status`, `campaign_id`, `tester_id`, `owner_id`, `submission_context`; join thông tin hiển thị của chiến dịch, chủ app và tester. Các RPC duyệt/từ chối hiện có vẫn là nguồn kiểm soát vòng đời thẩm quyền.

### Nhóm 5: Bồi hoàn Credit an toàn & Chống xử lý lặp
- **`public.admin_compensate_credits`**:
  - Nhận UUID `request_id`, `target_user_id`, `amount`, `reason`, cùng liên kết tùy chọn tới `original_credit_log_id` hoặc `contact_report_id`.
  - Bảng quản lý yêu cầu `public.admin_operation_requests` phạm vi `(actor_id, operation, id)`.
  - Khóa hàng và khóa giao dịch chống race condition.
  - Tái sử dụng `admin_adjust_credits` để tính toán số dư thực tế (effective delta), không sửa trực tiếp sổ cái quá khứ.
  - Gửi lại cùng `request_id` và payload: trả về kết quả ban đầu kèm `"is_replay": true`.
  - Gửi lại cùng `request_id` nhưng khác payload: từ chối với lỗi `REQUEST_ID_PAYLOAD_MISMATCH`.

### Nhóm 6: Phân quyền vai trò & Bảo vệ Quản trị viên cuối cùng
- **`public.admin_get_my_capabilities`**: Trả về quyền hạn của admin đang đăng nhập (`can_manage_admins`, `can_manage_moderators`).
- **`public.admin_set_user_role`**:
  - Quản lý vai trò `member`, `moderator` thông qua admin chưa bị khóa.
  - Bổ nhiệm hoặc hạ quyền `admin` chỉ cho phép khi người gọi sở hữu capability `admin_management` (quản lý bootstrap qua `bootstrap_admin_capability`).
  - Chặn người dùng tự thay đổi vai trò hoặc tự leo thang quyền hạn (`CANNOT_CHANGE_OWN_ROLE`).
  - Bảo vệ Quản trị viên chưa bị khóa cuối cùng trong hệ thống dưới điều kiện đồng thời (`CANNOT_REMOVE_LAST_ADMIN`).
  - Không dùng thay đổi vai trò để xóa phạt quá khứ.

### Nhóm 7: Xử lý & Thu hồi cảnh báo (Warning Revocation & Consistency)
- **`public.user_warning_revocations`**: Bảng append-only lưu các sự kiện thu hồi cảnh báo (không xóa dòng cảnh báo gốc).
- **`public.admin_revoke_warning`**: Thu hồi cảnh báo idempotent kèm lý do, request ID và kiểm toán.
- **`public.admin_get_member_warnings`**: Đọc danh sách cảnh báo kèm trạng thái `is_revoked` và chi tiết thu hồi.
- **Cập nhật đồng bộ toàn bộ hàm đếm cảnh báo hiệu lực**:
  - `public.get_unread_warnings()`: Loại trừ các cảnh báo đã bị thu hồi.
  - `public.get_campaign_detail()`: Loại trừ các cảnh báo đã bị thu hồi khỏi `unread_warnings` và `weekly_warnings_count`.
  - `public.reject_tester_report()`: Loại trừ cảnh báo đã bị thu hồi khỏi ngưỡng tính khóa tài khoản theo tuần và streak từ chối trong ngày.
  - Mở khóa tài khoản là thao tác riêng biệt (`admin_set_user_lock`), không tự ý xóa lịch sử phạt nhiệm vụ ngày đã chốt.

### Nhóm 8: Giám sát vận hành thời gian thực & Retry chi trả nhiệm vụ
- **`public.admin_get_system_monitor_summary`**: Dữ liệu thực từ database tổng hợp số lượng thành viên (tổng, khóa, admin, mod), chiến dịch (mở, tạm dừng, hoàn tất), báo cáo tester (chờ, duyệt, từ chối), báo cáo khiếu nại liên hệ, hàng đợi công việc chi trả (`mission_settlement_jobs`), và lần dọn dẹp storage gần nhất (`cleanup_runs`). Không tạo dữ liệu giả trên thiết bị, không gọi trực tiếp GCS.
- **`public.admin_get_job_runs_queue`**: Hàng đợi công việc nền có phân trang (`mission_settlement` hoặc `cleanup`).
- **`public.admin_retry_mission_settlement_jobs`**: Wrapper retry công việc chi trả theo ID hoặc theo lô giới hạn (tối đa 50) có kiểm tra quyền admin, audit và request ID.

3: The first migration070 is still under author testing; these are independent observations against the current source. Read independent-core-probe-results.json and log. Fix production behavior, add regressions and update API contract/Android gaps as necessary.
4: 
5: 1. **Confirmed: cancelled carryover policy rolls back with NOT NULL error.** `admin_cancel_future_carryover_policy` inserts NULL into existing `daily_task_carryover_policy_audit.new_is_enabled NOT NULL`. Independent probe schedules tomorrow then cancellation fails. Preserve cancellation audit without violating schema; don't silently delete audit or omit revision advance. Contract currently has no actual paginated eventhistory of cancellation and returns all policy rows unbounded; add bounded future/history pagination/read API and cancellation events visible to admins. Keep existing getter compatible for Android, add pageAPI rather than breaking callers.
6: 2. **Confirmed: revoked warning remains on Home dashboard.** `get_campaign_detail` shows0 but `get_my_dashboard(false)` still returns weekly_warnings_count1 and unread_warnings length1 after revoke. Update the effective dashboard consumer too, not only get_unread_warnings/get_campaign_detail/reject. Check ALL active warning readers. Keep dashboard's full DTO/logic unchanged except exclusion. Independent probe reproduces.
7: 3. **Confirmed: old admin adjustment writes zero common audit events.** admin_adjust_credits still bypasses admin_action_events. Original credit dialog remains old API unless Android switches it. Scope requires audit old/admin mutations as well: lock/unlock, adjust, notification, update appconfig, homecycle, daily ratio changes, campaign moderation and support actions. Add appropriate backend audit, avoid duplicate intent events if compensation wrapsadjust. Keep signatures/grants/069 hardening and popup behavior; tests should use old exposed API. Log cannot manufacture request IDs or actor for historical records.
8: 4. **Request ID consistency:** current carryover schedule/cancel/revoke accept requestID but do not register/replay it; role accepts optionalnull; retryjob checks requests without serialized requestIDlock before reading. Introduce consistent replay/mismatch semantics for important writes, especially retryjob schedule/cancel. A retry of an unchanged successful request must work with originalexpectedrevision (replay check BEFORE newCASvalidation, while auth still checked first). Payloadhash should use canonical jsonb, not ambiguous colon-concatenated arbitrary strings. No requestIDreuse for differentwarning intent.
9: 5. **Role capability lifecycle review:** old admin_set_user_lock is not coordinated with admin_set_user_role's advisorylock; callers may passguard then be locked/demoted by another transaction. Protect last unlocked admin across BOTH role and lock mutation paths and ensure privilege-check data are locked/revalidated appropriately. Capabilities must not persist as dormant admin_management through demotion then later unrelated promotion; revoke capabilities on demotion and test. No widening make_user_admin grants.
10: 6. **Member detail contract missing real slot data.** admin_get_member_overview only returns slots counts, not slotnumbers/expires/associatedcampaigns required for useful memberdetail. Add bounded adminmember slotslist RPC or bounded overviewarray (max6slots). Campaigns can be queried by owner using admin_search_campaigns. Update contract so Android doesn't fake details from counts.
11: 7. **Audit data bounds:** validate reason lengths, cursor pair completeness (time/id), allowed status/context filters, finite dates and limits. get_carryover_policies currently all history/futureunbounded. Existing typeofnull audit priorcancel defect must test underactualschema, don't relaxschema invariants without deliberate compatible design.
12: 
13: The get_campaign_detail DTO regression was already corrected by author before the current independent probe; its rootkeys now match069. Preserve nested shapes and eligibility/claims logic as well.
14: 
15: Keep modifications restricted to owned backendfiles. Android session is concurrently implementing published API; document additive APIchanges and any unavoidable signaturechanges to android-backend-gaps.md or corehandover. No need to wait Android to fix known backendissues.

-- Migration 072: Admin Notification Campaigns Backend & Batch Fanout Worker
--
-- Features:
-- 1. Campaign schema: title_vi/en, body_vi/en, default_locale, audience (all/role/selected_users)
-- 2. Recipient snapshot taken deterministically at schedule / send-now
-- 3. Optimistic concurrency control (CAS) via campaign revision

    id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    title_vi text NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(title_vi)) >= 1 AND length(title_vi) <= 200),
    title_en text NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(title_en)) >= 1 AND length(title_en) <= 200),
    body_vi text NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(body_vi)) >= 1 AND length(body_vi) <= 2000),
    body_en text NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(body_en)) >= 1 AND length(body_en) <= 2000),
    default_locale text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'vi' CHECK (default_locale IN ('vi', 'en', 'bilingual')),
    audience_type text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'all' CHECK (audience_type IN ('all', 'role', 'selected_users')),
    target_role text CHECK (target_role IS NULL OR target_role IN ('member', 'moderator', 'admin')),
    selected_user_ids uuid[] DEFAULT '{}'::uuid[],
    status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'queued', 'sending', 'completed', 'cancelled', 'failed')),

    total_recipients integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (total_recipients >= 0),
    sent_count integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (sent_count >= 0),

    started_at timestamptz,
    completed_at timestamptz,
    cancelled_at timestamptz,
    cancelled_by uuid REFERENCES public.profiles(id),
    cancel_reason text,

);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_notif_campaigns_created_by

-- Migration 072: Admin Notification Campaigns Backend & Batch Fanout Worker
--
-- Features:
-- 1. Campaign schema: title_vi/en, body_vi/en, default_locale, audience (all/role/selected_users)
-- 2. Recipient snapshot taken deterministically at schedule / send-now (frozen flag protects zero-recipient audiences)
-- 3. Optimistic concurrency control (CAS) via campaign revision
-- 4. Idempotency ledger for mutations: canonical JSON payload hashing, request-scoped advisory locking, actor validation
-- 5. Atomic batch fanout worker using SKIP LOCKED; per-campaign/user unique receipts
-- 6. No popup states for mass broadcasts (preserves 067/069 direct popup flow)
-- 7. Stable sent counts even if user deletes notifications; live read count based on notifications.is_read
-- 8. Service-only batch worker + admin-guarded bounded manual trigger
-- 9. Keyset cursor pagination for campaigns and recipient delivery results with malformed/infinity protection
-- 10. Conditional pg_cron registration with safe fallback & scheduler readiness reporting
-- ============================================================================

BEGIN;

-- ============================================================================
-- 1. NOTIFICATION CAMPAIGNS CORE TABLES
-- ============================================================================

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.notification_campaigns (
    id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    title_vi text NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(title_vi)) >= 1 AND length(title_vi) <= 200),
    title_en text NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(title_en)) >= 1 AND length(title_en) <= 200),
    body_vi text NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(body_vi)) >= 1 AND length(body_vi) <= 2000),
    body_en text NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(body_en)) >= 1 AND length(body_en) <= 2000),
    default_locale text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'vi' CHECK (default_locale IN ('vi', 'en', 'bilingual')),
    audience_type text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'all' CHECK (audience_type IN ('all', 'role', 'selected_users')),
    target_role text CHECK (target_role IS NULL OR target_role IN ('member', 'moderator', 'admin')),
    selected_user_ids uuid[] DEFAULT '{}'::uuid[],
    status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'queued', 'sending', 'completed', 'cancelled', 'failed')),
    revision integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (revision >= 1),
    total_recipients integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (total_recipients >= 0),
    recipient_snapshot_taken boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    snapshot_taken_at timestamptz,
    sent_count integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (sent_count >= 0),
    failed_count integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (failed_count >= 0),
    scheduled_for timestamptz,
    started_at timestamptz,
    completed_at timestamptz,
    cancelled_at timestamptz,
    cancelled_by uuid REFERENCES public.profiles(id),
    cancel_reason text,
    created_by uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.profiles(id),
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(),
    updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(),
    CONSTRAINT chk_audience_role CHECK (
        (audience_type = 'role' AND target_role IS NOT NULL) OR
        (audience_type <> 'role' AND target_role IS NULL)
    ),
    CONSTRAINT chk_audience_selected CHECK (
        (audience_type = 'selected_users' AND cardinality(selected_user_ids) > 0 AND cardinality(selected_user_ids) <= 1000) OR
        (audience_type <> 'selected_users' AND (selected_user_ids IS NULL OR cardinality(selected_user_ids) = 0))
    )
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_notif_campaigns_status_sched
    ON public.notification_campaigns (status, scheduled_for ASC);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_notif_campaigns_created_cursor
    ON public.notification_campaigns (created_at DESC, id DESC);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_notif_campaigns_created_by
    ON public.notification_campaigns (created_by);

ALTER TABLE public.notification_campaigns ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public.notification_campaigns NO FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
REVOKE ALL ON TABLE public.notification_campaigns FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON TABLE public.notification_campaigns TO service_role;

-- 2. NOTIFICATION CAMPAIGN RECIPIENTS (Deterministic snapshot & delivery receipts)

    id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    campaign_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.notification_campaigns(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,

    sent_at timestamptz,

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_notif_recipients_camp_status
    ON public.notification_campaign_recipients (campaign_id, status);

    ON public.notification_campaign_recipients (user_id);

    ON public.notification_campaign_recipients (notification_id);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_notif_recipients_cursor
    ON public.notification_campaign_recipients (campaign_id, created_at ASC, id ASC);

ALTER TABLE public.notification_campaign_recipients ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public.notification_campaign_recipients NO FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
REVOKE ALL ON TABLE public.notification_campaign_recipients FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON TABLE public.notification_campaign_recipients TO service_role;


-- ============================================================================
-- 3. NOTIFICATION CAMPAIGN REQUESTS (Mutation Idempotency & Replay Ledger)
-- ============================================================================

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.notification_campaign_requests (
    request_id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
    admin_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.profiles(id),
    action text NOT NULL,
    campaign_id uuid REFERENCES public.notification_campaigns(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    payload_hash text NOT NULL,
    response_json jsonb NOT NULL,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_notif_requests_actor
    ON public.notification_campaign_requests (admin_id, action);

ALTER TABLE public.notification_campaign_requests ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public.notification_campaign_requests NO FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
REVOKE ALL ON TABLE public.notification_campaign_requests FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON TABLE public.notification_campaign_requests TO service_role;


-- ============================================================================
-- 4. NOTIFICATION CAMPAIGN EVENTS (Append-only Audit Log)
-- ============================================================================

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.notification_campaign_events (
    id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    campaign_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.notification_campaigns(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    admin_id uuid REFERENCES public.profiles(id),
    action text NOT NULL,
    reason text,
    details jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp()

    ON public.notification_campaign_events (campaign_id, created_at DESC);

REVOKE ALL ON TABLE public.notification_campaign_events FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON TABLE public.notification_campaign_events TO service_role;


-- ============================================================================
-- 5. WORKER EXECUTION MARKERS
-- ============================================================================

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.notification_worker_heartbeats (
    worker_key text PRIMARY KEY,
    last_run_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(),
    campaigns_processed integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    notifications_sent integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'idle'
);

ALTER TABLE public.notification_worker_heartbeats ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public.notification_worker_heartbeats NO FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
REVOKE ALL ON TABLE public.notification_worker_heartbeats FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON TABLE public.notification_worker_heartbeats TO service_role;


-- ============================================================================
-- 6. INTERNAL HELPER FUNCTIONS (Service/Definer only, private execution)
-- ============================================================================

-- Compute delivered title and message according to default_locale
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._notif_resolve_delivered_content(
    p_title_vi text,
    p_title_en text,
    p_body_vi text,
    p_body_en text,
    p_locale text,
    OUT delivered_title text,
    OUT delivered_message text
)
LANGUAGE plpgsql
IMMUTABLE
AS $$
BEGIN
    IF p_locale = 'en' THEN
        delivered_title := COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p_title_en), ''), p_title_vi);
        delivered_message := COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p_body_en), ''), p_body_vi);
    ELSIF p_locale = 'bilingual' THEN
        delivered_title := TRIM(p_title_vi) || ' / ' || TRIM(p_title_en);
        delivered_message := TRIM(p_body_vi) || E'\n\n---\n\n' || TRIM(p_body_en);
    ELSE -- 'vi' or fallback
        delivered_title := COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p_title_vi), ''), p_title_en);
        delivered_message := COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p_body_vi), ''), p_body_en);
    END IF;
END;
$$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public._notif_resolve_delivered_content(text, text, text, text, text) FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public._notif_resolve_delivered_content(text, text, text, text, text) TO service_role;

-- Format campaign row into consistent JSON DTO
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._notif_campaign_to_jsonb(
    p_camp public.notification_campaigns
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
STABLE
AS $$
DECLARE
    v_live_read_count bigint;
BEGIN
    SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_live_read_count
    FROM public.notification_campaign_recipients r
    JOIN public.notifications n ON n.id = r.notification_id
    WHERE r.campaign_id = p_camp.id AND n.is_read = true;

    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
        'id', p_camp.id,
        'title_vi', p_camp.title_vi,
        'title_en', p_camp.title_en,
        'body_vi', p_camp.body_vi,
        'body_en', p_camp.body_en,
        'default_locale', p_camp.default_locale,
        'audience_type', p_camp.audience_type,
        'target_role', p_camp.target_role,
        'selected_user_ids', to_jsonb(COALESCE(p_camp.selected_user_ids, '{}'::uuid[])),
        'status', p_camp.status,
        'revision', p_camp.revision,
        'total_recipients', p_camp.total_recipients,
        'recipient_snapshot_taken', p_camp.recipient_snapshot_taken,
        'snapshot_taken_at', CASE WHEN p_camp.snapshot_taken_at IS NOT NULL THEN to_char(p_camp.snapshot_taken_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') ELSE NULL END,
        'sent_count', p_camp.sent_count,
        'read_count', COALESCE(v_live_read_count, 0),
        'failed_count', p_camp.failed_count,
        'scheduled_for', CASE WHEN p_camp.scheduled_for IS NOT NULL THEN to_char(p_camp.scheduled_for AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') ELSE NULL END,
        'started_at', CASE WHEN p_camp.started_at IS NOT NULL THEN to_char(p_camp.started_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') ELSE NULL END,
        'completed_at', CASE WHEN p_camp.completed_at IS NOT NULL THEN to_char(p_camp.completed_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') ELSE NULL END,
        'cancelled_at', CASE WHEN p_camp.cancelled_at IS NOT NULL THEN to_char(p_camp.cancelled_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') ELSE NULL END,
        'cancelled_by', p_camp.cancelled_by,
        'cancel_reason', p_camp.cancel_reason,
        'created_by', p_camp.created_by,
        'created_at', to_char(p_camp.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"'),
        'updated_at', to_char(p_camp.updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"')
    );
END;
$$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public._notif_campaign_to_jsonb(public.notification_campaigns) FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public._notif_campaign_to_jsonb(public.notification_campaigns) TO service_role;

-- Take deterministic recipient snapshot and freeze it
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._notif_snapshot_recipients(
    p_campaign_id uuid
)
RETURNS integer
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $$
DECLARE
    v_camp public.notification_campaigns;
    v_count integer := 0;
BEGIN
    SELECT * INTO v_camp
    FROM public.notification_campaigns
    WHERE id = p_campaign_id
    FOR UPDATE;

    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'CAMPAIGN_NOT_FOUND';
    END IF;

    -- Delete any un-sent recipients if re-snapshotting pending draft/queued
    DELETE FROM public.notification_campaign_recipients
    WHERE campaign_id = p_campaign_id AND status = 'pending';

    IF v_camp.audience_type = 'all' THEN
        INSERT INTO public.notification_campaign_recipients (campaign_id, user_id, status)
        SELECT v_camp.id, p.id, 'pending'
        FROM public.profiles p
        ORDER BY p.id ASC
        ON CONFLICT (campaign_id, user_id) DO NOTHING;

    ELSIF v_camp.audience_type = 'role' THEN
        INSERT INTO public.notification_campaign_recipients (campaign_id, user_id, status)
        SELECT v_camp.id, p.id, 'pending'
        FROM public.profiles p
        WHERE p.role = v_camp.target_role
        ORDER BY p.id ASC
        ON CONFLICT (campaign_id, user_id) DO NOTHING;

    ELSIF v_camp.audience_type = 'selected_users' THEN
        INSERT INTO public.notification_campaign_recipients (campaign_id, user_id, status)
        SELECT v_camp.id, u.user_id, 'pending'
        FROM (SELECT DISTINCT unnest(v_camp.selected_user_ids) AS user_id) u
        JOIN public.profiles p ON p.id = u.user_id
        ORDER BY u.user_id ASC
        ON CONFLICT (campaign_id, user_id) DO NOTHING;
    END IF;

    SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_count
    FROM public.notification_campaign_recipients
    WHERE campaign_id = p_campaign_id;

    UPDATE public.notification_campaigns
    SET total_recipients = v_count,
        recipient_snapshot_taken = true,
        snapshot_taken_at = clock_timestamp(),
        updated_at = clock_timestamp()
    WHERE id = p_campaign_id;

    RETURN v_count;
END;
$$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public._notif_snapshot_recipients(uuid) FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public._notif_snapshot_recipients(uuid) TO service_role;


-- ============================================================================
-- 7. ADMIN RPC: ADMIN_CREATE_NOTIFICATION_CAMPAIGN
-- ============================================================================

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_create_notification_campaign(
    p_request_id uuid,
    p_title_vi text,
    p_title_en text,
    p_body_vi text,
    p_body_en text,
    p_default_locale text DEFAULT 'vi',
    p_audience_type text DEFAULT 'all',
    p_target_role text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_selected_user_ids uuid[] DEFAULT NULL,
    p_reason text DEFAULT NULL
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $$
DECLARE
    v_admin_id uuid;
    v_payload_hash text;
    v_existing_req public.notification_campaign_requests;
    v_new_campaign public.notification_campaigns;
    v_clean_selected uuid[] := '{}';
    v_missing_count integer;
    v_response jsonb;
BEGIN
    v_admin_id := public._assert_daily_task_admin();

    IF p_request_id IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_REQUEST_ID';
    END IF;

    -- Clean selected user IDs
    IF p_selected_user_ids IS NOT NULL AND cardinality(p_selected_user_ids) > 0 THEN
        SELECT array_agg(DISTINCT u ORDER BY u) INTO v_clean_selected
        FROM unnest(p_selected_user_ids) AS u
        WHERE u IS NOT NULL;
    END IF;

    -- Canonical JSON payload hash eliminates delimiter collisions
    v_payload_hash := md5(jsonb_build_object(
        'action', 'create',
        'title_vi', TRIM(COALESCE(p_title_vi, '')),
        'title_en', TRIM(COALESCE(p_title_en, '')),
        'body_vi', TRIM(COALESCE(p_body_vi, '')),
        'body_en', TRIM(COALESCE(p_body_en, '')),
        'default_locale', COALESCE(p_default_locale, 'vi'),
        'audience_type', COALESCE(p_audience_type, 'all'),
        'target_role', p_target_role,
        'selected_user_ids', to_jsonb(COALESCE(v_clean_selected, '{}'::uuid[])),
        'reason', NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(p_reason, '')), '')
    )::text);

    -- Request-scoped advisory lock prevents concurrency race on identical request_id
    PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext('notif_req:' || p_request_id::text));

    -- Check idempotency
    SELECT * INTO v_existing_req
    FROM public.notification_campaign_requests
    WHERE request_id = p_request_id;

    IF v_existing_req.request_id IS NOT NULL THEN
        IF v_existing_req.admin_id <> v_admin_id THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT: Request ID already claimed by another administrator';
        END IF;
        IF v_existing_req.payload_hash <> v_payload_hash OR v_existing_req.action <> 'create' THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT: Request ID already used with different payload';
        END IF;
        RETURN v_existing_req.response_json || jsonb_build_object('replayed', true);
    END IF;

    -- Validate string bounds
    IF p_title_vi IS NULL OR TRIM(p_title_vi) = '' OR length(p_title_vi) > 200 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_TITLE_VI: Title must be between 1 and 200 characters';
    END IF;
    IF p_title_en IS NULL OR TRIM(p_title_en) = '' OR length(p_title_en) > 200 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_TITLE_EN: Title must be between 1 and 200 characters';
    END IF;
    IF p_body_vi IS NULL OR TRIM(p_body_vi) = '' OR length(p_body_vi) > 2000 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_BODY_VI: Body must be between 1 and 2000 characters';
    END IF;
    IF p_body_en IS NULL OR TRIM(p_body_en) = '' OR length(p_body_en) > 2000 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_BODY_EN: Body must be between 1 and 2000 characters';
    END IF;

    IF p_default_locale NOT IN ('vi', 'en', 'bilingual') THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_LOCALE: default_locale must be vi, en, or bilingual';
    END IF;

    IF p_audience_type NOT IN ('all', 'role', 'selected_users') THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_AUDIENCE_TYPE';
    END IF;

    IF p_audience_type = 'role' THEN
        IF p_target_role IS NULL OR p_target_role NOT IN ('member', 'moderator', 'admin') THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_TARGET_ROLE: Must specify valid role for role audience';
        END IF;
        v_clean_selected := '{}';
    ELSIF p_audience_type = 'selected_users' THEN
        p_target_role := NULL;
        IF v_clean_selected IS NULL OR cardinality(v_clean_selected) = 0 THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'EMPTY_SELECTED_USERS: At least one user ID required';
        END IF;
        IF cardinality(v_clean_selected) > 1000 THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'TOO_MANY_SELECTED_USERS: Maximum 1000 users allowed';
        END IF;

        -- Verify all selected users exist
        SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_missing_count
        FROM unnest(v_clean_selected) AS u
        WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles WHERE id = u);

        IF v_missing_count > 0 THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_RECIPIENT_USER: One or more selected user IDs do not exist';
        END IF;
    ELSE
        p_target_role := NULL;
        v_clean_selected := '{}';
    END IF;

    INSERT INTO public.notification_campaigns (
        title_vi,
        title_en,
        body_vi,
        body_en,
        default_locale,
        audience_type,
        target_role,
        selected_user_ids,
        status,
        revision,
        created_by
    ) VALUES (
        TRIM(p_title_vi),
        TRIM(p_title_en),
        TRIM(p_body_vi),
        TRIM(p_body_en),
        p_default_locale,
        p_audience_type,
        p_target_role,
        v_clean_selected,
        'draft',
        1,
        v_admin_id
    ) RETURNING * INTO v_new_campaign;

    -- Append audit event
    INSERT INTO public.notification_campaign_events (
        campaign_id,
        admin_id,
        action,
        reason,
        details
    ) VALUES (
        v_new_campaign.id,
        v_admin_id,
        'created',
        p_reason,
        jsonb_build_object(
            'audience_type', p_audience_type,
            'default_locale', p_default_locale
        )
    );

    v_response := jsonb_build_object(
        'success', true,
        'replayed', false,
        'campaign', public._notif_campaign_to_jsonb(v_new_campaign)
    );

    INSERT INTO public.notification_campaign_requests (
        request_id,
        admin_id,
        action,
        campaign_id,
        payload_hash,
        response_json
    ) VALUES (
        p_request_id,
        v_admin_id,
        'create',
        v_new_campaign.id,
        v_payload_hash,
        v_response
    );

    RETURN v_response;
END;
$$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.admin_create_notification_campaign(uuid, text, text, text, text, text, text, text, uuid[], text) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.admin_create_notification_campaign(uuid, text, text, text, text, text, text, text, uuid[], text) TO authenticated, service_role;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_update_notification_campaign(
    p_request_id uuid,
    p_campaign_id uuid,
    p_expected_revision integer,
    p_title_vi text,
    p_title_en text,
    p_body_vi text,
    p_body_en text,
    p_default_locale text DEFAULT 'vi',
    p_audience_type text DEFAULT 'all',
    p_target_role text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_selected_user_ids uuid[] DEFAULT NULL,
    p_reason text DEFAULT NULL
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $$
DECLARE
    v_admin_id uuid;
    v_payload_hash text;
    v_existing_req public.notification_campaign_requests;
    v_camp public.notification_campaigns;
    v_clean_selected uuid[] := '{}';
    v_missing_count integer;
    v_response jsonb;
BEGIN
    v_admin_id := public._assert_daily_task_admin();

    IF p_request_id IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_REQUEST_ID';
    END IF;
    IF p_campaign_id IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_CAMPAIGN_ID';
    END IF;
    IF p_expected_revision IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'REVISION_REQUIRED';
    END IF;

    IF p_selected_user_ids IS NOT NULL AND cardinality(p_selected_user_ids) > 0 THEN
        SELECT array_agg(DISTINCT u ORDER BY u) INTO v_clean_selected
        FROM unnest(p_selected_user_ids) AS u
        WHERE u IS NOT NULL;
    END IF;

    -- Canonical JSON payload hash eliminates delimiter collisions
    v_payload_hash := md5(jsonb_build_object(
        'action', 'update',
        'campaign_id', p_campaign_id,
        'expected_revision', p_expected_revision,
        'title_vi', TRIM(COALESCE(p_title_vi, '')),
        'title_en', TRIM(COALESCE(p_title_en, '')),
        'body_vi', TRIM(COALESCE(p_body_vi, '')),
        'body_en', TRIM(COALESCE(p_body_en, '')),
        'default_locale', COALESCE(p_default_locale, 'vi'),
        'audience_type', COALESCE(p_audience_type, 'all'),
        'target_role', p_target_role,
        'selected_user_ids', to_jsonb(COALESCE(v_clean_selected, '{}'::uuid[])),
        'reason', NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(p_reason, '')), '')
    )::text);

    PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext('notif_req:' || p_request_id::text));

    SELECT * INTO v_existing_req
    FROM public.notification_campaign_requests
    WHERE request_id = p_request_id;

    IF v_existing_req.request_id IS NOT NULL THEN
        IF v_existing_req.admin_id <> v_admin_id THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT: Request ID already claimed by another administrator';
        END IF;
        IF v_existing_req.payload_hash <> v_payload_hash OR v_existing_req.action <> 'update' THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT: Request ID already used with different payload';
        END IF;
        RETURN v_existing_req.response_json || jsonb_build_object('replayed', true);
    END IF;

    SELECT * INTO v_camp
    FROM public.notification_campaigns
    WHERE id = p_campaign_id
    FOR UPDATE;

    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'CAMPAIGN_NOT_FOUND';
    END IF;

    IF v_camp.status NOT IN ('draft', 'queued') THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'CAMPAIGN_NOT_MODIFIABLE: Only draft or queued campaigns can be modified';
    END IF;

    IF v_camp.status = 'queued' AND v_camp.scheduled_for <= clock_timestamp() THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'CAMPAIGN_ALREADY_DUE: Campaign is already due for processing';
    END IF;

    IF v_camp.revision <> p_expected_revision THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'REVISION_CONFLICT: Expected revision % but found %', p_expected_revision, v_camp.revision;
    END IF;

    -- Validation
    IF p_title_vi IS NULL OR TRIM(p_title_vi) = '' OR length(p_title_vi) > 200 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_TITLE_VI';
    END IF;
    IF p_title_en IS NULL OR TRIM(p_title_en) = '' OR length(p_title_en) > 200 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_TITLE_EN';
    END IF;
    IF p_body_vi IS NULL OR TRIM(p_body_vi) = '' OR length(p_body_vi) > 2000 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_BODY_VI';
    END IF;
    IF p_body_en IS NULL OR TRIM(p_body_en) = '' OR length(p_body_en) > 2000 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_BODY_EN';
    END IF;

    IF p_default_locale NOT IN ('vi', 'en', 'bilingual') THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_LOCALE';
    END IF;

    IF p_audience_type NOT IN ('all', 'role', 'selected_users') THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_AUDIENCE_TYPE';
    END IF;

    IF p_audience_type = 'role' THEN
        IF p_target_role IS NULL OR p_target_role NOT IN ('member', 'moderator', 'admin') THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_TARGET_ROLE';
        END IF;
        v_clean_selected := '{}';
    ELSIF p_audience_type = 'selected_users' THEN
        p_target_role := NULL;
        IF v_clean_selected IS NULL OR cardinality(v_clean_selected) = 0 THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'EMPTY_SELECTED_USERS';
        END IF;
        IF cardinality(v_clean_selected) > 1000 THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'TOO_MANY_SELECTED_USERS';
        END IF;

        SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_missing_count
        FROM unnest(v_clean_selected) AS u
        WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles WHERE id = u);

        IF v_missing_count > 0 THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_RECIPIENT_USER';
        END IF;
    ELSE
        p_target_role := NULL;
        v_clean_selected := '{}';
    END IF;

    UPDATE public.notification_campaigns
    SET title_vi = TRIM(p_title_vi),
        title_en = TRIM(p_title_en),
        body_vi = TRIM(p_body_vi),
        body_en = TRIM(p_body_en),
        default_locale = p_default_locale,
        audience_type = p_audience_type,
        target_role = p_target_role,
        selected_user_ids = v_clean_selected,
        revision = revision + 1,
        updated_at = clock_timestamp()
    WHERE id = p_campaign_id
    RETURNING * INTO v_camp;

    -- If campaign was queued, re-take recipient snapshot
    IF v_camp.status = 'queued' THEN
        PERFORM public._notif_snapshot_recipients(v_camp.id);
        SELECT * INTO v_camp FROM public.notification_campaigns WHERE id = v_camp.id;
    END IF;

    INSERT INTO public.notification_campaign_events (
        campaign_id,
        admin_id,
        action,
        reason,
        details
    ) VALUES (
        v_camp.id,
        v_admin_id,
        'updated',
        p_reason,
        jsonb_build_object('revision', v_camp.revision)
    );

    v_response := jsonb_build_object(
        'success', true,
        'replayed', false,
        'campaign', public._notif_campaign_to_jsonb(v_camp)
    );

    INSERT INTO public.notification_campaign_requests (
        request_id,
        admin_id,
        action,
        campaign_id,
        payload_hash,
        response_json
    ) VALUES (
        p_request_id,
        v_admin_id,
        'update',
        v_camp.id,
        v_payload_hash,
        v_response
    );

    RETURN v_response;
END;
$$;

GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.admin_update_notification_campaign(uuid, uuid, integer, text, text, text, text, text, text, text, uuid[], text) TO authenticated, service_role;

-- ============================================================================

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_preview_notification_campaign(
    p_campaign_id uuid DEFAULT NULL,
    p_audience_type text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_target_role text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_selected_user_ids uuid[] DEFAULT NULL,
    p_default_locale text DEFAULT 'vi',
    p_title_vi text DEFAULT '',
    p_title_en text DEFAULT '',
    p_body_vi text DEFAULT '',
    p_body_en text DEFAULT ''
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $$
DECLARE
    v_admin_id uuid;
    v_camp public.notification_campaigns;
    v_aud text;
    v_role text;
    v_selected uuid[] := '{}';
    v_locale text;
    v_title_vi text;
    v_title_en text;
    v_body_vi text;
    v_body_en text;
    v_count integer := 0;
    v_prev_vi_title text;
    v_prev_vi_body text;
    v_prev_en_title text;
    v_prev_en_body text;
    v_eff_title text;
    v_eff_body text;
BEGIN
    v_admin_id := public._assert_daily_task_admin();

    IF p_campaign_id IS NOT NULL THEN
        SELECT * INTO v_camp
        FROM public.notification_campaigns
        WHERE id = p_campaign_id;

        IF NOT FOUND THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'CAMPAIGN_NOT_FOUND';
        END IF;

        v_aud := v_camp.audience_type;
        v_role := v_camp.target_role;
        v_selected := COALESCE(v_camp.selected_user_ids, '{}'::uuid[]);
        v_locale := v_camp.default_locale;
        v_title_vi := v_camp.title_vi;
        v_title_en := v_camp.title_en;
        v_body_vi := v_camp.body_vi;
        v_body_en := v_camp.body_en;

        -- If campaign has frozen recipient snapshot, use that exact count
        IF v_camp.recipient_snapshot_taken THEN
            v_count := v_camp.total_recipients;
        END IF;
    ELSE
        v_aud := COALESCE(p_audience_type, 'all');
        v_role := p_target_role;
        IF p_selected_user_ids IS NOT NULL THEN
            SELECT array_agg(DISTINCT u ORDER BY u) INTO v_selected FROM unnest(p_selected_user_ids) AS u WHERE u IS NOT NULL;
        END IF;
        v_locale := COALESCE(p_default_locale, 'vi');
        v_title_vi := COALESCE(p_title_vi, '');
        v_title_en := COALESCE(p_title_en, '');
        v_body_vi := COALESCE(p_body_vi, '');
        v_body_en := COALESCE(p_body_en, '');
    END IF;

    -- If count not yet derived from snapshot
    IF (v_camp.id IS NULL OR NOT v_camp.recipient_snapshot_taken) THEN
        IF v_aud = 'all' THEN
            SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_count FROM public.profiles;
        ELSIF v_aud = 'role' THEN
            IF v_role NOT IN ('member', 'moderator', 'admin') THEN
                RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_TARGET_ROLE';
            END IF;
            SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_count FROM public.profiles WHERE role = v_role;
        ELSIF v_aud = 'selected_users' THEN
            IF v_selected IS NOT NULL AND cardinality(v_selected) > 0 THEN
                SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_count
                FROM public.profiles
                WHERE id = ANY(v_selected);
            ELSE
                v_count := 0;
            END IF;
        END IF;
    END IF;

    -- Compute previews
    SELECT delivered_title, delivered_message INTO v_prev_vi_title, v_prev_vi_body
    FROM public._notif_resolve_delivered_content(v_title_vi, v_title_en, v_body_vi, v_body_en, 'vi');

    SELECT delivered_title, delivered_message INTO v_prev_en_title, v_prev_en_body
    FROM public._notif_resolve_delivered_content(v_title_vi, v_title_en, v_body_vi, v_body_en, 'en');

    SELECT delivered_title, delivered_message INTO v_eff_title, v_eff_body
    FROM public._notif_resolve_delivered_content(v_title_vi, v_title_en, v_body_vi, v_body_en, v_locale);

    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
        'success', true,
        'recipient_count', v_count,
        'audience_type', v_aud,
        'target_role', v_role,
        'default_locale', v_locale,
        'preview_vi', jsonb_build_object('title', v_prev_vi_title, 'body', v_prev_vi_body),
        'preview_en', jsonb_build_object('title', v_prev_en_title, 'body', v_prev_en_body),
        'preview_effective', jsonb_build_object('locale', v_locale, 'title', v_eff_title, 'body', v_eff_body)
    );
END;
$$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.admin_preview_notification_campaign(uuid, text, text, uuid[], text, text, text, text, text) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.admin_preview_notification_campaign(uuid, text, text, uuid[], text, text, text, text, text) TO authenticated, service_role;

        'reason', NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(p_reason, '')), '')

        END IF;
        RETURN v_existing_req.response_json || jsonb_build_object('replayed', true);
