    IF v_camp.status = 'queued' AND v_camp.scheduled_for <= clock_timestamp() THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'CAMPAIGN_ALREADY_DUE: Campaign is already due for processing';
    END IF;

    IF v_camp.revision <> p_expected_revision THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'REVISION_CONFLICT: Expected revision % but found %', p_expected_revision, v_camp.revision;
    END IF;

    -- Take deterministic recipient snapshot and freeze it
    PERFORM public._notif_snapshot_recipients(v_camp.id);

    UPDATE public.notification_campaigns
    SET status = 'queued',
        scheduled_for = p_scheduled_for,
        revision = revision + 1,
        updated_at = clock_timestamp()
    WHERE id = p_campaign_id
    RETURNING * INTO v_camp;

    INSERT INTO public.notification_campaign_events (
        campaign_id,
        admin_id,
        action,
        reason,
        details
    ) VALUES (
        v_camp.id,
        v_admin_id,
        'scheduled',
        p_reason,
        jsonb_build_object(
            'scheduled_for', to_char(p_scheduled_for AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"'),
            'total_recipients', v_camp.total_recipients,
            'revision', v_camp.revision
        )
    );

    v_response := jsonb_build_object(
        'success', true,
        'replayed', false,
        'campaign', public._notif_campaign_to_jsonb(v_camp)
    );

    INSERT INTO public.notification_campaign_requests (
        request_id,
        admin_id,
        action,
        campaign_id,
        payload_hash,
        response_json
    ) VALUES (
        p_request_id,
        v_admin_id,
        'schedule',
        v_camp.id,
        v_payload_hash,
        v_response
    );

    RETURN v_response;
END;
$$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.admin_schedule_notification_campaign(uuid, uuid, integer, timestamptz, text) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.admin_schedule_notification_campaign(uuid, uuid, integer, timestamptz, text) TO authenticated, service_role;


-- ============================================================================
-- 11. ADMIN RPC: ADMIN_SEND_NOW_NOTIFICATION_CAMPAIGN
-- ============================================================================

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_send_now_notification_campaign(
    p_request_id uuid,
    p_campaign_id uuid,
    p_expected_revision integer,
    p_reason text DEFAULT NULL
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $$
DECLARE
    v_admin_id uuid;
    v_payload_hash text;
    v_existing_req public.notification_campaign_requests;
    v_camp public.notification_campaigns;
    v_response jsonb;
BEGIN
    v_admin_id := public._assert_daily_task_admin();

    IF p_request_id IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_REQUEST_ID';
    END IF;
    IF p_campaign_id IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_CAMPAIGN_ID';
    END IF;
    IF p_expected_revision IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'REVISION_REQUIRED';
    END IF;

    -- Canonical JSON payload hash eliminates delimiter collisions
    v_payload_hash := md5(jsonb_build_object(
        'action', 'send_now',
        'campaign_id', p_campaign_id,
        'expected_revision', p_expected_revision,
        'reason', NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(p_reason, '')), '')
    )::text);

    PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext('notif_req:' || p_request_id::text));

    SELECT * INTO v_existing_req
    FROM public.notification_campaign_requests
    WHERE request_id = p_request_id;

    IF v_existing_req.request_id IS NOT NULL THEN
        IF v_existing_req.admin_id <> v_admin_id THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT: Request ID already claimed by another administrator';
        END IF;
        IF v_existing_req.payload_hash <> v_payload_hash OR v_existing_req.action <> 'send_now' THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT: Request ID already used with different payload';
        END IF;
        RETURN v_existing_req.response_json || jsonb_build_object('replayed', true);
    END IF;

    SELECT * INTO v_camp
    FROM public.notification_campaigns
    WHERE id = p_campaign_id
    FOR UPDATE;

    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'CAMPAIGN_NOT_FOUND';
    END IF;

    IF v_camp.status NOT IN ('draft', 'queued') THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'CAMPAIGN_NOT_MODIFIABLE: Only draft or queued campaigns can be sent now';
    END IF;

    IF v_camp.revision <> p_expected_revision THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'REVISION_CONFLICT: Expected revision % but found %', p_expected_revision, v_camp.revision;
    END IF;

    -- Freeze recipient snapshot if not yet taken
    IF NOT v_camp.recipient_snapshot_taken THEN
        PERFORM public._notif_snapshot_recipients(v_camp.id);
    END IF;

    UPDATE public.notification_campaigns
    SET status = 'queued',
        scheduled_for = clock_timestamp(),
        revision = revision + 1,
        updated_at = clock_timestamp()
    WHERE id = p_campaign_id
    RETURNING * INTO v_camp;

    INSERT INTO public.notification_campaign_events (
        campaign_id,
        admin_id,
        action,
        reason,
        details
    ) VALUES (
        v_camp.id,
        v_admin_id,
        'send_now_requested',
        p_reason,
        jsonb_build_object(
            'total_recipients', v_camp.total_recipients,
            'revision', v_camp.revision
        )
    );

    v_response := jsonb_build_object(
        'success', true,
        'replayed', false,
        'campaign', public._notif_campaign_to_jsonb(v_camp)
    );

    INSERT INTO public.notification_campaign_requests (
        request_id,
        admin_id,
        action,
        campaign_id,
        payload_hash,
        response_json
    ) VALUES (
        p_request_id,
        v_admin_id,
        'send_now',
        v_camp.id,
        v_payload_hash,
        v_response
    );

    RETURN v_response;
END;
$$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.admin_send_now_notification_campaign(uuid, uuid, integer, text) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.admin_send_now_notification_campaign(uuid, uuid, integer, text) TO authenticated, service_role;


-- ============================================================================
-- 12. ADMIN RPC: ADMIN_CANCEL_NOTIFICATION_CAMPAIGN
-- ============================================================================

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_cancel_notification_campaign(
    p_request_id uuid,
    p_campaign_id uuid,
    p_expected_revision integer,
    p_reason text
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $$
DECLARE
    v_admin_id uuid;
    v_payload_hash text;
    v_existing_req public.notification_campaign_requests;
    v_camp public.notification_campaigns;
    v_response jsonb;
BEGIN
    v_admin_id := public._assert_daily_task_admin();

    IF p_request_id IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_REQUEST_ID';
    END IF;
    IF p_campaign_id IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_CAMPAIGN_ID';
    END IF;
    IF p_expected_revision IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'REVISION_REQUIRED';
    END IF;
    IF p_reason IS NULL OR TRIM(p_reason) = '' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'REASON_REQUIRED: Cancellation reason is required';
    END IF;

    -- Canonical JSON payload hash eliminates delimiter collisions
    v_payload_hash := md5(jsonb_build_object(
        'action', 'cancel',
        'campaign_id', p_campaign_id,
        'expected_revision', p_expected_revision,
        'reason', TRIM(p_reason)
    )::text);

    PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext('notif_req:' || p_request_id::text));

    SELECT * INTO v_existing_req
    FROM public.notification_campaign_requests
    WHERE request_id = p_request_id;

    IF v_existing_req.request_id IS NOT NULL THEN
        IF v_existing_req.admin_id <> v_admin_id THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT: Request ID already claimed by another administrator';
        END IF;
        IF v_existing_req.payload_hash <> v_payload_hash OR v_existing_req.action <> 'cancel' THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT: Request ID already used with different payload';
        END IF;
        RETURN v_existing_req.response_json || jsonb_build_object('replayed', true);
    END IF;

    SELECT * INTO v_camp
    FROM public.notification_campaigns
    WHERE id = p_campaign_id
    FOR UPDATE;

    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'CAMPAIGN_NOT_FOUND';
    END IF;

    IF v_camp.revision <> p_expected_revision THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'REVISION_CONFLICT: Expected revision % but found %', p_expected_revision, v_camp.revision;
    END IF;

    -- Only draft or future queued campaigns can be cancelled
    IF v_camp.status = 'draft' THEN
        -- Allowed
        NULL;
    ELSIF v_camp.status = 'queued' AND v_camp.scheduled_for > clock_timestamp() THEN
        -- Future queued: Allowed
        NULL;
    ELSE
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'CANNOT_CANCEL_IN_FLIGHT_OR_PAST_CAMPAIGN: Cannot cancel campaign that is sending, completed, cancelled, or already due';
    END IF;

    -- Remove any unsent recipients
    DELETE FROM public.notification_campaign_recipients
    WHERE campaign_id = p_campaign_id AND status = 'pending';

    UPDATE public.notification_campaigns
    SET status = 'cancelled',
        cancelled_at = clock_timestamp(),
        cancelled_by = v_admin_id,
        cancel_reason = TRIM(p_reason),
        revision = revision + 1,
        updated_at = clock_timestamp()
    WHERE id = p_campaign_id
    RETURNING * INTO v_camp;

    INSERT INTO public.notification_campaign_events (
        campaign_id,
        admin_id,
        action,
        reason,
        details
    ) VALUES (
        v_camp.id,
        v_admin_id,
        'cancelled',
        TRIM(p_reason),
        jsonb_build_object('revision', v_camp.revision)
    );

    v_response := jsonb_build_object(
        'success', true,
        'replayed', false,
        'campaign', public._notif_campaign_to_jsonb(v_camp)
    );

    INSERT INTO public.notification_campaign_requests (
        request_id,
        admin_id,
        action,
        campaign_id,
        payload_hash,
        response_json
    ) VALUES (
        p_request_id,
        v_admin_id,
        'cancel',
        v_camp.id,
        v_payload_hash,
        v_response
    );

    RETURN v_response;
END;
$$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.admin_cancel_notification_campaign(uuid, uuid, integer, text) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.admin_cancel_notification_campaign(uuid, uuid, integer, text) TO authenticated, service_role;


-- ============================================================================
-- 13. CORE BATCH FANOUT WORKER (Service-only execution)
-- ============================================================================

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.service_process_notification_campaigns(
    p_batch_size integer DEFAULT 500,
    p_max_campaigns integer DEFAULT 10,
    p_campaign_id uuid DEFAULT NULL
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $$
DECLARE
    v_camp RECORD;
    v_campaigns_processed integer := 0;
    v_total_notifications_sent integer := 0;
    v_camp_batch_sent integer := 0;
    v_deliv_title text;
    v_deliv_message text;
    v_pending_remaining integer;
    v_batch_limit integer;
    v_details jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
BEGIN
    v_batch_limit := GREATEST(1, LEAST(COALESCE(p_batch_size, 500), 1000));

    FOR v_camp IN
        SELECT c.*
        FROM public.notification_campaigns c
        WHERE (p_campaign_id IS NULL OR c.id = p_campaign_id)
          AND c.status IN ('queued', 'sending')
          AND c.scheduled_for <= clock_timestamp()
        ORDER BY c.scheduled_for ASC, c.id ASC
        LIMIT p_max_campaigns
        FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
    LOOP
        -- If campaign was queued, transition to sending and ensure snapshot
        IF v_camp.status = 'queued' THEN
            -- Only take snapshot if NOT already frozen
            IF NOT v_camp.recipient_snapshot_taken THEN
                PERFORM public._notif_snapshot_recipients(v_camp.id);
                SELECT * INTO v_camp FROM public.notification_campaigns WHERE id = v_camp.id;
            END IF;

            -- If frozen snapshot has 0 recipients, complete immediately with 0 sent
            IF v_camp.total_recipients = 0 THEN
                UPDATE public.notification_campaigns
                SET status = 'completed',
                    started_at = COALESCE(v_camp.started_at, clock_timestamp()),
                    completed_at = clock_timestamp(),
                    updated_at = clock_timestamp()
                WHERE id = v_camp.id;

                INSERT INTO public.notification_campaign_events (campaign_id, action, details)
                VALUES (v_camp.id, 'worker_completed', jsonb_build_object('total_recipients', 0, 'sent_count', 0));

                v_details := v_details || jsonb_build_object(
                    'campaign_id', v_camp.id,
                    'sent_in_batch', 0,
                    'pending_remaining', 0,
                    'completed', true
                );
                v_campaigns_processed := v_campaigns_processed + 1;
                CONTINUE;
            END IF;

            UPDATE public.notification_campaigns
            SET status = 'sending',
                started_at = COALESCE(v_camp.started_at, clock_timestamp()),
                updated_at = clock_timestamp()
            WHERE id = v_camp.id;

            INSERT INTO public.notification_campaign_events (campaign_id, action, details)
            VALUES (v_camp.id, 'worker_started', jsonb_build_object('batch_size', v_batch_limit));
        END IF;

        -- Resolve delivered content
        SELECT delivered_title, delivered_message INTO v_deliv_title, v_deliv_message
        FROM public._notif_resolve_delivered_content(
            v_camp.title_vi,
            v_camp.title_en,
            v_camp.body_vi,
            v_camp.body_en,
            v_camp.default_locale
        );

        -- Atomically lock pending recipient rows with SKIP LOCKED,
        -- create notifications rows without popup states,
        -- and update recipient receipts to 'sent'
        WITH target_recipients AS (
            SELECT r.id AS recipient_id, r.user_id
            FROM public.notification_campaign_recipients r
            WHERE r.campaign_id = v_camp.id
              AND r.status = 'pending'
            ORDER BY r.user_id ASC
            LIMIT v_batch_limit
            FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
        ),
        created_notifications AS (
            INSERT INTO public.notifications (
                user_id,
                title,
                message,
                type,
                data,
                created_at
            )
            SELECT
                tr.user_id,
                v_deliv_title,
                v_deliv_message,
                'admin',
                jsonb_build_object(
                    'campaign_id', v_camp.id,
                    'broadcast', true,
                    'sender', 'admin',
                    'locale', v_camp.default_locale,
                    'title_vi', v_camp.title_vi,
                    'title_en', v_camp.title_en
                ),
                clock_timestamp()
            FROM target_recipients tr
            RETURNING id AS notification_id, user_id
        ),
        updated_recipients AS (
            UPDATE public.notification_campaign_recipients r
            SET status = 'sent',
                notification_id = cn.notification_id,
                sent_at = clock_timestamp()
            FROM created_notifications cn
            WHERE r.campaign_id = v_camp.id
              AND r.user_id = cn.user_id
              AND r.status = 'pending'
            RETURNING r.id
        )
        SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_camp_batch_sent FROM updated_recipients;

        v_total_notifications_sent := v_total_notifications_sent + v_camp_batch_sent;
        v_campaigns_processed := v_campaigns_processed + 1;

        -- Update sent count on campaign
        UPDATE public.notification_campaigns
        SET sent_count = (
                SELECT COUNT(*)
                FROM public.notification_campaign_recipients
                WHERE campaign_id = v_camp.id AND status = 'sent'
            ),
            updated_at = clock_timestamp()
        WHERE id = v_camp.id;

        -- Check remaining pending recipients
        SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_pending_remaining
        FROM public.notification_campaign_recipients
        WHERE campaign_id = v_camp.id AND status = 'pending';

        IF v_pending_remaining = 0 THEN
            UPDATE public.notification_campaigns
            SET status = 'completed',
                completed_at = clock_timestamp(),
                updated_at = clock_timestamp()
            WHERE id = v_camp.id;

            INSERT INTO public.notification_campaign_events (campaign_id, action, details)
            VALUES (v_camp.id, 'worker_completed', jsonb_build_object(
                'total_recipients', v_camp.total_recipients,
                'sent_count', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.notification_campaign_recipients WHERE campaign_id = v_camp.id AND status = 'sent')
            ));
        END IF;

        v_details := v_details || jsonb_build_object(
            'campaign_id', v_camp.id,
            'sent_in_batch', v_camp_batch_sent,
            'pending_remaining', v_pending_remaining,
            'completed', (v_pending_remaining = 0)
        );
    END LOOP;

    -- Update heartbeat
    INSERT INTO public.notification_worker_heartbeats (
        worker_key,
        last_run_at,
        campaigns_processed,
        notifications_sent,
        status
    ) VALUES (
        'service_cron',
        clock_timestamp(),
        v_campaigns_processed,
        v_total_notifications_sent,
        'idle'
    )
    ON CONFLICT (worker_key) DO UPDATE SET
        last_run_at = excluded.last_run_at,
        campaigns_processed = public.notification_worker_heartbeats.campaigns_processed + excluded.campaigns_processed,
        notifications_sent = public.notification_worker_heartbeats.notifications_sent + excluded.notifications_sent,
        status = excluded.status;

    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
        'success', true,
        'campaigns_processed', v_campaigns_processed,
        'notifications_sent', v_total_notifications_sent,
        'details', v_details
    );
END;
$$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.service_process_notification_campaigns(integer, integer, uuid) FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.service_process_notification_campaigns(integer, integer, uuid) TO service_role;

-- ============================================================================
-- 15. ADMIN RPC: ADMIN_LIST_NOTIFICATION_CAMPAIGNS (Cursor paginated)
-- ============================================================================

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_list_notification_campaigns(
    p_status text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_audience_type text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_limit integer DEFAULT 20,
    p_cursor text DEFAULT NULL
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $$
DECLARE
    v_admin_id uuid;
    v_limit integer;
    v_cursor_created_at timestamptz;
    v_cursor_id uuid;
    v_items jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
    v_has_more boolean := false;
    v_next_cursor text := NULL;
    v_last_created_at timestamptz;
    v_last_id uuid;
    v_row RECORD;
    v_count integer := 0;
BEGIN
    v_admin_id := public._assert_daily_task_admin();

    v_limit := GREATEST(1, LEAST(COALESCE(p_limit, 20), 100));

    -- Whitelist status and audience filters
    IF p_status IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(p_status) <> '' THEN
        IF p_status NOT IN ('draft', 'queued', 'sending', 'completed', 'cancelled', 'failed') THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_STATUS_FILTER: Status must be one of draft, queued, sending, completed, cancelled, failed';
        END IF;
    END IF;

    IF p_audience_type IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(p_audience_type) <> '' THEN
        IF p_audience_type NOT IN ('all', 'role', 'selected_users') THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_AUDIENCE_FILTER: Audience must be one of all, role, selected_users';
        END IF;
    END IF;

    IF p_cursor IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(p_cursor) <> '' THEN
        IF position('|' in p_cursor) = 0 THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_CURSOR: Cursor format must be ISO8601|uuid';
        END IF;

        IF lower(p_cursor) LIKE '%infinity%' OR lower(p_cursor) LIKE '%nan%' THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_CURSOR: Cursor cannot contain infinity or NaN values';
        END IF;

        BEGIN
            v_cursor_created_at := split_part(p_cursor, '|', 1)::timestamptz;
            v_cursor_id := split_part(p_cursor, '|', 2)::uuid;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_CURSOR: Cursor format must be ISO8601|uuid';
        END;

        IF v_cursor_created_at IS NULL OR v_cursor_id IS NULL THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_CURSOR: Cursor format must be ISO8601|uuid';
        END IF;
    END IF;

    FOR v_row IN
        SELECT c.*,
            COALESCE((
                SELECT COUNT(*)
                FROM public.notification_campaign_recipients r
                JOIN public.notifications n ON n.id = r.notification_id
                WHERE r.campaign_id = c.id AND n.is_read = true
            ), 0) AS live_read_count
        FROM public.notification_campaigns c
        WHERE (p_status IS NULL OR c.status = p_status)
          AND (p_audience_type IS NULL OR c.audience_type = p_audience_type)
          AND (
              v_cursor_created_at IS NULL OR
              (c.created_at, c.id) < (v_cursor_created_at, v_cursor_id)
          )
        ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.id DESC
        LIMIT v_limit + 1
    LOOP
        v_count := v_count + 1;
        IF v_count <= v_limit THEN
            v_items := v_items || jsonb_build_object(
                'id', v_row.id,
                'title_vi', v_row.title_vi,
                'title_en', v_row.title_en,
                'body_vi', v_row.body_vi,
                'body_en', v_row.body_en,
                'default_locale', v_row.default_locale,
                'audience_type', v_row.audience_type,
                'target_role', v_row.target_role,
                'status', v_row.status,
                'revision', v_row.revision,
                'total_recipients', v_row.total_recipients,
                'recipient_snapshot_taken', v_row.recipient_snapshot_taken,
                'snapshot_taken_at', CASE WHEN v_row.snapshot_taken_at IS NOT NULL THEN to_char(v_row.snapshot_taken_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') ELSE NULL END,
                'sent_count', v_row.sent_count,
                'read_count', v_row.live_read_count,
                'failed_count', v_row.failed_count,
                'scheduled_for', CASE WHEN v_row.scheduled_for IS NOT NULL THEN to_char(v_row.scheduled_for AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') ELSE NULL END,
                'started_at', CASE WHEN v_row.started_at IS NOT NULL THEN to_char(v_row.started_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') ELSE NULL END,
                'completed_at', CASE WHEN v_row.completed_at IS NOT NULL THEN to_char(v_row.completed_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') ELSE NULL END,
                'created_by', v_row.created_by,
                'created_at', to_char(v_row.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"'),
                'updated_at', to_char(v_row.updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"')
            );
            v_last_created_at := v_row.created_at;
            v_last_id := v_row.id;
        ELSE
            v_has_more := true;
        END IF;
    END LOOP;

    IF v_has_more AND v_last_created_at IS NOT NULL THEN
        v_next_cursor := to_char(v_last_created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') || '|' || v_last_id::text;
    END IF;

    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
        'items', v_items,
        'has_more', v_has_more,
        'next_cursor', v_next_cursor
    );
END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_get_notification_campaign_detail(
    p_campaign_id uuid,
    p_events_limit integer DEFAULT 50
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $$
DECLARE
    v_admin_id uuid;
    v_camp public.notification_campaigns;
    v_events jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
    v_preview jsonb;
    v_ev RECORD;
    v_events_limit integer;
BEGIN
    v_admin_id := public._assert_daily_task_admin();

    IF p_campaign_id IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_CAMPAIGN_ID';
    END IF;

    v_events_limit := GREATEST(1, LEAST(COALESCE(p_events_limit, 50), 100));

    SELECT * INTO v_camp
    FROM public.notification_campaigns
    WHERE id = p_campaign_id;

    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'CAMPAIGN_NOT_FOUND';
    END IF;

    v_preview := public.admin_preview_notification_campaign(p_campaign_id => p_campaign_id);

    FOR v_ev IN
        SELECT e.id, e.action, e.admin_id, e.reason, e.details,
               to_char(e.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS created_at_iso
        FROM public.notification_campaign_events e
        WHERE e.campaign_id = p_campaign_id
        ORDER BY e.created_at DESC, e.id DESC
        LIMIT v_events_limit
    LOOP
        v_events := v_events || jsonb_build_object(
            'id', v_ev.id,
            'action', v_ev.action,
            'admin_id', v_ev.admin_id,
            'reason', v_ev.reason,
            'details', v_ev.details,
            'created_at', v_ev.created_at_iso
        );
    END LOOP;

    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
        'campaign', public._notif_campaign_to_jsonb(v_camp),
        'preview', v_preview,
        'events', v_events
    );
END;
$$;

-- ============================================================================
-- 17. ADMIN RPC: ADMIN_LIST_NOTIFICATION_CAMPAIGN_RECIPIENTS (Cursor paginated)
-- ============================================================================

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_list_notification_campaign_recipients(
    p_campaign_id uuid,
    p_status text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_limit integer DEFAULT 50,
    p_cursor text DEFAULT NULL
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $$
DECLARE
    v_admin_id uuid;
    v_limit integer;
    v_cursor_created_at timestamptz;
    v_cursor_id uuid;
    v_items jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
    v_has_more boolean := false;
    v_next_cursor text := NULL;
    v_last_created_at timestamptz;
    v_last_id uuid;
    v_row RECORD;
    v_count integer := 0;
BEGIN
    v_admin_id := public._assert_daily_task_admin();

    IF p_campaign_id IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_CAMPAIGN_ID';
    END IF;

    v_limit := GREATEST(1, LEAST(COALESCE(p_limit, 50), 100));

    -- Whitelist status filter
    IF p_status IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(p_status) <> '' THEN
        IF p_status NOT IN ('pending', 'sent', 'failed') THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_STATUS_FILTER: Recipient status must be one of pending, sent, failed';
        END IF;
    END IF;

    IF p_cursor IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(p_cursor) <> '' THEN
        IF position('|' in p_cursor) = 0 THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_CURSOR: Cursor format must be ISO8601|uuid';
        END IF;

        IF lower(p_cursor) LIKE '%infinity%' OR lower(p_cursor) LIKE '%nan%' THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_CURSOR: Cursor cannot contain infinity or NaN values';
        END IF;

        BEGIN
            v_cursor_created_at := split_part(p_cursor, '|', 1)::timestamptz;
            v_cursor_id := split_part(p_cursor, '|', 2)::uuid;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_CURSOR: Cursor format must be ISO8601|uuid';
        END;

        IF v_cursor_created_at IS NULL OR v_cursor_id IS NULL THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_CURSOR: Cursor format must be ISO8601|uuid';
        END IF;
    END IF;

    FOR v_row IN
        SELECT r.id AS recipient_id,
               r.user_id,
               p.email AS user_email,
               p.display_name AS user_display_name,
               p.role AS user_role,
               r.status,
               r.notification_id,
               r.sent_at,
               r.error_message,
               r.created_at,
               COALESCE(n.is_read, false) AS is_read
        FROM public.notification_campaign_recipients r
        JOIN public.profiles p ON p.id = r.user_id
        LEFT JOIN public.notifications n ON n.id = r.notification_id
        WHERE r.campaign_id = p_campaign_id
          AND (p_status IS NULL OR r.status = p_status)
          AND (
              v_cursor_created_at IS NULL OR
              (r.created_at, r.id) > (v_cursor_created_at, v_cursor_id)
          )
        ORDER BY r.created_at ASC, r.id ASC
        LIMIT v_limit + 1
    LOOP
        v_count := v_count + 1;
        IF v_count <= v_limit THEN
            v_items := v_items || jsonb_build_object(
                'recipient_id', v_row.recipient_id,
                'user_id', v_row.user_id,
                'user_email', v_row.user_email,
                'user_display_name', v_row.user_display_name,
                'user_role', v_row.user_role,
                'status', v_row.status,
                'notification_id', v_row.notification_id,
                'sent_at', CASE WHEN v_row.sent_at IS NOT NULL THEN to_char(v_row.sent_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') ELSE NULL END,
                'is_read', v_row.is_read,
                'error_message', v_row.error_message
            );
            v_last_created_at := v_row.created_at;
            v_last_id := v_row.recipient_id;
        ELSE
            v_has_more := true;
        END IF;
    END LOOP;

    IF v_has_more AND v_last_created_at IS NOT NULL THEN
        v_next_cursor := to_char(v_last_created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') || '|' || v_last_id::text;
    END IF;

    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
        'items', v_items,
        'has_more', v_has_more,
        'next_cursor', v_next_cursor
    );
END;
$$;

-- 18. ADMIN RPC: ADMIN_GET_NOTIFICATION_SCHEDULER_HEALTH
-- ============================================================================

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_get_notification_scheduler_health()
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $$
DECLARE
    v_admin_id uuid;
    v_cron_available boolean := false;
    v_cron_job_active boolean := false;
    v_scheduler_ready boolean := false;
    v_pending_due_count integer := 0;
    v_in_flight_count integer := 0;
    v_heartbeat RECORD;
    v_health_status text := 'healthy';
BEGIN
    v_admin_id := public._assert_daily_task_admin();

    -- Check pg_cron
    IF to_regclass('cron.job') IS NOT NULL THEN
        v_cron_available := true;
        BEGIN
            EXECUTE 'SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cron.job WHERE jobname = ''process_due_notification_campaigns'' AND active = true)'
            INTO v_cron_job_active;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
            v_cron_job_active := false;
        END;
    END IF;

    -- Count pending due campaigns
    SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_pending_due_count
    FROM public.notification_campaigns
    WHERE status IN ('queued', 'sending')
      AND scheduled_for <= clock_timestamp();

    -- Count in flight
    SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_in_flight_count
    FROM public.notification_campaigns
    WHERE status = 'sending';

    -- Retrieve last heartbeat
    SELECT * INTO v_heartbeat
    FROM public.notification_worker_heartbeats
    WHERE worker_key = 'service_cron';

    -- Evaluate readiness status
    IF v_cron_available AND v_cron_job_active THEN
        v_scheduler_ready := true;
        v_health_status := 'healthy';
    ELSIF v_heartbeat.last_run_at IS NOT NULL AND v_heartbeat.last_run_at >= (clock_timestamp() - interval '5 minutes') THEN
        v_scheduler_ready := true;
        v_health_status := 'healthy_daemon_active';
    ELSE
        v_scheduler_ready := false;
        v_health_status := 'scheduler_manual_fallback_required';
    END IF;

    IF v_pending_due_count > 10 THEN
        v_health_status := 'degraded_backlog_accumulating';
    ELSIF v_pending_due_count = 0 AND v_in_flight_count = 0 AND v_scheduler_ready THEN
        v_health_status := 'idle';
    END IF;

    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
        'pg_cron_available', v_cron_available,
        'pg_cron_job_active', v_cron_job_active,
        'scheduler_ready', v_scheduler_ready,
        'pending_due_campaigns_count', v_pending_due_count,
        'in_flight_campaigns_count', v_in_flight_count,
        'last_worker_run_at', CASE WHEN v_heartbeat.last_run_at IS NOT NULL THEN to_char(v_heartbeat.last_run_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') ELSE NULL END,
        'lifetime_campaigns_processed', COALESCE(v_heartbeat.campaigns_processed, 0),
        'lifetime_notifications_sent', COALESCE(v_heartbeat.notifications_sent, 0),
        'health_status', v_health_status
    );
END;
$$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.admin_get_notification_scheduler_health() FROM PUBLIC, anon;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.admin_get_notification_scheduler_health() TO authenticated, service_role;


-- ============================================================================
-- 19. CONDITIONAL PG_CRON REGISTRATION WITH SAFE FALLBACK
-- ============================================================================

DO $cron_setup$
BEGIN
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM pg_extension WHERE extname = 'pg_cron'
    ) OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM pg_available_extensions WHERE name = 'pg_cron'
    ) THEN
        BEGIN
            CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pg_cron;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
            RAISE NOTICE 'pg_cron extension creation skipped: %', SQLERRM;
        END;

        IF to_regclass('cron.job') IS NOT NULL THEN
            IF NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM cron.job WHERE jobname = 'process_due_notification_campaigns'
            ) THEN
                PERFORM cron.schedule(
                    'process_due_notification_campaigns',
                    '* * * * *',
                    'SELECT public.service_process_notification_campaigns(500, 10);'
                );
            END IF;
        END IF;
    END IF;
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
    RAISE NOTICE 'pg_cron conditional scheduling skipped (environment without pg_cron): %', SQLERRM;
END;
$cron_setup$;

COMMIT;

/**
 * Notification Campaigns Background Worker Daemon
 *
 * Safe, robust background executor for notification campaigns fanout.
 * Features:
 * - In-flight execution guard prevents overlapping iterations
 * - Completion-based setTimeout scheduling (no interval pileup)
 * - Sanitized logging (never logs connection strings, tokens or credentials)
 * - Configurable batch sizes, loop intervals, and SSL modes
 */

import { parseArgs } from 'node:util';

const options = {
  once: { type: 'boolean', default: false },
  interval: { type: 'string', default: '60' },
  batch: { type: 'string', default: '500' },
  campaigns: { type: 'string', default: '10' }
};

const { values } = parseArgs({ options, allowPositionals: true });
const runOnce = values.once;
const intervalMs = Math.max(5000, (parseInt(values.interval, 10) || 60) * 1000);
const batchSize = Math.max(1, parseInt(values.batch, 10) || 500);
const maxCampaigns = Math.max(1, parseInt(values.campaigns, 10) || 10);

let inFlight = false;
let clientPool = null;

function sanitizeUrl(rawUrl) {
  if (!rawUrl) return '(not configured)';
  try {
    const parsed = new URL(rawUrl);
    return `${parsed.protocol}//${parsed.username ? '***@' : ''}${parsed.host}${parsed.pathname}`;
  } catch {
    return '(redacted)';
  }
}

async function getClientPool() {
  if (clientPool) return clientPool;

  const dbUrl = process.env.DATABASE_URL || process.env.SUPABASE_DB_URL;
  if (!dbUrl) {
    throw new Error('DATABASE_URL or SUPABASE_DB_URL environment variable is required.');
  }

  let pgModule;
  try {
    pgModule = await import('pg');
  } catch (err) {
    throw new Error('pg package not resolved. Ensure npm install has been executed.');
  }

  const { Pool } = pgModule.default || pgModule;
  const sslConfig = process.env.DATABASE_SSL === 'false' ? false : { rejectUnauthorized: false };

  clientPool = new Pool({
    connectionString: dbUrl,
    ssl: sslConfig,
    max: 2,
    idleTimeoutMillis: 30000,
    connectionTimeoutMillis: 10000
  });

  clientPool.on('error', (err) => {
    console.error('[notification-worker] Pool background error:', err.message);
  });

  return clientPool;
}

export async function runIteration() {
  if (inFlight) {
    console.log('[notification-worker] Previous iteration still in progress, skipping tick.');
    return null;
  }

  inFlight = true;
  const pool = await getClientPool();
  const client = await pool.connect();

  try {
    const res = await client.query(
      'SELECT public.service_process_notification_campaigns($1, $2) as result',
      [batchSize, maxCampaigns]
    );
    const result = res.rows[0]?.result;
    const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
    console.log(`[notification-worker ${nowIso}] Iteration completed:`, JSON.stringify(result));
    return result;
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('[notification-worker] Iteration error:', err.message);
    throw err;
  } finally {
    client.release();
    inFlight = false;
  }
}

async function main() {
  const targetUrl = process.env.DATABASE_URL || process.env.SUPABASE_DB_URL;
  console.log(`[notification-worker] Starting worker against ${sanitizeUrl(targetUrl)}`);

  if (runOnce) {
    try {
      await runIteration();
      if (clientPool) await clientPool.end();
      process.exit(0);
    } catch {
      if (clientPool) await clientPool.end();
      process.exit(1);
    }
  } else {
    console.log(`[notification-worker] Running continuous daemon (interval: ${intervalMs / 1000}s, batchSize: ${batchSize})...`);

    const loop = async () => {
      try {
        await runIteration();
      } catch (err) {
        // Logged inside runIteration
      } finally {
        setTimeout(loop, intervalMs);
      }
    };

    loop();
  }
}

if (process.argv[1] && import.meta.url.endsWith(process.argv[1].replace(/\\/g, '/'))) {
  main();
}

  clientPool.on('error', (err) => {
    console.error('[notification-worker] Pool background error:', err.message);
  });

  return clientPool;
}

export async function runIteration() {
  if (inFlight) {
    console.log('[notification-worker] Previous iteration still in progress, skipping tick.');
    return null;
  }

  inFlight = true;
  const pool = await getClientPool();
  const client = await pool.connect();

  try {
    const res = await client.query(
      'SELECT public.service_process_notification_campaigns($1, $2) as result',
      [batchSize, maxCampaigns]
    );
    const result = res.rows[0]?.result;
    const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
    console.log(`[notification-worker ${nowIso}] Iteration completed:`, JSON.stringify(result));
    return result;
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('[notification-worker] Iteration error:', err.message);
    throw err;
  } finally {
    client.release();
    inFlight = false;
  }
}

async function main() {
  const targetUrl = process.env.DATABASE_URL || process.env.SUPABASE_DB_URL;
  console.log(`[notification-worker] Starting worker against ${sanitizeUrl(targetUrl)}`);

  if (runOnce) {
    try {
      await runIteration();
      if (clientPool) await clientPool.end();
      process.exit(0);
    } catch {
      if (clientPool) await clientPool.end();
      process.exit(1);
    }
  } else {
    console.log(`[notification-worker] Running continuous daemon (interval: ${intervalMs / 1000}s, batchSize: ${batchSize})...`);

    const loop = async () => {
      try {
        await runIteration();
      } catch (err) {
        // Logged inside runIteration
      } finally {
        setTimeout(loop, intervalMs);
      }
    };

    loop();
  }
}

      ) as r;

  assert.equal(resBroadcast.success, true);
  assert.equal(resBroadcast.target, 'all');

// 13. Compatibility with existing 067/069 direct notifications and broadcast
await test('Compatibility with existing direct notification popup registration and original broadcast', async () => {
  // Direct notification to Member A registers popup state
  const resDirect = await asUser(adminId, 'authenticated', async () => {
    return (await one(`
      select public.admin_send_notification(
        '${memberAId}',
        'Tin nhắn trực tiếp',
        'Nội dung trực tiếp',
        'warning'
      ) as r;
    `)).r;
  });

  assert.equal(resDirect.success, true);
  assert.equal(resDirect.sent_count, 1);

  const notifDirect = await one(`select id from public.notifications where user_id = '${memberAId}' and title = 'Tin nhắn trực tiếp'`);
  assert.ok(notifDirect);
  const popupState = await one(`select display_count from public.notification_popup_states where notification_id = '${notifDirect.id}'`);
  assert.ok(popupState, 'Direct notification must still register in notification_popup_states');
  assert.equal(popupState.display_count, 0);

  // Original broadcast without target_user_id
  const resBroadcast = await asUser(adminId, 'authenticated', async () => {
    return (await one(`
      select public.admin_send_notification(
        null,
        'Tin phát thanh cũ',
        'Nội dung phát thanh cũ',
        'info'
      ) as r;
    `)).r;
  });

  assert.equal(resBroadcast.success, true);
  assert.equal(resBroadcast.target, 'all');

  const notifBroadcast = await one(`select id from public.notifications where title = 'Tin phát thanh cũ' limit 1`);
  assert.ok(notifBroadcast);
  const popupStateBroadcast = await one(`select display_count from public.notification_popup_states where notification_id = '${notifBroadcast.id}'`);
  assert.equal(popupStateBroadcast, undefined, 'Old broadcast must not register popup state');
});

// 15. Codex Round 1 Defect 2: Empty scheduled role audience freezes at 0 and does not grow
await test('Empty scheduled role audience freezes at 0 and does not grow when member changes role', async () => {
  const reqDraft = 'b0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001';
  const reqSend = 'b0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002';

  // Make sure no moderator exists initially
  await db.exec(`update public.profiles set role = 'member' where id = '${modId}';`);

  const draft = (await asUser(adminId, 'authenticated', async () => {
    return (await one(`
      select public.admin_create_notification_campaign(
        '${reqDraft}', 'Tiêu đề kiểm tra rỗng', 'Empty Test Title',
        'Nội dung', 'Body', 'vi', 'role', 'moderator'
      ) as r;
    `)).r;
  })).campaign;

  // Send now when 0 moderators exist
  const sent = (await asUser(adminId, 'authenticated', async () => {
    return (await one(`
      select public.admin_send_now_notification_campaign(
        '${reqSend}', '${draft.id}', ${draft.revision}
      ) as r;
    `)).r;
  })).campaign;

  assert.equal(sent.total_recipients, 0);
  assert.equal(sent.recipient_snapshot_taken, true);

  const initialCount = Number((await db.query(`select count(*) as cnt from public.notification_campaign_recipients where campaign_id = '${draft.id}'`)).rows[0].cnt);
  assert.equal(initialCount, 0);

  // Now promote a member to moderator
  await db.exec(`update public.profiles set role = 'moderator' where id = '${memberAId}';`);

  // Run worker
  const workerRes = await asServiceRole(async () => {
    return (await one(`select public.service_process_notification_campaigns(500, 10, '${draft.id}') as r;`)).r;
  });

  assert.equal(workerRes.notifications_sent, 0);

  const afterCount = Number((await db.query(`select count(*) as cnt from public.notification_campaign_recipients where campaign_id = '${draft.id}'`)).rows[0].cnt);
  assert.equal(afterCount, 0, 'Recipient count must remain 0 and not grow after late role promotion');

  const finalCamp = await one(`select status, sent_count from public.notification_campaigns where id = '${draft.id}'`);
  assert.equal(finalCamp.status, 'completed');
  assert.equal(finalCamp.sent_count, 0);
});

Background execution daemon for notification campaigns fanout and delivery in CrossTest / 12Tester.

## Purpose
When `pg_cron` extension is available in Supabase, notification campaigns are automatically processed every minute via PostgreSQL cron jobs.
In deployment environments where `pg_cron` is not enabled or available, this service worker runs continuously to process due notification campaigns.

## Features
- **In-Flight Guard**: Single concurrency guard prevents execution overlap if a batch takes longer than the tick interval.
- **Completion-Based Scheduling**: Uses `setTimeout` after iteration completion instead of fixed `setInterval`, avoiding worker backlog.
- **Sanitized Logging**: Database passwords, connection strings, and tokens are scrubbed before printing.
- **Configurable Batching**: Allows tuning batch size (recipients per batch) and campaigns per run.

## Setup & Deployment

```bash
cd backend/notification-worker
npm install
```

### Environment Variables
- `DATABASE_URL` (or `SUPABASE_DB_URL`): PostgreSQL connection string (`postgres://...`).
- `DATABASE_SSL`: Set to `'false'` for local testing, or leave default/unset for SSL with self-signed certificate support.

### Run in Foreground (Testing)
```bash
# Single iteration (runs once and exits)
DATABASE_URL="postgres://postgres:password@localhost:5432/postgres" npm run once

# Continuous daemon (checks every 60 seconds)
DATABASE_URL="postgres://postgres:password@localhost:5432/postgres" npm start
```

### Run with PM2 (Production Daemon)
```bash
pm2 start worker-runner.mjs --name notification-worker --env DATABASE_URL="postgres://..." -- --interval=60 --batch=500
```

2: 
3: Document version: `1.0.0`

8: 
9: ## 1. Architectural Principles & Security Rules
10: 
11: 1. **Authentication & Authorization**:
12:    - All admin-facing RPCs strictly enforce unlocked administrator credentials using `public._assert_daily_task_admin()`.
13:    - Denied callers (`anon`, standard `member`, `moderator`, locked `admin`, or missing credentials) immediately raise `FORBIDDEN: Admin access required` or `UNAUTHORIZED: Authentication required`.
14:    - Client roles (`PUBLIC`, `anon`, `authenticated`) have **NO DIRECT PERMISSIONS** on internal campaign tables (`notification_campaigns`, `notification_campaign_recipients`, `notification_campaign_requests`, `notification_campaign_events`). All direct modifications are blocked via RLS and revoked privileges.
15:    - Core background worker functions (`service_process_notification_campaigns`, `service_process_notification_campaign_batch`) are restricted to `service_role` execution only. A bounded, authenticated wrapper (`admin_process_due_notification_campaigns`) is provided for manual admin operation and testing.
16: 
17: 2. **Idempotency & Replay Protection**:
18:    - All state-mutating RPCs require a client-generated UUID `p_request_id`.
19:    - Replaying the same `p_request_id` with an identical payload returns the previous response with `"replayed": true` and **does NOT emit duplicate audit events**.
20:    - Replaying the same `p_request_id` with a mismatched payload or action fails with `REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT` (or `PAYLOAD_MISMATCH`).
21: 
22: 3. **Concurrency & Safe Optimistic Locking (CAS)**:
23:    - Campaign scheduling, updating, sending, and cancelling require `p_expected_revision integer`.
24:    - If the database revision has advanced, the call fails immediately with `REVISION_CONFLICT`.
25: 
26: 4. **Recipient Snapshot & Delivery Semantics**:
27:    - Recipient snapshots are taken deterministically at campaign scheduling / send-now into `public.notification_campaign_recipients`.
28:    - Recipient fanout uses `FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED` on recipient rows to guarantee that concurrent workers and worker restarts never duplicate notifications.
29:    - Batch inserts create rows in `public.notifications` with:
30:      ```json
31:      {
32:        "campaign_id": "uuid",
33:        "broadcast": true,
34:        "sender": "admin"
35:      }
36:      ```
37:    - **No popup states** (`notification_popup_states`) are registered for campaign mass broadcasts, preserving compatibility with 067/069 direct single-user notifications.
38:    - `sent_count` is tracked per recipient receipt. When a user deletes their notification (`public.notifications` row deleted, setting `receipt.notification_id` to NULL), `sent_count` remains stable.
39:    - `read_count` is computed dynamically by joining `notification_campaign_recipients.notification_id` with `public.notifications.is_read = true`.
40: 
41: 5. **Locale Fallback & Content Structure**:
42:    - Campaigns define `title_vi`, `title_en`, `body_vi`, `body_en`, and `default_locale` (`'vi'`, `'en'`, or `'bilingual'`).
43:    - Profile table has no `locale` column; delivered text is resolved from `default_locale`:
44:      - `'vi'`: delivers Vietnamese text (falls back to English if empty).
45:      - `'en'`: delivers English text (falls back to Vietnamese if empty).
46:      - `'bilingual'`: delivers formatted composite text (`title_vi / title_en` and `body_vi \n\n---\n\n body_en`).
47:      - Localized variants are also attached inside `notifications.data`.

## 1. Architectural Principles & Security Rules

1. **Authentication & Authorization**:
   - All admin-facing RPCs strictly enforce unlocked administrator credentials using `public._assert_daily_task_admin()`.
   - Denied callers (`anon`, standard `member`, `moderator`, locked `admin`, or missing credentials) immediately raise `FORBIDDEN: Admin access required` or `UNAUTHORIZED: Authentication required`.
   - Client roles (`PUBLIC`, `anon`, `authenticated`) have **NO DIRECT PERMISSIONS** on internal campaign tables (`notification_campaigns`, `notification_campaign_recipients`, `notification_campaign_requests`, `notification_campaign_events`). All direct modifications are blocked via RLS and revoked privileges.
   - Core background worker functions (`service_process_notification_campaigns`) are restricted to `service_role` execution only. A bounded, authenticated wrapper (`admin_process_due_notification_campaigns`) is provided for manual admin operation and testing.

2. **Idempotency & Replay Protection (Canonical JSON Object Hashing)**:
   - All state-mutating RPCs require a client-generated UUID `p_request_id`.
   - Request-scoped transaction advisory locking (`pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext('notif_req:' || p_request_id))`) serializes concurrent duplicate submissions before lookup, ensuring identical requests receive the committed response instead of unique constraint errors.
   - Cross-admin collision protection: A `p_request_id` already claimed by another administrator raises `REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT: Request ID already claimed by another administrator`.
   - Mutation payloads are hashed using deterministic canonical `jsonb` object serialization (`md5(jsonb_build_object(...)::text)`), preventing delimiter-based hash collisions (e.g. `'A|B', 'C'` vs `'A', 'B|C'`).
   - Replaying the same `p_request_id` with an identical payload returns the previous response with `"replayed": true` and **does NOT emit duplicate audit events**.
   - Replaying the same `p_request_id` with a mismatched payload or action fails with `REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT: Request ID already used with different payload`.

3. **Concurrency & Safe Optimistic Locking (CAS)**:
   - Campaign scheduling, updating, sending, and cancelling require `p_expected_revision integer`.
   - If the database revision has advanced, the call fails immediately with `REVISION_CONFLICT`.

4. **Deterministic Recipient Snapshot & Delivery Semantics**:
   - Recipient snapshots are taken deterministically at campaign scheduling / send-now into `public.notification_campaign_recipients`.
   - The snapshot is frozen with `recipient_snapshot_taken = true` and `snapshot_taken_at = clock_timestamp()`.
   - If an audience has `0` matching recipients at schedule time (e.g. `role = 'moderator'` when zero moderators exist), the zero count is permanently frozen and the campaign completes with 0 delivered. Late profile or role changes will **never** expand a frozen scheduled campaign.
   - Recipient fanout uses `FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED` on recipient rows to guarantee that concurrent workers and worker restarts never duplicate notifications.
   - Batch inserts create rows in `public.notifications` with:
     ```json
     {
       "campaign_id": "uuid",
       "broadcast": true,
       "sender": "admin"
     }
     ```
   - **No popup states** (`notification_popup_states`) are registered for campaign mass broadcasts, preserving compatibility with 067/069 direct single-user notifications.
   - `sent_count` is tracked per recipient receipt. When a user deletes their notification (`public.notifications` row deleted, setting `receipt.notification_id` to NULL), `sent_count` remains stable.
   - `read_count` represents the live read status among extant remaining notifications (`r.notification_id = n.id AND n.is_read = true`). It reflects current user read state rather than an immutable delivery receipt.

5. **Locale Fallback & Content Structure**:
   - Campaigns define `title_vi`, `title_en`, `body_vi`, `body_en`, and `default_locale` (`'vi'`, `'en'`, or `'bilingual'`).
   - Profile table has no `locale` column; delivered text is resolved from `default_locale`:
     - `'vi'`: delivers Vietnamese text (falls back to English if empty).
     - `'en'`: delivers English text (falls back to Vietnamese if empty).
     - `'bilingual'`: delivers formatted composite text (`title_vi / title_en` and `body_vi \n\n---\n\n body_en`).
     - Localized variants are also attached inside `notifications.data`.

6. **Common Admin Audit Integration Interface**:
   - Dedicated event logging is maintained in `public.notification_campaign_events`.
   - When core admin migration `070_admin_management.sql` is active with `admin_action_events`, campaigns can seamlessly dual-write or bridge actions (`campaign_create`, `campaign_schedule`, `campaign_cancel`, `campaign_send_now`) into the unified admin audit log using the caller's admin UID and request ID.

## 3. Database Schema and Architecture

### 3.1 Tables Added in Staged 072
1. `public.notification_campaigns`:
   - Stores draft, queued, sending, completed, and cancelled campaigns.
   - Enforces content lengths (`title_vi/en`: 1..200 chars; `body_vi/en`: 1..2000 chars), valid locales (`vi`, `en`, `bilingual`), audience types (`all`, `role`, `selected_users`), and optimistic locking via `revision`.
   - Stores immutable administrative attribution (`created_by`, `cancelled_by`, `cancel_reason`, timestamps).
2. `public.notification_campaign_recipients`:
   - Deterministic recipient snapshot populated at scheduling / send-now.
   - Unique constraint `(campaign_id, user_id)` ensures idempotent fanout.
   - Foreign key to `public.notifications(id) ON DELETE SET NULL` preserves delivery receipts even if individual notification rows are deleted by users.
3. `public.notification_campaign_requests`:
   - Mutation idempotency ledger storing `request_id`, `admin_id`, `action`, `payload_hash`, and cached `response_json`.
   - Replayed requests return previous outcome with `"replayed": true` and do not emit duplicate audit events.
   - Mismatched payloads fail with `REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT`.
4. `public.notification_campaign_events`:
   - Append-only audit trail logging all lifecycle actions (`created`, `updated`, `scheduled`, `send_now_requested`, `cancelled`, `worker_started`, `worker_completed`).
5. `public.notification_worker_heartbeats`:
   - Records execution metrics and timestamp for scheduler health monitoring.

### 3.2 Security and RLS
- All new tables have Row Level Security enabled.
- All direct privileges (`SELECT`, `INSERT`, `UPDATE`, `DELETE`) on campaign tables are revoked from `PUBLIC`, `anon`, and `authenticated`.
- Internal helper functions (`_notif_resolve_delivered_content`, `_notif_snapshot_recipients`, `_notif_campaign_to_jsonb`) have execution revoked from client roles.
- All admin RPCs call `public._assert_daily_task_admin()` to enforce unlocked administrator role.
- Background worker `service_process_notification_campaigns` is executable by `service_role` only.

### 3.3 Delivery & Fanout Semantics
- Worker uses `FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED` on `notification_campaign_recipients`. Concurrent worker workers process non-overlapping subsets without collisions.
- Notifications are inserted with `broadcast: true` and `sender: 'admin'`. **No popup states** (`notification_popup_states`) are registered for mass broadcasts.
- `sent_count` is derived from recipient delivery receipts and remains stable when notifications are deleted.
- `read_count` is dynamically calculated by joining `notification_campaign_recipients.notification_id` with `public.notifications.is_read = true`.

## 3. Confirmed Defects and Review Points Resolved

### 3.1 Defect 1: Delimiter-Based Payload Hash Collision
- **Problem**: Hashing via `md5(concat_ws('|', ...))` allowed collisions such as `title_vi='A|B', title_en='C'` vs `title_vi='A', title_en='B|C'`.
- **Fix**: Replaced all mutation payload fingerprints with canonical `jsonb` object hashing (`md5(jsonb_build_object(...)::text)`). Keys and values are escaped and ordered deterministically.
- **Request Advisory Locking**: Added `PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext('notif_req:' || p_request_id::text))` before idempotency lookup. Concurrent requests with the same `request_id` wait and return the committed result without unique constraint violations.
- **Cross-Admin Safety**: Added check `IF v_existing_req.admin_id <> v_admin_id THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT: Request ID already claimed by another administrator'; END IF;`.

### 3.2 Defect 2: Re-snapshotting Zero-Recipient Audiences
- **Problem**: Worker checked `IF v_camp.total_recipients = 0 THEN _notif_snapshot_recipients(...)`. When a campaign was scheduled for an empty role audience (e.g. 0 moderators), and a member later became a moderator, the worker re-snapshotted and delivered notifications instead of respecting the frozen count of 0.
- **Fix**: Added `recipient_snapshot_taken boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false` and `snapshot_taken_at timestamptz` to `public.notification_campaigns`. Once scheduled or sent-now, `recipient_snapshot_taken` is permanently set to `true`. The worker only snapshots if `NOT v_camp.recipient_snapshot_taken`. If the frozen snapshot has 0 recipients, the worker marks the campaign `completed` with 0 sent and exits.

### 3.3 Scoped Review Points
- **Filter Whitelist Validation**: `admin_list_notification_campaigns` and `admin_list_notification_campaign_recipients` explicitly validate `p_status` and `p_audience_type` against valid enums and raise clear errors on unknown inputs.
- **Cursor Format Protection**: Keyset cursors validate format (`ISO8601|uuid`), reject missing delimiters, and reject malformed/`infinity`/`-infinity`/`NaN` timestamps.
- **Bounded Event Logs**: `admin_get_notification_campaign_detail` accepts optional `p_events_limit` (clamped to 1..100, default 50).
- **Read Count Semantics**: Contract updated to clarify that `read_count` reflects live read status among remaining/extant notifications in `public.notifications`. `sent_count` remains stable even after notification row deletion.
- **Service Worker Packaging**: Packaged standalone service under `backend/notification-worker/` with `package.json`, in-flight guard, completion-based `setTimeout` loop, and credential-scrubbed logging.
- **Scheduler Readiness**: `admin_get_notification_scheduler_health` exposes `scheduler_ready: boolean`, allowing the frontend to know whether pg_cron or daemon heartbeat is actively processing queues.

1: # Hợp đồng API và DTO Quản Trị Viên (Admin Management Stage A)

8: ## 1. Quy ước chung
9: 1. **Xác thực và phân quyền (Authorization)**:
10:    - Mọi RPC quản trị yêu cầu phiên xác thực (`auth.uid() IS NOT NULL`).
11:    - Yêu cầu tài khoản có `role = 'admin'` và `is_locked = false`. Bất kỳ vi phạm nào đều bị từ chối với lỗi `PERMISSION_DENIED` hoặc `NOT_AUTHENTICATED`.
12:    - Các mutation quan trọng yêu cầu `p_request_id` (UUIDv4) để chống double-submit và hỗ trợ replay idempotency.
13:    - Thao tác quản lý quyền Admin (`admin_set_user_role` thành `admin` hoặc từ `admin` thành vai trò khác) yêu cầu capability riêng `admin_management` trong bảng `admin_capabilities`.
14: 2. **Quy ước phân trang (Cursor Pagination)**:
15:    - Các API danh sách trả về định dạng chuẩn:
16:      ```json
17:      {
18:        "items": [ ... ],
19:        "has_more": true,
20:        "next_cursor": {
21:          "created_at": "2026-11-01T10:00:00Z",
22:          "id": "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111"
23:        }
24:      }
25:      ```
26:    - Khi `has_more` là `false`, `next_cursor` luôn là `null`.
27:    - Giới hạn trang `limit`: mặc định 50, giới hạn trong khoảng `1 <= limit <= 100` (đối với danh sách ngày nhiệm vụ: `1 <= limit <= 60`, mặc định 14).
28:    - Con trỏ sắp xếp cố định theo `(created_at DESC, id DESC)` hoặc `(task_date DESC)`.
29: 3. **An toàn kiểu dữ liệu**:
30:    - Khóa chính, ID người dùng, ID chiến dịch, ID báo cáo dùng chuỗi UUID định dạng chuẩn.
31:    - Các ID bigint (như policy ID, revision) được chuyển đổi thành chuỗi hoặc số nguyên an toàn đối với Android / Kotlin / kotlinx.serialization.

### 4.2 `admin_schedule_carryover_policy`
Lên lịch chính sách cộng dồn từ một ngày tương lai (phải lớn hơn ngày hôm nay theo giờ Việt Nam).

- **RPC Name**: `public.admin_schedule_carryover_policy`
- **Caller Guard**: Unlocked Admin
- **Tham số**:
  - `p_effective_from` (`date`, required): Ngày bắt đầu áp dụng (`> VN today`)
  - `p_is_enabled` (`boolean`, required): Bật (`true`) hoặc tắt (`false`)
  - `p_operator_note` (`text`, required): Ghi chú lý do của quản trị viên
  - `p_expected_revision` (`bigint`, optional): Phiên bản revision hiện tại để chống xung đột ghi đè
  - `p_request_id` (`uuid`, optional): Mã định danh yêu cầu chống trùng
- **Trả về**:
  ```json
  {
    "success": true,
    "effective_from": "2026-11-05",
    "is_enabled": false,
    "operator_note": "Tạm tắt cộng dồn bảo trì",
    "revision": "5"
  }
  ```
- **Lỗi có thể xảy ra**:
  - `CANNOT_MODIFY_HISTORICAL_POLICY`: Ngày hiệu lực không thuộc tương lai
  - `REVISION_CONFLICT`: Revision đã thay đổi trước khi lưu
  - `INVALID_EFFECTIVE_DATE`: Ngày hiệu lực không hợp lệ

### 4.3 `admin_cancel_future_carryover_policy`
Hủy một chính sách tương lai đã lên lịch trước đó.

- **RPC Name**: `public.admin_cancel_future_carryover_policy`
- **Caller Guard**: Unlocked Admin
- **Tham số**:
  - `p_effective_from` (`date`, required): Ngày hiệu lực cần hủy (`> VN today`)
  - `p_reason` (`text`, required): Lý do hủy bỏ
  - `p_expected_revision` (`bigint`, optional): Revision dự kiến
  - `p_request_id` (`uuid`, optional): Mã định danh yêu cầu
- **Trả về**:
  ```json
  {
    "success": true,
    "cancelled_date": "2026-11-05",
    "reason": "Hủy bỏ lịch tắt bảo trì",
    "revision": "6"
  }
  ```
- **Lỗi có thể xảy ra**:
  - `POLICY_NOT_FOUND`: Không tìm thấy chính sách tương lai ứng với ngày đã cho
  - `CANNOT_CANCEL_NON_FUTURE_POLICY`: Không được hủy chính sách hiện hành hoặc quá khứ

## 6. Nhóm 5: Bồi hoàn Credit an toàn (Credit Compensation)

### 6.1 `admin_compensate_credits`
Thực hiện bồi hoàn hoặc điều chỉnh credit kèm Request ID chống trùng lặp và liên kết giao dịch/khiếu nại gốc.

- **RPC Name**: `public.admin_compensate_credits`
- **Caller Guard**: Unlocked Admin
- **Tham số**:
  - `p_request_id` (`uuid`, required): Mã UUID yêu cầu duy nhất từ client
  - `p_target_user_id` (`uuid`, required): ID người dùng nhận bồi hoàn
  - `p_amount` (`integer`, required): Số credit điều chỉnh (khác 0)
  - `p_reason` (`text`, required): Lý do bồi hoàn cụ thể
  - `p_original_credit_log_id` (`uuid`, optional): ID giao dịch credit gốc liên quan
  - `p_contact_report_id` (`uuid`, optional): ID báo cáo khiếu nại liên quan
- **Trả về**:
  ```json
  {
    "success": true,
    "request_id": "99999999-...",
    "user_id": "22222222-...",
    "previous_credits": 100,
    "new_credits": 120,
    "amount": 20,
    "reason": "Bồi hoàn báo cáo bị trừ sai ngày 30/10",
    "original_credit_log_id": null,
    "contact_report_id": null,
    "is_replay": false
  }
  ```
- **Hành vi Idempotency**:
  - Nếu gửi lại cùng `p_request_id` và cùng bộ tham số payload: Trả về kết quả ban đầu với `is_replay: true`.
  - Nếu gửi lại cùng `p_request_id` nhưng khác tham số: Báo lỗi `REQUEST_ID_PAYLOAD_MISMATCH`.

## 7. Nhóm 6: Phân quyền & Quản lý vai trò (Role Management)

### 7.1 `admin_set_user_role`
Thay đổi vai trò người dùng (`member`, `moderator`, `admin`).

- **RPC Name**: `public.admin_set_user_role`
- **Caller Guard**: Unlocked Admin (và capability `admin_management` nếu liên quan tới vai trò `admin`)
- **Tham số**:
  - `p_target_user_id` (`uuid`, required): ID người dùng cần đổi vai trò
  - `p_new_role` (`text`, required): Vai trò mới (`member`, `moderator`, `admin`)
  - `p_reason` (`text`, required): Lý do thay đổi vai trò
  - `p_request_id` (`uuid`, optional): Mã yêu cầu chống trùng
- **Trả về**:
  ```json
  {
    "success": true,
    "user_id": "33333333-...",
    "previous_role": "member",
    "new_role": "moderator",
    "reason": "Bổ nhiệm điều hành viên hỗ trợ duyệt báo cáo"
  }
  ```
- **Ràng buộc an toàn**:
  - `CANNOT_CHANGE_OWN_ROLE`: Admin không được tự đổi vai trò của chính mình.
  - `INSUFFICIENT_PRIVILEGE`: Thao tác bổ nhiệm hoặc hạ quyền `admin` đòi hỏi capability `admin_management`.
  - `CANNOT_REMOVE_LAST_ADMIN`: Không thể hạ quyền Admin nếu đây là Admin chưa bị khóa cuối cùng của hệ thống.
  - `USER_NOT_FOUND`: Người dùng mục tiêu không tồn tại.

2. Tìm kiếm thành viên từ server có pagination; member detail gồm nhiệm vụ/credit/warnings/campaigns/slots, xử lý compensation và role phù hợp quyền.
3. Carryover trong thẻ Nhiệm vụ ngày; campaign search, pending report queue, audit, notification composer/history và monitor; điều hướng thẻ hỗ trợ vào màn hình đã có.
4. Xử lý empty/loading/error/retry, giữ selection theo ID, chống double-submit, stale search và phản hồi sau đổi phiên. Không tự retry mutation không có request ID.
5. Không để screen lớn, chữ lớn hoặc nested scrolling che thao tác.

Nghiệm thu B: compile/assembleDebug, các test admin/popup/session/cache hiện có và tests hành vi mới cho phân trang/race/request ID; probe layout phù hợp. UI và resource không chứa text mới hardcode.

### C. Policy thưởng/phạt và phí dùng thật

1. Versioned policy có schema/validation riêng cho credit khởi tạo, phần trăm phạt, phí đẩy app, giá slot/thời hạn, thưởng báo cáo và thưởng cập nhật app.
2. Mọi nhánh SQL tiêu thụ policy: create profile, finalize daily penalty, push/renew slot, report submit/approve/reject/auto-approve, app-update publish/claim/refund. Snapshot policy/amount tại thời điểm phát sinh nghĩa vụ. Không sửa số dư lịch sử hoặc thay đổi lịch sử đã chốt.
3. Client đọc policy/báo giá từ server cho hiển thị và xác nhận; loại bỏ các check cứng làm mâu thuẫn với server. Quote/revision + request ID cho giao dịch nhạy cảm, có phương án tương thích client cũ; không chỉ sửa label.
4. Form admin xem/schedule/cancel/history + revision; giữ default giá trị hiện hành khi chưa đặt policy mới.

Nghiệm thu C: test trước/sau ngày hiệu lực, lịch sử cũ, release escrow/paid/refunded cân đối, provisional/rejection clawback không vượt số đã cấp, slot/push display và số bị trừ thống nhất, timezone và concurrency.

### D. Review độc lập và vòng sửa

- Codex đọc diff mới so với checkpoint, review RPC privilege, tình huống tài chính và luồng phiên/client.

148:     /**
149:      * Schedules the daily 20:00 check-in reminder. The first run is aligned to
150:      * the next 20:00, then repeats every 24h. Note: WorkManager guarantees
151:      * *at-least-daily* delivery, not an exact clock time â€” on some devices the
152:      * notification may arrive a bit after 20:00 (Doze / battery optimization).
153:      */
154:     fun scheduleDailyReminder() {
155:         val now = LocalDateTime.now()
156:         var nextRun = now.toLocalDate().atTime(LocalTime.of(20, 0))
157:         if (!nextRun.isAfter(now)) {
158:             nextRun = nextRun.plusDays(1)
159:         }
160:         val initialDelayMinutes = Duration.between(now, nextRun).toMinutes().coerceAtLeast(1)
161: 
162:         val request = PeriodicWorkRequestBuilder<ReminderWorker>(24, TimeUnit.HOURS)
163:             .setInitialDelay(initialDelayMinutes, TimeUnit.MINUTES)
164:             .addTag(REMINDER_TAG)
165:             .build()
166: 
167:         WorkManager.getInstance(this).enqueueUniquePeriodicWork(
168:             REMINDER_WORK_NAME,
169:             ExistingPeriodicWorkPolicy.KEEP,
170:             request,
171:         )
172:     }

192:             request,

197:      * Single sign-out path used by every screen: clears the remote session

211:         ImageHashHelper.clearCache()

216:             // áº¢nh remote (screenshot/icon) vÃ  áº£nh Ä‘ang chá» ná»™p khÃ´ng Ä‘Æ°á»£c
217:             // tá»“n táº¡i sau khi Ä‘á»•i tÃ i khoáº£n.
218:             val loader = coil.Coil.imageLoader(this@TestCheoApp)
219:             loader.memoryCache?.clear()
220:             loader.diskCache?.clear()
221:             PreparedScreenshotCache.clear(this@TestCheoApp)
222:             PendingReportStore.clear(this@TestCheoApp)
223:         }
224:     }

247:         fun observeAuthSession(
248:             scope: kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope,
249:             context: android.content.Context,
250:             sessionStatus: kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow<io.github.jan.supabase.auth.status.SessionStatus>,
251:             currentUserIdProvider: () -> String? = { null }
252:         ): kotlinx.coroutines.Job {
253:             return scope.launch {
254:                 sessionStatus.collect { status ->
255:                     when (status) {
256:                         is io.github.jan.supabase.auth.status.SessionStatus.Authenticated -> {
257:                             val uid = status.session.user?.id ?: currentUserIdProvider()
258:                             if (!uid.isNullOrBlank()) {
259:                                 ScreenshotManager.onUserSessionChanged(uid, context)
260:                             }
261:                         }
262:                         is io.github.jan.supabase.auth.status.SessionStatus.NotAuthenticated -> {
263:                             ScreenshotManager.onUserSignedOut(context)
264:                         }
265:                         else -> {
266:                             // Initializing hoặc RefreshFailure: chờ trạng thái tiếp theo
267:                         }
268:                     }
269:                 }
270:             }
271:         }

    /**
     * Schedules the daily 20:00 check-in reminder. The first run is aligned to
     * the next 20:00, then repeats every 24h. Note: WorkManager guarantees
     * *at-least-daily* delivery, not an exact clock time â€” on some devices the
     * notification may arrive a bit after 20:00 (Doze / battery optimization).
     */
    fun scheduleDailyReminder() {
        val now = LocalDateTime.now()
        var nextRun = now.toLocalDate().atTime(LocalTime.of(20, 0))
        if (!nextRun.isAfter(now)) {
            nextRun = nextRun.plusDays(1)
        }
        val initialDelayMinutes = Duration.between(now, nextRun).toMinutes().coerceAtLeast(1)

        val request = PeriodicWorkRequestBuilder<ReminderWorker>(24, TimeUnit.HOURS)
            .setInitialDelay(initialDelayMinutes, TimeUnit.MINUTES)
            .addTag(REMINDER_TAG)
            .build()

        WorkManager.getInstance(this).enqueueUniquePeriodicWork(
            REMINDER_WORK_NAME,
            ExistingPeriodicWorkPolicy.KEEP,
            request,
        )
    }

    fun cancelDailyReminder() {
        WorkManager.getInstance(this).cancelUniqueWork(REMINDER_WORK_NAME)
    }

    /**
     * Checks the remote app config in the background (every 12h, first run after
     * ~10 minutes) and notifies when a newer version is available. The in-app
     * launch check (MainActivity) still handles blocking force updates.
     */
    fun scheduleUpdateCheck() {
        val request = PeriodicWorkRequestBuilder<UpdateCheckWorker>(12, TimeUnit.HOURS)
            .setInitialDelay(10, TimeUnit.MINUTES)
            .addTag(UPDATE_CHECK_TAG)
            .build()

        WorkManager.getInstance(this).enqueueUniquePeriodicWork(
            UPDATE_CHECK_WORK_NAME,
            ExistingPeriodicWorkPolicy.KEEP,
            request,
        )
    }

    /**
     * Single sign-out path used by every screen: clears the remote session
     * (best effort), the in-memory repository cache and the on-disk session
     * snapshot so the next user/guest never sees the previous account's data.
     */
    @OptIn(ExperimentalCoilApi::class)
    suspend fun performSignOut() {
        try {
            authRepository.signOut()
        } catch (_: Exception) {
            // Even if the remote sign-out fails (e.g. offline), clear local state.
        }
        campaignRepository.clearMemoryCache()
        SessionCacheManager.clear(this)
        ScreenshotManager.clear(this)
        ImageHashHelper.clearCache()
        if (::reportSubmitManager.isInitialized) {
            reportSubmitManager.cancelAllPendingWork()
        }
        withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
            // áº¢nh remote (screenshot/icon) vÃ  áº£nh Ä‘ang chá» ná»™p khÃ´ng Ä‘Æ°á»£c
            // tá»“n táº¡i sau khi Ä‘á»•i tÃ i khoáº£n.
            val loader = coil.Coil.imageLoader(this@TestCheoApp)
            loader.memoryCache?.clear()
            loader.diskCache?.clear()
            PreparedScreenshotCache.clear(this@TestCheoApp)
            PendingReportStore.clear(this@TestCheoApp)
        }
    }

    companion object {
        @Volatile

        fun get(): TestCheoApp? = instance

        const val REMINDER_WORK_NAME = "daily_checkin_reminder"
        const val REMINDER_TAG = "checkin_reminder"
        const val UPDATE_CHECK_WORK_NAME = "app_update_check"
        const val UPDATE_CHECK_TAG = "app_update_check"

        fun observeAuthSession(
            scope: kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope,
            context: android.content.Context,
            authRepository: AuthRepository
        ): kotlinx.coroutines.Job {
            return observeAuthSession(scope, context, authRepository.sessionStatus) {
                authRepository.currentUserId()
            }
        }

        fun observeAuthSession(
            scope: kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope,
            context: android.content.Context,
            sessionStatus: kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow<io.github.jan.supabase.auth.status.SessionStatus>,
            currentUserIdProvider: () -> String? = { null }
        ): kotlinx.coroutines.Job {
            return scope.launch {
                sessionStatus.collect { status ->
                    when (status) {
                        is io.github.jan.supabase.auth.status.SessionStatus.Authenticated -> {
                            val uid = status.session.user?.id ?: currentUserIdProvider()
                            if (!uid.isNullOrBlank()) {
                                ScreenshotManager.onUserSessionChanged(uid, context)
                            }
                        }
                        is io.github.jan.supabase.auth.status.SessionStatus.NotAuthenticated -> {
                            ScreenshotManager.onUserSignedOut(context)
                        }
                        else -> {
                            // Initializing hoặc RefreshFailure: chờ trạng thái tiếp theo
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

275:                 AdminFilter.ADMIN -> u.isAdmin
276:             }

enum class AdminFilter {
    ALL, ACTIVE, LOCKED, ADMIN
}

data class AdminUsersUiState(
    val isLoading: Boolean = true,
    val isActionLoading: Boolean = false,
    val allUsers: List<Profile> = emptyList(),
    val filteredUsers: List<Profile> = emptyList(),
    val query: String = "",
    val filter: AdminFilter = AdminFilter.ALL,
    val error: String? = null,
    val actionMessage: String? = null,
    val currentAdminId: String? = null,
    val sessionGeneration: Long = 0L,
    val appConfig: AppConfig? = null,
