    private fun parseBackendError(e: Throwable): String {
        val msg = e.message.orEmpty()
        return when {
            "INSUFFICIENT_PRIVILEGE" in msg -> localizer.get(R.string.admin_role_insufficient_privilege)
            "CANNOT_CHANGE_OWN_ROLE" in msg -> localizer.get(R.string.admin_role_cannot_change_self)
            "CANNOT_REMOVE_LAST_ADMIN" in msg -> localizer.get(R.string.admin_role_cannot_remove_last_admin)
            else -> friendlyError(e, localizer)
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun creditAndLockActionsStayReadableAtNarrowWidthsAndLargeFonts() {
        val output = mutableListOf<String>()
        val testUser = Profile(id = "member", displayName = "Nguyễn Văn An", email = "an@example.com", createdAt = "2026-11-01")
        for (width in listOf(320, 360, 411)) for (fontScale in listOf(1f, 1.3f, 2f)) {
            val textNodes = measureCard(width, fontScale, testUser, isCurrentAdmin = false)
            assertTrue("No text was composed at width=$width, fontScale=$fontScale", textNodes.isNotEmpty())

            val creditNode = textNodes.firstOrNull { it.text == "Tặng / Trừ Credit" }
            assertNotNull("Credit button label 'Tặng / Trừ Credit' missing at width=$width, fontScale=$fontScale", creditNode)
            assertTrue(
                "Credit button label 'Tặng / Trừ Credit' has zero width at width=$width, fontScale=$fontScale (bounds=${creditNode!!.bounds})",
                creditNode.bounds.width > 0f && creditNode.bounds.height > 0f
            )
            assertFalse(
                "Credit button label 'Tặng / Trừ Credit' is ellipsized at width=$width, fontScale=$fontScale",
                creditNode.isEllipsized
            )

            val lockNode = textNodes.firstOrNull { it.text == "Khóa tài khoản" }
            assertNotNull("Lock button label 'Khóa tài khoản' missing at width=$width, fontScale=$fontScale", lockNode)
            assertTrue(
                "Lock button label 'Khóa tài khoản' has zero width at width=$width, fontScale=$fontScale (bounds=${lockNode!!.bounds})",
                lockNode.bounds.width > 0f && lockNode.bounds.height > 0f
            )
            assertFalse(
                "Lock button label 'Khóa tài khoản' is ellipsized at width=$width, fontScale=$fontScale",
                lockNode.isEllipsized
            )

            val serialized = textNodes.map { "${it.text}:bounds=${it.bounds};ellipsis=${it.isEllipsized}" }
            output += "width=$width;fontScale=$fontScale\n" + serialized.joinToString("\n")
        }
        File("F:/AI/12Tester/audit/admin-expansion-2026-11-01/member-layout-baseline.txt").writeText(output.joinToString("\n\n"))
    }

    @Test
    fun testLockedMemberUnlockActionNoEllipsisAcrossWidthsAndFontScales() {
        val lockedUser = Profile(id = "member_locked", displayName = "Trần Thị B", email = "b@example.com", isLocked = true, createdAt = "2026-11-01")
        for (width in listOf(320, 360, 411)) for (fontScale in listOf(1f, 1.3f, 2f)) {
            val textNodes = measureCard(width, fontScale, lockedUser, isCurrentAdmin = false)
            val creditNode = textNodes.firstOrNull { it.text == "Tặng / Trừ Credit" }
            assertNotNull("Credit label missing for locked user at width=$width, fontScale=$fontScale", creditNode)
            assertFalse("Credit label ellipsized for locked user at width=$width, fontScale=$fontScale", creditNode!!.isEllipsized)
            assertTrue("Credit label bounds empty for locked user at width=$width, fontScale=$fontScale", creditNode.bounds.width > 0f)

            val unlockNode = textNodes.firstOrNull { it.text == "Mở khóa" }
            assertNotNull("Unlock label missing at width=$width, fontScale=$fontScale", unlockNode)
            assertFalse("Unlock label ellipsized at width=$width, fontScale=$fontScale", unlockNode!!.isEllipsized)
            assertTrue("Unlock label bounds empty at width=$width, fontScale=$fontScale", unlockNode.bounds.width > 0f)
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun testCurrentAdminCardHasNoSelfLockAction() {
        val adminUser = Profile(id = "admin_self", displayName = "Admin User", email = "admin@example.com", role = "admin", createdAt = "2026-11-01")
        for (width in listOf(320, 360, 411)) for (fontScale in listOf(1f, 1.3f, 2f)) {
            val textNodes = measureCard(width, fontScale, adminUser, isCurrentAdmin = true)
            val creditNode = textNodes.firstOrNull { it.text == "Tặng / Trừ Credit" }
            assertNotNull("Credit label missing for admin at width=$width, fontScale=$fontScale", creditNode)
            assertFalse("Credit label ellipsized for admin at width=$width, fontScale=$fontScale", creditNode!!.isEllipsized)
            assertTrue("Credit label bounds empty for admin at width=$width, fontScale=$fontScale", creditNode.bounds.width > 0f)

            val lockNode = textNodes.firstOrNull { it.text == "Khóa tài khoản" || it.text == "Mở khóa" }
            assertNull("Admin should not have lock/unlock button for their own card at width=$width, fontScale=$fontScale", lockNode)
        }
    }

import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import com.ntt.crosstest.R
import com.ntt.crosstest.data.AdminCarryoverPoliciesResult
import com.ntt.crosstest.data.AdminCarryoverPolicyItem
import com.ntt.crosstest.data.AdminManagementRepository
import com.ntt.crosstest.data.AuthRepository
import com.ntt.crosstest.data.Localizer
import com.ntt.crosstest.data.SessionCacheManager
import com.ntt.crosstest.util.VnTime
import io.github.jan.supabase.auth.status.SessionStatus
import kotlinx.coroutines.CancellationException
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.update
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import java.util.UUID
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicLong

data class CarryoverPolicyUiState(
    val isLoading: Boolean = true,
    val isSaving: Boolean = false,
    val isCancelling: Boolean = false,
    val activePolicy: AdminCarryoverPolicyItem? = null,
    val futurePolicies: List<AdminCarryoverPolicyItem> = emptyList(),
    val history: List<AdminCarryoverPolicyItem> = emptyList(),
    val revision: String? = null,
    val draftEffectiveFrom: String = VnTime.today().plusDays(1).toString(),
    val draftIsEnabled: Boolean = true,
    val draftNote: String = "",
    val error: String? = null,
    val actionMessage: String? = null,
    val currentAdminId: String? = null,
    val sessionGeneration: Long = 0L,
)

class CarryoverPolicyViewModel(
    private val adminManagementRepository: AdminManagementRepository,
    private val authRepository: AuthRepository,
    private val localizer: Localizer,
) : ViewModel() {

    private val _uiState = MutableStateFlow(CarryoverPolicyUiState())
    val uiState: StateFlow<CarryoverPolicyUiState> = _uiState.asStateFlow()

    private val loadSeq = AtomicLong(0L)
    private val actionSeq = AtomicLong(0L)
    private val isActionInProgress = AtomicBoolean(false)
    private val activeActionToken = AtomicLong(0L)

    private var activeUserId: String? = authRepository.currentUserId()
    private var activeGeneration: Long = SessionCacheManager.currentGeneration()

    private var lastSchedulePayload: String? = null
    private var scheduleRequestId: String = UUID.randomUUID().toString()

    private var lastCancelPayload: String? = null
    private var cancelRequestId: String = UUID.randomUUID().toString()

    init {
        _uiState.update { it.copy(currentAdminId = activeUserId, sessionGeneration = activeGeneration) }
        observeSession()
        loadPolicies()
    }

    private fun checkSessionChanged(reqUid: String?, reqGen: Long): Boolean {
        val curUid = authRepository.currentUserId()
        val curGen = SessionCacheManager.currentGeneration()
        if (reqUid != curUid || reqGen != curGen) {
            handleSessionReset(curUid, curGen)
            return true
        }
        return false
    }

    private fun observeSession() {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            authRepository.sessionStatus.collect { status ->
                when (status) {
                    is SessionStatus.Authenticated -> {
                        val newUid = authRepository.currentUserId()
                        val newGen = SessionCacheManager.currentGeneration()
                        if (newUid != activeUserId || newGen != activeGeneration) {
                            handleSessionReset(newUid, newGen)
                            loadPolicies()
                        }
                    }
                    is SessionStatus.NotAuthenticated -> {
                        val newGen = SessionCacheManager.currentGeneration()
                        handleSessionReset(null, newGen)
                    }
                    else -> {}
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private fun handleSessionReset(newUid: String?, newGen: Long) {
        activeUserId = newUid
        activeGeneration = newGen
        loadSeq.incrementAndGet()
        actionSeq.incrementAndGet()
        activeActionToken.set(0L)
        isActionInProgress.set(false)
        lastSchedulePayload = null
        scheduleRequestId = UUID.randomUUID().toString()
        lastCancelPayload = null
        cancelRequestId = UUID.randomUUID().toString()

        _uiState.update {
            CarryoverPolicyUiState(
                currentAdminId = newUid,
                sessionGeneration = newGen,
                isLoading = false,
            )
        }
    }

    private fun releaseActionGuard(token: Long) {
        if (activeActionToken.compareAndSet(token, 0L)) {
            isActionInProgress.set(false)
        }
    }

    fun clearMessages() {
        _uiState.update { it.copy(error = null, actionMessage = null) }
    }

    fun setDraft(effectiveFrom: String? = null, isEnabled: Boolean? = null, note: String? = null) {
        _uiState.update {
            it.copy(
                draftEffectiveFrom = effectiveFrom ?: it.draftEffectiveFrom,
                draftIsEnabled = isEnabled ?: it.draftIsEnabled,
                draftNote = note ?: it.draftNote,
            )
        }
    }

    fun loadPolicies(preserveDraft: Boolean = true) {
        val curUid = authRepository.currentUserId()
        val curGen = SessionCacheManager.currentGeneration()
        val seq = loadSeq.incrementAndGet()
        _uiState.update { it.copy(isLoading = true, error = null) }

        viewModelScope.launch {
            if (checkSessionChanged(curUid, curGen) || seq != loadSeq.get()) return@launch
            try {
                val res = adminManagementRepository.getCarryoverPolicies()
                if (checkSessionChanged(curUid, curGen) || seq != loadSeq.get()) return@launch

                _uiState.update { state ->
                    val defaultTomorrow = VnTime.today().plusDays(1).toString()
                    state.copy(
                        isLoading = false,
                        activePolicy = res.active,
                        futurePolicies = res.future,
                        history = res.history,
                        revision = res.revision,
                        draftEffectiveFrom = if (preserveDraft) state.draftEffectiveFrom else defaultTomorrow,
                        draftIsEnabled = if (preserveDraft) state.draftIsEnabled else true,
                        draftNote = if (preserveDraft) state.draftNote else "",
                    )
                }
            } catch (e: CancellationException) {
                if (!checkSessionChanged(curUid, curGen) && seq == loadSeq.get()) {
                    _uiState.update { it.copy(isLoading = false) }
                }
                throw e
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                if (checkSessionChanged(curUid, curGen) || seq != loadSeq.get()) return@launch
                _uiState.update {
                    it.copy(
                        isLoading = false,
                        error = friendlyError(e, localizer),
                    )
                }
            }
        }
    }

    fun schedulePolicy(effectiveFrom: String, isEnabled: Boolean, note: String) {
        val curUid = authRepository.currentUserId()
        val curGen = SessionCacheManager.currentGeneration()

        val token = actionSeq.incrementAndGet()
        if (!isActionInProgress.compareAndSet(false, true)) return
        activeActionToken.set(token)
        _uiState.update { it.copy(isSaving = true, error = null, actionMessage = null) }

        val payload = "$effectiveFrom:$isEnabled:${note.trim()}"
        if (payload != lastSchedulePayload) {
            scheduleRequestId = UUID.randomUUID().toString()
            lastSchedulePayload = payload
        }
        val reqId = scheduleRequestId
        val expectedRev = _uiState.value.revision?.toLongOrNull()

        viewModelScope.launch {
            if (checkSessionChanged(curUid, curGen) || token != activeActionToken.get()) {
                releaseActionGuard(token)
                return@launch
            }
            try {
                val res = adminManagementRepository.scheduleCarryoverPolicy(
                    effectiveFrom = effectiveFrom,
                    isEnabled = isEnabled,
                    operatorNote = note.trim(),
                    expectedRevision = expectedRev,
                    requestId = reqId,
                )
                if (checkSessionChanged(curUid, curGen) || token != activeActionToken.get()) return@launch

                lastSchedulePayload = null
                scheduleRequestId = UUID.randomUUID().toString()

                _uiState.update {
                    it.copy(
                        isSaving = false,
                        actionMessage = localizer.get(R.string.admin_carryover_schedule_success),
                        draftNote = "",
                        draftEffectiveFrom = VnTime.today().plusDays(1).toString(),
                    )
                }
                loadPolicies(preserveDraft = false)
            } catch (e: CancellationException) {
                if (!checkSessionChanged(curUid, curGen) && token == activeActionToken.get()) {
                    _uiState.update { it.copy(isSaving = false) }
                }
                throw e
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                if (checkSessionChanged(curUid, curGen) || token != activeActionToken.get()) return@launch
                val errMsg = friendlyError(e, localizer)
                _uiState.update {
                    it.copy(
                        isSaving = false,
                        error = localizer.get(R.string.admin_carryover_schedule_failed, errMsg),
                    )
                }
                if ("REVISION_CONFLICT" in e.message.orEmpty()) {
                    loadPolicies(preserveDraft = true)
                }
            } finally {
                releaseActionGuard(token)
            }
        }
    }

    fun cancelFuturePolicy(effectiveFrom: String, reason: String) {
        val curUid = authRepository.currentUserId()
        val curGen = SessionCacheManager.currentGeneration()

        val token = actionSeq.incrementAndGet()
        if (!isActionInProgress.compareAndSet(false, true)) return
        activeActionToken.set(token)
        _uiState.update { it.copy(isCancelling = true, error = null, actionMessage = null) }

        val payload = "$effectiveFrom:${reason.trim()}"
        if (payload != lastCancelPayload) {
            cancelRequestId = UUID.randomUUID().toString()
            lastCancelPayload = payload
        }
        val reqId = cancelRequestId
        val expectedRev = _uiState.value.revision?.toLongOrNull()

        viewModelScope.launch {
            if (checkSessionChanged(curUid, curGen) || token != activeActionToken.get()) {
                releaseActionGuard(token)
                return@launch
            }
            try {
                adminManagementRepository.cancelFutureCarryoverPolicy(
                    effectiveFrom = effectiveFrom,
                    reason = reason.trim(),
                    expectedRevision = expectedRev,
                    requestId = reqId,
                )
                if (checkSessionChanged(curUid, curGen) || token != activeActionToken.get()) return@launch

                lastCancelPayload = null
                cancelRequestId = UUID.randomUUID().toString()

                _uiState.update {
                    it.copy(
                        isCancelling = false,
                        actionMessage = localizer.get(R.string.admin_carryover_cancel_success),
                    )
                }
                loadPolicies(preserveDraft = true)
            } catch (e: CancellationException) {
                if (!checkSessionChanged(curUid, curGen) && token == activeActionToken.get()) {
                    _uiState.update { it.copy(isCancelling = false) }
                }
                throw e
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                if (checkSessionChanged(curUid, curGen) || token != activeActionToken.get()) return@launch
                val errMsg = friendlyError(e, localizer)
                _uiState.update {
                    it.copy(
                        isCancelling = false,
                        error = localizer.get(R.string.admin_carryover_cancel_failed, errMsg),
                    )
                }
                if ("REVISION_CONFLICT" in e.message.orEmpty()) {
                    loadPolicies(preserveDraft = true)
                }
            } finally {
                releaseActionGuard(token)
            }
        }
    }
}

                    Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(16.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)) {
                        Text(stringResource(R.string.admin_carryover_schedule_btn), fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleSmall)

                        Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
                            FilterChip(
                                selected = uiState.draftIsEnabled,
                                onClick = { viewModel.setDraft(isEnabled = true) },
                                label = { Text(stringResource(R.string.admin_carryover_status_enabled)) },
                            )
                            FilterChip(
                                selected = !uiState.draftIsEnabled,
                                onClick = { viewModel.setDraft(isEnabled = false) },
                                label = { Text(stringResource(R.string.admin_carryover_status_disabled)) },
                            )
                        }

                        OutlinedTextField(
                            value = uiState.draftEffectiveFrom,
                            onValueChange = { viewModel.setDraft(effectiveFrom = it) },
                            label = { Text(stringResource(R.string.admin_carryover_effective_from)) },
                            singleLine = true,
                            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                        )

                        OutlinedTextField(
                            value = uiState.draftNote,
                            onValueChange = { viewModel.setDraft(note = it) },
                            label = { Text(stringResource(R.string.admin_carryover_note)) },
                            singleLine = true,
                            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                        )

                        Button(
                            onClick = {
                                viewModel.schedulePolicy(
                                    effectiveFrom = uiState.draftEffectiveFrom,
                                    isEnabled = uiState.draftIsEnabled,
                                    note = uiState.draftNote,
                                )
                            },
                            enabled = !uiState.isSaving && uiState.draftEffectiveFrom.isNotBlank() && uiState.draftNote.isNotBlank(),
                            modifier = Modifier.align(Alignment.End),
                        ) {
                            if (uiState.isSaving) {
                                CircularProgressIndicator(modifier = Modifier.size(16.dp), strokeWidth = 2.dp)
                                Spacer(Modifier.width(8.dp))
                            }
                            Text(stringResource(R.string.admin_carryover_schedule_btn))
                        }
                    }
                }

                // Future Policies List
                Card(
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                    shape = RoundedCornerShape(14.dp),
                    colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surfaceContainerLowest),
                    border = androidx.compose.foundation.BorderStroke(1.dp, MaterialTheme.colorScheme.outlineVariant),
                ) {
                    Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(16.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)) {
                        Text(stringResource(R.string.admin_carryover_future_title), fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleSmall)

                        if (uiState.futurePolicies.isEmpty()) {
                            Text(stringResource(R.string.admin_carryover_empty_future), style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall, color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant)
                        } else {
                            uiState.futurePolicies.forEach { policy ->
                                FuturePolicyItemRow(
                                    policy = policy,
                                    isCancelling = uiState.isCancelling,
                                    onCancel = { cancellingPolicyDate = policy.effectiveFrom }
                                )
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                // History List
                if (uiState.history.isNotEmpty()) {
                    Card(
                        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                        shape = RoundedCornerShape(14.dp),
                        colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surfaceContainerLowest),
                        border = androidx.compose.foundation.BorderStroke(1.dp, MaterialTheme.colorScheme.outlineVariant),
                    ) {
                        Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(16.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
                            Text(stringResource(R.string.admin_carryover_history_title), fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleSmall)
                            uiState.history.forEach { item ->
                                Row(
                                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                                    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
                                    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,

                                    Column(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                                        Text("${item.effectiveFrom} — ${if (item.isEnabled) "Bật" else "Tắt"}", fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold)
                                        item.operatorNote?.let {
                                            Text(it, style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall, color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant)
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    cancellingPolicyDate?.let { date ->
        CancelFuturePolicyDialog(
            effectiveDate = date,
            isLoading = uiState.isCancelling,
            onDismiss = { cancellingPolicyDate = null },
            onConfirm = { reason ->
                viewModel.cancelFuturePolicy(date, reason)
                cancellingPolicyDate = null
            }
        )
    }
}

@Composable
private fun FuturePolicyItemRow(
    policy: AdminCarryoverPolicyItem,
    isCancelling: Boolean,
    onCancel: () -> Unit,
) {
    Row(
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
    ) {
        Column(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
            Text(
                text = "${policy.effectiveFrom}: ${if (policy.isEnabled) "Bật" else "Tắt"}",
                fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold,
            )
            policy.operatorNote?.let {
                Text(text = it, style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall, color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant)
            }
        }
        OutlinedButton(
            onClick = onCancel,
            enabled = !isCancelling,
            colors = ButtonDefaults.outlinedButtonColors(contentColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.error),
        ) {
            Text(stringResource(R.string.admin_carryover_cancel_btn))
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun CancelFuturePolicyDialog(
    effectiveDate: String,
    isLoading: Boolean,
    onDismiss: () -> Unit,
    onConfirm: (reason: String) -> Unit,
) {
    var reason by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf("") }

    AlertDialog(
        onDismissRequest = { if (!isLoading) onDismiss() },
        title = { Text(stringResource(R.string.admin_carryover_cancel_btn)) },
        text = {
            Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)) {
                Text("Xác nhận hủy chính sách lên lịch cho ngày $effectiveDate?")
                OutlinedTextField(
                    value = reason,
                    onValueChange = { reason = it },
                    label = { Text(stringResource(R.string.admin_carryover_cancel_reason)) },
                    singleLine = true,
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                )
            }
        },
        confirmButton = {
            Button(
                onClick = { onConfirm(reason) },
                enabled = !isLoading && reason.isNotBlank(),
                colors = ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(containerColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.error),
            ) {
                if (isLoading) CircularProgressIndicator(modifier = Modifier.size(16.dp), strokeWidth = 2.dp)
                else Text(stringResource(R.string.confirm))
            }
        },
        dismissButton = {
            TextButton(onClick = onDismiss, enabled = !isLoading) {
                Text(stringResource(R.string.cancel))
            }
        }
    )
}

import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel

data class AdminCampaignsUiState(
    val isLoading: Boolean = true,
    val isLoadingMore: Boolean = false,
    val campaigns: List<AdminCampaignItem> = emptyList(),
    val query: String = "",
    val statusFilter: String? = null,
    val hasMore: Boolean = false,
    val nextCursor: AdminDateTimeCursor? = null,
    val error: String? = null,
    val currentAdminId: String? = null,
    val sessionGeneration: Long = 0L,
)

class AdminCampaignsViewModel(
    private val adminManagementRepository: AdminManagementRepository,
    private val authRepository: AuthRepository,
    private val localizer: Localizer,
) : ViewModel() {

    private val _uiState = MutableStateFlow(AdminCampaignsUiState())
    val uiState: StateFlow<AdminCampaignsUiState> = _uiState.asStateFlow()

    private val reqSeq = AtomicLong(0L)
    private val loadMoreSeq = AtomicLong(0L)
    private var searchJob: Job? = null

    private var activeUserId: String? = authRepository.currentUserId()
    private var activeGeneration: Long = SessionCacheManager.currentGeneration()

    init {
        _uiState.update { it.copy(currentAdminId = activeUserId, sessionGeneration = activeGeneration) }
        observeSession()
        refresh()
    }

    private fun checkSessionChanged(reqUid: String?, reqGen: Long): Boolean {
        val curUid = authRepository.currentUserId()
        val curGen = SessionCacheManager.currentGeneration()
        if (reqUid != curUid || reqGen != curGen) {
            handleSessionReset(curUid, curGen)
            return true
        }
        return false
    }

    private fun observeSession() {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            authRepository.sessionStatus.collect { status ->
                when (status) {
                    is SessionStatus.Authenticated -> {
                        val newUid = authRepository.currentUserId()
                        val newGen = SessionCacheManager.currentGeneration()
                        if (newUid != activeUserId || newGen != activeGeneration) {
                            handleSessionReset(newUid, newGen)
                            refresh()
                        }
                    }
                    is SessionStatus.NotAuthenticated -> {
                        val newGen = SessionCacheManager.currentGeneration()
                        handleSessionReset(null, newGen)
                    }
                    else -> {}
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private fun handleSessionReset(newUid: String?, newGen: Long) {
        activeUserId = newUid
        activeGeneration = newGen
        reqSeq.incrementAndGet()
        loadMoreSeq.incrementAndGet()
        searchJob?.cancel()

        _uiState.update {
            AdminCampaignsUiState(
                currentAdminId = newUid,
                sessionGeneration = newGen,
                isLoading = false,
            )
        }
    }

    fun clearError() {
        _uiState.update { it.copy(error = null) }
    }

    fun setQuery(q: String) {
        _uiState.update { it.copy(query = q, hasMore = false, nextCursor = null) }
        loadMoreSeq.incrementAndGet()
        searchJob?.cancel()
        searchJob = viewModelScope.launch {
            delay(300)
            refresh()
        }
    }

    fun setStatusFilter(status: String?) {
        _uiState.update { it.copy(statusFilter = status, hasMore = false, nextCursor = null) }
        loadMoreSeq.incrementAndGet()
        searchJob?.cancel()
        refresh()
    }

    fun refresh() {
        val curUid = authRepository.currentUserId()
        val curGen = SessionCacheManager.currentGeneration()
        val seq = reqSeq.incrementAndGet()
        loadMoreSeq.incrementAndGet()
        val queryAtStart = _uiState.value.query
        val statusAtStart = _uiState.value.statusFilter

        _uiState.update { it.copy(isLoading = true, error = null) }

        viewModelScope.launch {
            if (checkSessionChanged(curUid, curGen) || seq != reqSeq.get()) return@launch
            try {
                val res = adminManagementRepository.searchCampaigns(
                    query = queryAtStart,
                    status = statusAtStart,
                    limit = 50,
                )
                if (checkSessionChanged(curUid, curGen) || seq != reqSeq.get() ||
                    queryAtStart != _uiState.value.query || statusAtStart != _uiState.value.statusFilter
                ) {
                    return@launch
                }
                _uiState.update {
                    it.copy(
                        isLoading = false,
                        isLoadingMore = false,
                        campaigns = res.items,
                        hasMore = res.hasMore,
                        nextCursor = res.nextCursor,
                    )
                }
            } catch (e: CancellationException) {
                if (!checkSessionChanged(curUid, curGen) && seq == reqSeq.get()) {
                    _uiState.update { it.copy(isLoading = false, isLoadingMore = false) }
                }
                throw e
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                if (checkSessionChanged(curUid, curGen) || seq != reqSeq.get()) return@launch
                _uiState.update {
                    it.copy(
                        isLoading = false,
                        isLoadingMore = false,
                        error = friendlyError(e, localizer),
                    )
                }
            }
        }
    }

    fun loadMore() {
        val curUid = authRepository.currentUserId()
        val curGen = SessionCacheManager.currentGeneration()
        val state = _uiState.value
        if (state.isLoadingMore || !state.hasMore) return
        val cursor = state.nextCursor ?: return
        _uiState.update { it.copy(isLoadingMore = true) }
        val seq = loadMoreSeq.incrementAndGet()
        val queryAtStart = state.query
        val statusAtStart = state.statusFilter

        viewModelScope.launch {
            if (checkSessionChanged(curUid, curGen) || seq != loadMoreSeq.get()) return@launch
            try {
                val res = adminManagementRepository.searchCampaigns(
                    query = queryAtStart,
                    status = statusAtStart,
                    limit = 50,
                    cursorCreatedAt = cursor.createdAt,
                    cursorId = cursor.id,
                )
                if (checkSessionChanged(curUid, curGen) || seq != loadMoreSeq.get() ||
                    queryAtStart != _uiState.value.query || statusAtStart != _uiState.value.statusFilter
                ) {
                    return@launch
                }
                _uiState.update { s ->
                    val existingIds = s.campaigns.map { it.id }.toSet()
                    val newItems = res.items.filter { it.id !in existingIds }
                    s.copy(
                        isLoadingMore = false,
                        campaigns = s.campaigns + newItems,
                        hasMore = res.hasMore,
                        nextCursor = res.nextCursor,
                    )
                }
            } catch (e: CancellationException) {
                if (!checkSessionChanged(curUid, curGen) && seq == loadMoreSeq.get()) {
                    _uiState.update { it.copy(isLoadingMore = false) }
                }
                throw e
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                if (checkSessionChanged(curUid, curGen) || seq != loadMoreSeq.get()) return@launch
                _uiState.update { it.copy(isLoadingMore = false, error = friendlyError(e, localizer)) }
            }
        }
    }
}

@OptIn(ExperimentalMaterial3Api::class)
@Composable
fun AdminCampaignsScreen(
    onBack: () -> Unit,
    onOpenCampaignDetail: (campaignId: String) -> Unit,
) {
    val context = LocalContext.current
    val app = context.applicationContext as TestCheoApp
    val viewModel: AdminCampaignsViewModel = viewModel(
        factory = viewModelFactory {
            initializer {
                AdminCampaignsViewModel(
                    adminManagementRepository = app.adminManagementRepository,
                    authRepository = app.authRepository,
                    localizer = Localizer(app),
                )
            }
        }
    )
    val uiState by viewModel.uiState.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
    val snackbarHostState = remember { SnackbarHostState() }

    LaunchedEffect(uiState.error) {
        uiState.error?.let {
            snackbarHostState.showSnackbar(it)
            viewModel.clearError()
        }
    }

    Scaffold(
        topBar = {
            TopAppBar(
                title = { Text(stringResource(R.string.admin_tool_campaigns), fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold) },
                navigationIcon = {
                    IconButton(onClick = onBack) {
                        Icon(Icons.AutoMirrored.Filled.ArrowBack, contentDescription = stringResource(R.string.back))
                    }
                },
                actions = {
                    IconButton(onClick = viewModel::refresh, enabled = !uiState.isLoading) {
                        Icon(Icons.Filled.Refresh, contentDescription = stringResource(R.string.admin_refresh_cd))
                    }
                }
            )
        },
        snackbarHost = { SnackbarHost(snackbarHostState) },
    ) { padding ->
        PullToRefreshBox(
            isRefreshing = uiState.isLoading,
            onRefresh = viewModel::refresh,
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxSize()
                .padding(padding),
        ) {
            Column(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
                // Search & Filter header
                Column(
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .fillMaxWidth()
                        .padding(14.dp),
                    verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp),
                ) {
                    OutlinedTextField(
                        value = uiState.query,
                        onValueChange = viewModel::setQuery,
                        placeholder = { Text(stringResource(R.string.admin_campaign_search_hint)) },
                        leadingIcon = { Icon(Icons.Filled.Search, contentDescription = null) },
                        singleLine = true,
                        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                        shape = RoundedCornerShape(12.dp),
                    )

                    Row(
                        modifier = Modifier
                            .fillMaxWidth()
                            .horizontalScroll(rememberScrollState()),
                        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp),
                    ) {
                        FilterChip(
                            selected = uiState.statusFilter == null,
                            onClick = { viewModel.setStatusFilter(null) },
                            label = { Text(stringResource(R.string.admin_campaign_status_all)) },
                        )
                        FilterChip(
                            selected = uiState.statusFilter == "open",
                            onClick = { viewModel.setStatusFilter("open") },
                            label = { Text("Open") },
                        )
                        FilterChip(
                            selected = uiState.statusFilter == "paused",
                            onClick = { viewModel.setStatusFilter("paused") },
                            label = { Text("Paused") },
                        )
                        FilterChip(
                            selected = uiState.statusFilter == "completed",
                            onClick = { viewModel.setStatusFilter("completed") },
                            label = { Text("Completed") },
                        )
                    }
                }

                if (uiState.campaigns.isEmpty()) {
                    Box(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
                        if (uiState.isLoading) CircularProgressIndicator()
                        else Text(stringResource(R.string.admin_campaign_empty), color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant)
                    }
                } else {
                    LazyColumn(
                        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
                        contentPadding = PaddingValues(14.dp),
                        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp),
                    ) {
                        items(uiState.campaigns, key = { it.id }) { item ->
                            AdminCampaignCard(
                                item = item,
                                onOpen = { onOpenCampaignDetail(item.id) },
                            )
                        }

                        if (uiState.hasMore) {
                            item {
                                Box(
                                    modifier = Modifier
                                        .fillMaxWidth()
                                        .padding(vertical = 8.dp),
                                    contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
                                ) {
                                    if (uiState.isLoadingMore) {
                                        CircularProgressIndicator(modifier = Modifier.size(24.dp))
                                    } else {
                                        OutlinedButton(onClick = viewModel::loadMore) {
                                            Text(stringResource(R.string.admin_load_more))
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun AdminCampaignCard(
    item: AdminCampaignItem,
    onOpen: () -> Unit,
) {
    Card(
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
        shape = RoundedCornerShape(12.dp),
        colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surfaceContainerLowest),
        border = androidx.compose.foundation.BorderStroke(1.dp, MaterialTheme.colorScheme.outlineVariant),
    ) {
        Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(14.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
            Row(
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
            ) {
                Column(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                    Text(
                        text = item.appName,
                        fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                        style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium,
                        maxLines = 1,
                        overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
                    )
                    Text(
                        text = item.packageName,
                        style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall,
                        color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                        maxLines = 1,
                        overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
                    )
                }

                Box(
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .clip(RoundedCornerShape(6.dp))
                        .background(
                            when (item.status) {
                                "open" -> MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primaryContainer
                                "paused" -> MaterialTheme.colorScheme.errorContainer
                                else -> MaterialTheme.colorScheme.secondaryContainer
                            }
                        )
                        .padding(horizontal = 8.dp, vertical = 3.dp)
                ) {
                    Text(
                        text = item.status.uppercase(),
                        style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall,
                        fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                    )
                }
            }

            FlowRow(
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp),
                verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp),
            ) {
                Text(
                    text = stringResource(R.string.admin_campaign_owner, item.ownerName ?: item.ownerEmail ?: item.ownerId.orEmpty()),
                    style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall,
                    color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                )
                Text(
                    text = stringResource(R.string.admin_campaign_testers_count, item.currentTesters, item.targetTesters),
                    style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold,
                )
                if (item.pendingReportsCount > 0) {
                    Box(
                        modifier = Modifier
                            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(4.dp))
                            .background(MaterialTheme.colorScheme.error.copy(alpha = 0.15f))
                            .padding(horizontal = 6.dp, vertical = 2.dp)
                    ) {
                        Text(
                            text = stringResource(R.string.admin_campaign_pending_reports, item.pendingReportsCount),
                            style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall,
                            fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                            color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.error,
                        )
                    }
                }
            }

            Button(
                onClick = onOpen,
                modifier = Modifier.align(Alignment.End),
            ) {
                Text(stringResource(R.string.admin_campaign_open_detail))
            }
        }
    }
}

import com.ntt.crosstest.data.AdminDateTimeCursor

import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow

import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean

data class AdminTesterReportsQueueUiState(
    val isLoading: Boolean = true,
    val isLoadingMore: Boolean = false,
    val isActionLoading: Boolean = false,
    val reports: List<AdminTesterReportQueueItem> = emptyList(),
    val statusFilter: String? = "pending",
    val contextFilter: String? = null,
    val hasMore: Boolean = false,
    val nextCursor: AdminDateTimeCursor? = null,
    val error: String? = null,
    val actionMessage: String? = null,
    val currentAdminId: String? = null,
    val sessionGeneration: Long = 0L,
)

class AdminTesterReportsQueueViewModel(
    private val adminManagementRepository: AdminManagementRepository,
    private val authRepository: AuthRepository,
    private val localizer: Localizer,
) : ViewModel() {

    private val _uiState = MutableStateFlow(AdminTesterReportsQueueUiState())
    val uiState: StateFlow<AdminTesterReportsQueueUiState> = _uiState.asStateFlow()

    private val reqSeq = AtomicLong(0L)
    private val loadMoreSeq = AtomicLong(0L)
    private val actionSeq = AtomicLong(0L)
    private val isActionInProgress = AtomicBoolean(false)
    private val activeActionToken = AtomicLong(0L)

    private var activeUserId: String? = authRepository.currentUserId()
    private var activeGeneration: Long = SessionCacheManager.currentGeneration()

    init {
        _uiState.update { it.copy(currentAdminId = activeUserId, sessionGeneration = activeGeneration) }
        observeSession()
        refresh()
    }

    private fun checkSessionChanged(reqUid: String?, reqGen: Long): Boolean {
        val curUid = authRepository.currentUserId()
        val curGen = SessionCacheManager.currentGeneration()
        if (reqUid != curUid || reqGen != curGen) {
            handleSessionReset(curUid, curGen)
            return true
        }
        return false
    }

    private fun observeSession() {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            authRepository.sessionStatus.collect { status ->
                when (status) {
                    is SessionStatus.Authenticated -> {
                        val newUid = authRepository.currentUserId()
                        val newGen = SessionCacheManager.currentGeneration()
                        if (newUid != activeUserId || newGen != activeGeneration) {
                            handleSessionReset(newUid, newGen)
                            refresh()
                        }
                    }
                    is SessionStatus.NotAuthenticated -> {
                        val newGen = SessionCacheManager.currentGeneration()
                        handleSessionReset(null, newGen)
                    }
                    else -> {}
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private fun handleSessionReset(newUid: String?, newGen: Long) {
        activeUserId = newUid
        activeGeneration = newGen
        reqSeq.incrementAndGet()
        loadMoreSeq.incrementAndGet()
        actionSeq.incrementAndGet()
        activeActionToken.set(0L)
        isActionInProgress.set(false)

        _uiState.update {
            AdminTesterReportsQueueUiState(
                currentAdminId = newUid,
                sessionGeneration = newGen,
                isLoading = false,
            )
        }
    }

    private fun releaseActionGuard(token: Long) {
        if (activeActionToken.compareAndSet(token, 0L)) {
            isActionInProgress.set(false)
        }
    }

    fun clearMessages() {
        _uiState.update { it.copy(error = null, actionMessage = null) }
    }

    fun setStatusFilter(status: String?) {
        _uiState.update { it.copy(statusFilter = status, hasMore = false, nextCursor = null) }
        loadMoreSeq.incrementAndGet()
        refresh()
    }

    fun setContextFilter(context: String?) {
        _uiState.update { it.copy(contextFilter = context, hasMore = false, nextCursor = null) }
        loadMoreSeq.incrementAndGet()
        refresh()
    }

    fun refresh() {
        val curUid = authRepository.currentUserId()
        val curGen = SessionCacheManager.currentGeneration()
        val seq = reqSeq.incrementAndGet()
        loadMoreSeq.incrementAndGet()
        val statusAtStart = _uiState.value.statusFilter
        val contextAtStart = _uiState.value.contextFilter

        _uiState.update { it.copy(isLoading = true, error = null) }

        viewModelScope.launch {
            if (checkSessionChanged(curUid, curGen) || seq != reqSeq.get()) return@launch
            try {
                val res = adminManagementRepository.getTesterReportsQueue(
                    status = statusAtStart,
                    submissionContext = contextAtStart,
                    limit = 50,
                )
                if (checkSessionChanged(curUid, curGen) || seq != reqSeq.get() ||
                    statusAtStart != _uiState.value.statusFilter || contextAtStart != _uiState.value.contextFilter
                ) {
                    return@launch
                }
                _uiState.update {
                    it.copy(
                        isLoading = false,
                        isLoadingMore = false,
                        reports = res.items,
                        hasMore = res.hasMore,
                        nextCursor = res.nextCursor,
                    )
                }
            } catch (e: CancellationException) {
                if (!checkSessionChanged(curUid, curGen) && seq == reqSeq.get()) {
                    _uiState.update { it.copy(isLoading = false, isLoadingMore = false) }
                }
                throw e
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                if (checkSessionChanged(curUid, curGen) || seq != reqSeq.get()) return@launch
                _uiState.update {
                    it.copy(
                        isLoading = false,
                        isLoadingMore = false,
                        error = friendlyError(e, localizer),
                    )
                }
            }
        }
    }

    fun loadMore() {
        val curUid = authRepository.currentUserId()
        val curGen = SessionCacheManager.currentGeneration()
        val state = _uiState.value
        if (state.isLoadingMore || !state.hasMore) return
        val cursor = state.nextCursor ?: return
        _uiState.update { it.copy(isLoadingMore = true) }
        val seq = loadMoreSeq.incrementAndGet()
        val statusAtStart = state.statusFilter
        val contextAtStart = state.contextFilter

        viewModelScope.launch {
            if (checkSessionChanged(curUid, curGen) || seq != loadMoreSeq.get()) return@launch
            try {
                val res = adminManagementRepository.getTesterReportsQueue(
                    status = statusAtStart,
                    submissionContext = contextAtStart,
                    limit = 50,
                    cursorCreatedAt = cursor.createdAt,
                    cursorId = cursor.id,
                )
                if (checkSessionChanged(curUid, curGen) || seq != loadMoreSeq.get() ||
                    statusAtStart != _uiState.value.statusFilter || contextAtStart != _uiState.value.contextFilter
                ) {
                    return@launch
                }
                _uiState.update { s ->
                    val existingIds = s.reports.map { it.id }.toSet()
                    val newItems = res.items.filter { it.id !in existingIds }
                    s.copy(
                        isLoadingMore = false,
                        reports = s.reports + newItems,
                        hasMore = res.hasMore,
                        nextCursor = res.nextCursor,
                    )
                }
            } catch (e: CancellationException) {
                if (!checkSessionChanged(curUid, curGen) && seq == loadMoreSeq.get()) {
                    _uiState.update { it.copy(isLoadingMore = false) }
                }
                throw e
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                if (checkSessionChanged(curUid, curGen) || seq != loadMoreSeq.get()) return@launch
                _uiState.update { it.copy(isLoadingMore = false, error = friendlyError(e, localizer)) }
            }
        }
    }

    fun approveReport(reportId: String, bonusCredits: Int = 0) {
        val curUid = authRepository.currentUserId()
        val curGen = SessionCacheManager.currentGeneration()

        val token = actionSeq.incrementAndGet()
        if (!isActionInProgress.compareAndSet(false, true)) return
        activeActionToken.set(token)
        _uiState.update { it.copy(isActionLoading = true, error = null) }

        viewModelScope.launch {
            if (checkSessionChanged(curUid, curGen) || token != activeActionToken.get()) {
                releaseActionGuard(token)
                return@launch
            }
            try {
                val res = adminManagementRepository.approveTesterReport(reportId, bonusCredits)
                if (checkSessionChanged(curUid, curGen) || token != activeActionToken.get()) return@launch
                if (res.success) {
                    _uiState.update { s ->
                        s.copy(
                            isActionLoading = false,
                            actionMessage = localizer.get(R.string.admin_report_approved_success),
                            reports = s.reports.map {
                                if (it.id == reportId) it.copy(status = "approved") else it
                            },
                        )
                    }
                    refresh()
                } else {
                    _uiState.update {
                        it.copy(
                            isActionLoading = false,
                            error = localizer.get(R.string.admin_report_approved_failed, "Conflict or expired"),
                        )
                    }
                }
            } catch (e: CancellationException) {
                if (!checkSessionChanged(curUid, curGen) && token == activeActionToken.get()) {
                    _uiState.update { it.copy(isActionLoading = false) }
                }
                throw e
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                if (checkSessionChanged(curUid, curGen) || token != activeActionToken.get()) return@launch
                _uiState.update {
                    it.copy(
                        isActionLoading = false,
                        error = localizer.get(R.string.admin_report_approved_failed, friendlyError(e, localizer)),
                    )
                }
            } finally {
                releaseActionGuard(token)
            }
        }
    }

    fun rejectReport(reportId: String, reason: String) {
        val curUid = authRepository.currentUserId()
        val curGen = SessionCacheManager.currentGeneration()

        val token = actionSeq.incrementAndGet()
        if (!isActionInProgress.compareAndSet(false, true)) return
        activeActionToken.set(token)
        _uiState.update { it.copy(isActionLoading = true, error = null) }

        viewModelScope.launch {
            if (checkSessionChanged(curUid, curGen) || token != activeActionToken.get()) {
                releaseActionGuard(token)
                return@launch
            }
            try {
                val res = adminManagementRepository.rejectTesterReport(reportId, reason)
                if (checkSessionChanged(curUid, curGen) || token != activeActionToken.get()) return@launch
                if (res.success) {
                    _uiState.update { s ->
                        s.copy(
                            isActionLoading = false,
                            actionMessage = localizer.get(R.string.admin_report_rejected_success),
                            reports = s.reports.map {
                                if (it.id == reportId) it.copy(status = "rejected", rejectionReason = reason) else it
                            },
                        )
                    }
                    refresh()
                } else {
                    _uiState.update {
                        it.copy(
                            isActionLoading = false,
                            error = localizer.get(R.string.admin_report_rejected_failed, "Conflict or expired"),
                        )
                    }
                }
            } catch (e: CancellationException) {
                if (!checkSessionChanged(curUid, curGen) && token == activeActionToken.get()) {
                    _uiState.update { it.copy(isActionLoading = false) }
                }
                throw e
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                if (checkSessionChanged(curUid, curGen) || token != activeActionToken.get()) return@launch
                _uiState.update {
                    it.copy(
                        isActionLoading = false,
                        error = localizer.get(R.string.admin_report_rejected_failed, friendlyError(e, localizer)),
                    )
                }
            } finally {
                releaseActionGuard(token)
            }
        }
    }

import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel

import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow

import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicLong

data class AdminAuditUiState(
    val isLoading: Boolean = true,
    val isLoadingMore: Boolean = false,
    val events: List<AdminActionEvent> = emptyList(),
    val actionFilter: String? = null,
    val targetTypeFilter: String? = null,
    val hasMore: Boolean = false,
    val nextCursor: AdminDateTimeCursor? = null,
    val error: String? = null,
    val currentAdminId: String? = null,
    val sessionGeneration: Long = 0L,
)

class AdminAuditViewModel(
    private val adminManagementRepository: AdminManagementRepository,
    private val authRepository: AuthRepository,
    private val localizer: Localizer,
) : ViewModel() {

    private val _uiState = MutableStateFlow(AdminAuditUiState())
    val uiState: StateFlow<AdminAuditUiState> = _uiState.asStateFlow()

    private val reqSeq = AtomicLong(0L)
    private val loadMoreSeq = AtomicLong(0L)

    private var activeUserId: String? = authRepository.currentUserId()
    private var activeGeneration: Long = SessionCacheManager.currentGeneration()

    init {
        _uiState.update { it.copy(currentAdminId = activeUserId, sessionGeneration = activeGeneration) }
        observeSession()
        refresh()
    }

    private fun checkSessionChanged(reqUid: String?, reqGen: Long): Boolean {
        val curUid = authRepository.currentUserId()
        val curGen = SessionCacheManager.currentGeneration()
        if (reqUid != curUid || reqGen != curGen) {
            handleSessionReset(curUid, curGen)
            return true
        }
        return false
    }

    private fun observeSession() {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            authRepository.sessionStatus.collect { status ->
                when (status) {
                    is SessionStatus.Authenticated -> {
                        val newUid = authRepository.currentUserId()
                        val newGen = SessionCacheManager.currentGeneration()
                        if (newUid != activeUserId || newGen != activeGeneration) {
                            handleSessionReset(newUid, newGen)
                            refresh()
                        }
                    }
                    is SessionStatus.NotAuthenticated -> {
                        val newGen = SessionCacheManager.currentGeneration()
                        handleSessionReset(null, newGen)
                    }
                    else -> {}
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private fun handleSessionReset(newUid: String?, newGen: Long) {
        activeUserId = newUid
        activeGeneration = newGen
        reqSeq.incrementAndGet()
        loadMoreSeq.incrementAndGet()

        _uiState.update {
            AdminAuditUiState(
                currentAdminId = newUid,
                sessionGeneration = newGen,
                isLoading = false,
            )
        }
    }

    fun clearError() {
        _uiState.update { it.copy(error = null) }
    }

    fun setActionFilter(action: String?) {
        _uiState.update { it.copy(actionFilter = action, hasMore = false, nextCursor = null) }
        loadMoreSeq.incrementAndGet()
        refresh()
    }

    fun setTargetTypeFilter(targetType: String?) {
        _uiState.update { it.copy(targetTypeFilter = targetType, hasMore = false, nextCursor = null) }
        loadMoreSeq.incrementAndGet()
        refresh()
    }

    fun refresh() {
        val curUid = authRepository.currentUserId()
        val curGen = SessionCacheManager.currentGeneration()
        val seq = reqSeq.incrementAndGet()
        loadMoreSeq.incrementAndGet()
        val actionAtStart = _uiState.value.actionFilter
        val targetAtStart = _uiState.value.targetTypeFilter

        _uiState.update { it.copy(isLoading = true, error = null) }

        viewModelScope.launch {
            if (checkSessionChanged(curUid, curGen) || seq != reqSeq.get()) return@launch
            try {
                val res = adminManagementRepository.getActionEvents(
                    limit = 50,
                    action = actionAtStart,
                    targetType = targetAtStart,
                )
                if (checkSessionChanged(curUid, curGen) || seq != reqSeq.get() ||
                    actionAtStart != _uiState.value.actionFilter || targetAtStart != _uiState.value.targetTypeFilter
                ) {
                    return@launch
                }
                _uiState.update {
                    it.copy(
                        isLoading = false,
                        isLoadingMore = false,
                        events = res.items,
                        hasMore = res.hasMore,
                        nextCursor = res.nextCursor,
                    )
                }
            } catch (e: CancellationException) {
                if (!checkSessionChanged(curUid, curGen) && seq == reqSeq.get()) {
                    _uiState.update { it.copy(isLoading = false, isLoadingMore = false) }
                }
                throw e
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                if (checkSessionChanged(curUid, curGen) || seq != reqSeq.get()) return@launch
                _uiState.update {
                    it.copy(
                        isLoading = false,
                        isLoadingMore = false,
                        error = friendlyError(e, localizer),
                    )
                }
            }
        }
    }

    fun loadMore() {
        val curUid = authRepository.currentUserId()
        val curGen = SessionCacheManager.currentGeneration()
        val state = _uiState.value
        if (state.isLoadingMore || !state.hasMore) return
        val cursor = state.nextCursor ?: return
        _uiState.update { it.copy(isLoadingMore = true) }
        val seq = loadMoreSeq.incrementAndGet()
        val actionAtStart = state.actionFilter
        val targetAtStart = state.targetTypeFilter

        viewModelScope.launch {
            if (checkSessionChanged(curUid, curGen) || seq != loadMoreSeq.get()) return@launch
            try {
                val res = adminManagementRepository.getActionEvents(
                    limit = 50,
                    cursorCreatedAt = cursor.createdAt,
                    cursorId = cursor.id,
                    action = actionAtStart,
                    targetType = targetAtStart,
                )
                if (checkSessionChanged(curUid, curGen) || seq != loadMoreSeq.get() ||
                    actionAtStart != _uiState.value.actionFilter || targetAtStart != _uiState.value.targetTypeFilter
                ) {
                    return@launch
                }
                _uiState.update { s ->
                    val existingIds = s.events.map { it.id }.toSet()
                    val newItems = res.items.filter { it.id !in existingIds }
                    s.copy(
                        isLoadingMore = false,
                        events = s.events + newItems,
                        hasMore = res.hasMore,
                        nextCursor = res.nextCursor,
                    )
                }
            } catch (e: CancellationException) {
                if (!checkSessionChanged(curUid, curGen) && seq == loadMoreSeq.get()) {
                    _uiState.update { it.copy(isLoadingMore = false) }
                }
                throw e
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                if (checkSessionChanged(curUid, curGen) || seq != loadMoreSeq.get()) return@launch
                _uiState.update { it.copy(isLoadingMore = false, error = friendlyError(e, localizer)) }
            }
        }
    }
}

@OptIn(ExperimentalMaterial3Api::class)
@Composable
fun AdminAuditScreen(
    onBack: () -> Unit,
) {
    val context = LocalContext.current
    val app = context.applicationContext as TestCheoApp
    val viewModel: AdminAuditViewModel = viewModel(
        factory = viewModelFactory {
            initializer {
                AdminAuditViewModel(
                    adminManagementRepository = app.adminManagementRepository,
                    authRepository = app.authRepository,
                    localizer = Localizer(app),
                )
            }
        }
    )
    val uiState by viewModel.uiState.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
    val snackbarHostState = remember { SnackbarHostState() }

    LaunchedEffect(uiState.error) {
        uiState.error?.let {
            snackbarHostState.showSnackbar(it)
            viewModel.clearError()
        }
    }

    Scaffold(
        topBar = {
            TopAppBar(
                title = { Text(stringResource(R.string.admin_tool_audit), fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold) },
                navigationIcon = {
                    IconButton(onClick = onBack) {
                        Icon(Icons.AutoMirrored.Filled.ArrowBack, contentDescription = stringResource(R.string.back))
                    }
                },
                actions = {
                    IconButton(onClick = viewModel::refresh, enabled = !uiState.isLoading) {
                        Icon(Icons.Filled.Refresh, contentDescription = stringResource(R.string.admin_refresh_cd))
                    }
                }
            )
        },
        snackbarHost = { SnackbarHost(snackbarHostState) },
    ) { padding ->
        PullToRefreshBox(
            isRefreshing = uiState.isLoading,
            onRefresh = viewModel::refresh,
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxSize()
                .padding(padding),
        ) {
            Column(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
                // Filters row
                Row(
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .fillMaxWidth()
                        .horizontalScroll(rememberScrollState())
                        .padding(horizontal = 14.dp, vertical = 8.dp),
                    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp),
                ) {
                    FilterChip(
                        selected = uiState.actionFilter == null,
                        onClick = { viewModel.setActionFilter(null) },
                        label = { Text("Tất cả hành động") },
                    )
                    FilterChip(
                        selected = uiState.actionFilter == "compensate_credits",
                        onClick = { viewModel.setActionFilter("compensate_credits") },
                        label = { Text("Bồi hoàn") },
                    )
                    FilterChip(
                        selected = uiState.actionFilter == "set_user_role",
                        onClick = { viewModel.setActionFilter("set_user_role") },
                        label = { Text("Đổi vai trò") },
                    )
                    FilterChip(
                        selected = uiState.actionFilter == "revoke_warning",
                        onClick = { viewModel.setActionFilter("revoke_warning") },
                        label = { Text("Thu hồi cảnh báo") },
                    )
                    FilterChip(
                        selected = uiState.actionFilter == "schedule_carryover_policy",
                        onClick = { viewModel.setActionFilter("schedule_carryover_policy") },
                        label = { Text("Lên lịch Carryover") },
                    )
                }

                if (uiState.events.isEmpty()) {
                    Box(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
                        if (uiState.isLoading) CircularProgressIndicator()
                        else Text(stringResource(R.string.admin_audit_empty), color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant)
                    }
                } else {
                    LazyColumn(
                        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
                        contentPadding = PaddingValues(14.dp),
                        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp),
                    ) {
                        items(uiState.events, key = { it.id }) { item ->
                            AuditEventCard(item = item)
                        }

                        if (uiState.hasMore) {
                            item {
                                Box(
                                    modifier = Modifier
                                        .fillMaxWidth()
                                        .padding(vertical = 8.dp),
                                    contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
                                ) {
                                    if (uiState.isLoadingMore) {
                                        CircularProgressIndicator(modifier = Modifier.size(24.dp))
                                    } else {
                                        OutlinedButton(onClick = viewModel::loadMore) {
                                            Text(stringResource(R.string.admin_load_more))
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

                        Text("Sau: $it", style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall, color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary, maxLines = 2, overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis)
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import com.ntt.crosstest.R
import com.ntt.crosstest.data.AdminDateTimeCursor
