+-- 7.3 push_campaign_v2 (Financial push operation with CAS & RequestID replay)
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.push_campaign_v2(
+    p_campaign_id uuid,
+    p_client_request_id uuid,
+    p_expected_cost integer DEFAULT NULL::integer,
+    p_expected_revision text DEFAULT NULL::text
+)
+RETURNS jsonb
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path TO 'public'
+AS $$
+declare
+    v_uid               uuid := auth.uid();
+    v_existing_receipt  record;
+    v_camp              public.campaigns%rowtype;
+    v_profile           public.profiles%rowtype;
+    v_now               timestamptz;
+    v_business_date     date;
+    v_expires_at        timestamptz;
+    v_push_order        bigint;
+    v_balance_after     int;
+    v_credit_log_id     uuid;
+    v_receipt_id        uuid;
+    v_note              text;
+    v_policy            public.business_policies;
+    v_cost              int;
+    v_current_rev       text;
+begin
+    if v_uid is null then
+        raise exception 'NOT_AUTHENTICATED';
+    end if;
+
+    if p_client_request_id is null then
+        raise exception 'INVALID_REQUEST_ID';
+    end if;
+
+    if p_campaign_id is null then
+        raise exception 'INVALID_CAMPAIGN_ID';
+    end if;
+
+    -- Replay check before locking
+    select * into v_existing_receipt
+    from public.campaign_push_receipts
+    where user_id = v_uid and client_request_id = p_client_request_id;
+
+    if v_existing_receipt.id is not null then
+        if coalesce(v_existing_receipt.target_campaign_id, v_existing_receipt.campaign_id) is distinct from p_campaign_id then
+            raise exception 'REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT: Yêu cầu bị trùng lặp với campaign khác';
+        end if;
+        if p_expected_cost is not null and v_existing_receipt.cost_credits <> p_expected_cost then
+            raise exception 'REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT: Yêu cầu bị trùng lặp với giá khác';
+        end if;
+        return jsonb_build_object(
+            'success', true,
+            'receipt_id', v_existing_receipt.id,
+            'client_request_id', v_existing_receipt.client_request_id,
+            'campaign_id', p_campaign_id,
+            'charged_credits', v_existing_receipt.cost_credits,
+            'balance_after', v_existing_receipt.balance_after,
+            'business_date', to_char(v_existing_receipt.business_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
+            'expires_at', to_char(v_existing_receipt.expires_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"'),
+            'push_order', v_existing_receipt.push_order,
+            'replayed', true
+        );
+    end if;
+
+    -- Consistent lock ordering: campaigns, then profiles
+    select * into v_camp
+    from public.campaigns
+    where id = p_campaign_id
+    for update;
+
+    if v_camp.id is null then
+        raise exception 'CAMPAIGN_NOT_FOUND';
+    end if;
+
+    select * into v_profile
+    from public.profiles
+    where id = v_uid
+    for update;
+
+    if v_profile.id is null then
+        raise exception 'PROFILE_NOT_FOUND';
+    end if;
+
+    -- Re-check receipt under lock
+    select * into v_existing_receipt
+    from public.campaign_push_receipts
+    where user_id = v_uid and client_request_id = p_client_request_id;
+
+    if v_existing_receipt.id is not null then
+        if coalesce(v_existing_receipt.target_campaign_id, v_existing_receipt.campaign_id) is distinct from p_campaign_id then
+            raise exception 'REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT: Yêu cầu bị trùng lặp với campaign khác';
+        end if;
+        if p_expected_cost is not null and v_existing_receipt.cost_credits <> p_expected_cost then
+            raise exception 'REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT: Yêu cầu bị trùng lặp với giá khác';
+        end if;
+        return jsonb_build_object(
+            'success', true,
+            'receipt_id', v_existing_receipt.id,
+            'client_request_id', v_existing_receipt.client_request_id,
+            'campaign_id', p_campaign_id,
+            'charged_credits', v_existing_receipt.cost_credits,
+            'balance_after', v_existing_receipt.balance_after,
+            'business_date', to_char(v_existing_receipt.business_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
+            'expires_at', to_char(v_existing_receipt.expires_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"'),
+            'push_order', v_existing_receipt.push_order,
+            'replayed', true
+        );
+    end if;
+
+    if v_camp.owner_id is distinct from v_uid then
+        raise exception 'NOT_OWNER';
+    end if;
+
+    if coalesce(v_profile.is_locked, false) = true then
+        raise exception 'ACCOUNT_LOCKED';
+    end if;
+
+    if v_camp.status <> 'open' then
+        raise exception 'CAMPAIGN_NOT_OPEN';
+    end if;
+
+    v_now := clock_timestamp();
+    v_business_date := (v_now at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date;
+    v_expires_at := (date_trunc('day', v_now at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh') + interval '1 day') at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh';
+
+    if v_camp.created_at <= v_now - interval '30 days' then
+        raise exception 'CAMPAIGN_WINDOW_EXPIRED';
+    end if;
+
+    if v_camp.slot_number > 1 then
+        if not exists (
+            select 1 from public.user_slots
+            where user_id = v_camp.owner_id
+              and slot_number = v_camp.slot_number
+              and expires_at > v_now
+        ) then
+            raise exception 'SLOT_EXPIRED';
+        end if;
+    end if;
+
+    v_policy := public._get_effective_business_policy_row(v_business_date);
+    v_cost := v_policy.push_fee;
+    v_current_rev := public._get_business_policy_revision();
+
+    if p_expected_cost is not null and p_expected_cost <> v_cost then
+        raise exception 'BUSINESS_POLICY_PRICE_MISMATCH: Phí đẩy ứng dụng đã thay đổi (hiện tại: %s Credit)', v_cost;
+    end if;
+
+    if p_expected_revision is not null and p_expected_revision <> v_current_rev then
+        raise exception 'BUSINESS_POLICY_CONFLICT: Chính sách hệ thống đã thay đổi';
+    end if;
+
+    if coalesce(v_profile.credits, 0) < v_cost then
+        raise exception 'INSUFFICIENT_CREDITS';
+    end if;
+
+    perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext('campaign_push_order_lock'));
+
+    v_push_order := nextval('public.campaign_push_order_seq');
+
+    update public.profiles
+    set credits = credits - v_cost
+    where id = v_uid
+    returning credits into v_balance_after;
+
+    v_note := format('Đẩy ứng dụng "%s" lên đầu danh sách (hạn đến hết %s)',
+                     coalesce(nullif(v_camp.app_name, ''), 'của bạn'),
+                     to_char(v_business_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY'));
+
+    insert into public.credit_logs (user_id, amount, action, note, balance)
+    values (v_uid, -v_cost, 'campaign_push', v_note, v_balance_after)
+    returning id into v_credit_log_id;
+
+    perform set_config('app.allow_push_metadata_write', 'true', true);
+
+    update public.campaigns
+    set push_business_date = v_business_date,
+        push_expires_at = v_expires_at,
+        push_order = v_push_order
+    where id = p_campaign_id;
+
+    perform set_config('app.allow_push_metadata_write', 'false', true);
+
+    insert into public.campaign_push_receipts (
+        user_id, campaign_id, target_campaign_id, client_request_id,
+        cost_credits, balance_after, business_date, pushed_at,
+        expires_at, push_order, credit_log_id
+    ) values (
+        v_uid, p_campaign_id, p_campaign_id, p_client_request_id,
+        v_cost, v_balance_after, v_business_date, v_now,
+        v_expires_at, v_push_order, v_credit_log_id
+    )
+    returning id into v_receipt_id;
+
+    return jsonb_build_object(
+        'success', true,
+        'receipt_id', v_receipt_id,
+        'client_request_id', p_client_request_id,
+        'campaign_id', p_campaign_id,
+        'charged_credits', v_cost,
+        'balance_after', v_balance_after,
+        'business_date', to_char(v_business_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
+        'expires_at', to_char(v_expires_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"'),
+        'push_order', v_push_order,
+        'replayed', false
+    );
+end;
+$$;

+-- 7.5 unlock_or_renew_slot_v2 (Financial slot operation with CAS & RequestID replay)
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.unlock_or_renew_slot_v2(
+    p_slot_number integer,
+    p_client_request_id uuid,
+    p_expected_cost integer DEFAULT NULL::integer,
+    p_expected_revision text DEFAULT NULL::text
+)
+RETURNS jsonb
+LANGUAGE plpgsql

+declare
+    v_user_id uuid := auth.uid();
+    v_cost int;
+    v_balance int;
+    v_locked boolean;
+    v_current_expires timestamptz;
+    v_prev_expires timestamptz;
+    v_new_expires timestamptz;
+    v_policy public.business_policies;
+    v_renewal_days int;
+    v_existing_receipt record;
+    v_receipt_id uuid;
+    v_current_rev text;
+begin
+    if v_user_id is null then
+        raise exception 'NOT_AUTHENTICATED';
+    end if;
+
+    if p_client_request_id is null then
+        raise exception 'INVALID_REQUEST_ID';
+    end if;
+
+    if p_slot_number < 2 or p_slot_number > 6 then
+        raise exception 'INVALID_SLOT_NUMBER';
+    end if;
+
+    -- Replay check before CAS
+    select * into v_existing_receipt
+    from public.slot_purchase_receipts
+    where user_id = v_user_id and client_request_id = p_client_request_id;
+
+    if v_existing_receipt.id is not null then
+        if v_existing_receipt.slot_number <> p_slot_number then
+            raise exception 'REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT: Yêu cầu bị trùng với slot khác';
+        end if;
+        if p_expected_cost is not null and v_existing_receipt.cost_credits <> p_expected_cost then
+            raise exception 'REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT: Yêu cầu bị trùng với giá khác';
+        end if;
+        return jsonb_build_object(
+            'success', true,
+            'slot_number', v_existing_receipt.slot_number,
+            'cost', v_existing_receipt.cost_credits,
+            'balance', v_existing_receipt.balance_after,
+            'expires_at', to_char(v_existing_receipt.expires_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"'),
+            'replayed', true,
+            'receipt_id', v_existing_receipt.id
+        );
+    end if;
+
+    -- Lock profile
+    select credits, coalesce(is_locked, false)
+    into v_balance, v_locked
+    from public.profiles
+    where id = v_user_id
+    for update;
+
+    if v_locked = true then
+        raise exception 'ACCOUNT_LOCKED: Tài khoản của bạn đã bị khóa';
+    end if;
+
+    -- Re-check receipt after lock
+    select * into v_existing_receipt
+    from public.slot_purchase_receipts
+    where user_id = v_user_id and client_request_id = p_client_request_id;
+
+    if v_existing_receipt.id is not null then
+        if v_existing_receipt.slot_number <> p_slot_number then
+            raise exception 'REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT: Yêu cầu bị trùng với slot khác';
+        end if;
+        if p_expected_cost is not null and v_existing_receipt.cost_credits <> p_expected_cost then
+            raise exception 'REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT: Yêu cầu bị trùng với giá khác';
+        end if;
+        return jsonb_build_object(
+            'success', true,
+            'slot_number', v_existing_receipt.slot_number,
+            'cost', v_existing_receipt.cost_credits,
+            'balance', v_existing_receipt.balance_after,
+            'expires_at', to_char(v_existing_receipt.expires_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"'),
+            'replayed', true,
+            'receipt_id', v_existing_receipt.id
+        );
+    end if;
+
+    v_policy := public._get_effective_business_policy_row();
+    v_cost := case
+        when p_slot_number = 2 then v_policy.slot_fee_2
+        when p_slot_number = 3 then v_policy.slot_fee_3
+        else v_policy.slot_fee_4_plus
+    end;
+    v_renewal_days := v_policy.slot_renewal_days;
+    v_current_rev := public._get_business_policy_revision();
+
+    if p_expected_cost is not null and p_expected_cost <> v_cost then
+        raise exception 'BUSINESS_POLICY_PRICE_MISMATCH: Phí slot đã thay đổi (hiện tại: %s Credit)', v_cost;
+    end if;
+
+    if p_expected_revision is not null and p_expected_revision <> v_current_rev then
+        raise exception 'BUSINESS_POLICY_CONFLICT: Chính sách hệ thống đã thay đổi';
+    end if;
+
+    if v_balance is null or v_balance < v_cost then
+        raise exception 'INSUFFICIENT_CREDITS';
+    end if;
+
+    -- Slot N (N > 2) chỉ mở được khi Slot N - 1 đang còn hoạt động
+    if p_slot_number > 2 then
+        select expires_at into v_prev_expires
+        from public.user_slots
+        where user_id = v_user_id and slot_number = p_slot_number - 1
+        for update;
+
+        if v_prev_expires is null or v_prev_expires <= now() then
+            raise exception 'PREVIOUS_SLOT_NOT_ACTIVE';
+        end if;
+    end if;

+    select expires_at into v_current_expires
+    from public.user_slots
+    where user_id = v_user_id and slot_number = p_slot_number
+    for update;
+
+    if v_current_expires is not null and v_current_expires > now() then
+        v_new_expires := v_current_expires + (v_renewal_days || ' days')::interval;
+    else
+        v_new_expires := now() + (v_renewal_days || ' days')::interval;
+    end if;

+    values (v_user_id, p_slot_number, now(), v_new_expires)
+    on conflict (user_id, slot_number)

+        expires_at = v_new_expires;

+    where id = v_user_id
+    returning credits into v_balance;
+
+    insert into public.credit_logs (user_id, amount, action, note, balance)
+    values (
+        v_user_id,
+        -v_cost,
+        'unlock_slot',
+        format('Mở khóa / Gia hạn Slot %s (thời hạn %s ngày)', p_slot_number, v_renewal_days),
+        v_balance
+    );
+
+    insert into public.slot_purchase_receipts (
+        user_id, client_request_id, slot_number, cost_credits, balance_after, expires_at, created_at
+    ) values (
+        v_user_id, p_client_request_id, p_slot_number, v_cost, v_balance, v_new_expires, clock_timestamp()
+    ) returning id into v_receipt_id;
+
+    return jsonb_build_object(
+        'success', true,
+        'slot_number', p_slot_number,
+        'cost', v_cost,
+        'balance', v_balance,
+        'expires_at', to_char(v_new_expires at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"'),
+        'renewal_days', v_renewal_days,
+        'receipt_id', v_receipt_id,
+        'replayed', false
+    );
+end;
+$$;

+-- 7.6 unlock_or_renew_slot (Legacy wrapper with fail-closed check)
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.unlock_or_renew_slot(p_slot_number integer)
+RETURNS jsonb
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path TO 'public'
+AS $$
+declare
+    v_policy public.business_policies;
+    v_default_cost integer;
+    v_cost integer;
+begin
+    if p_slot_number < 2 or p_slot_number > 6 then
+        raise exception 'INVALID_SLOT_NUMBER';
+    end if;
+
+    v_default_cost := case when p_slot_number = 2 then 50 when p_slot_number = 3 then 100 else 200 end;
+    v_policy := public._get_effective_business_policy_row();
+    v_cost := case
+        when p_slot_number = 2 then v_policy.slot_fee_2
+        when p_slot_number = 3 then v_policy.slot_fee_3
+        else v_policy.slot_fee_4_plus
+    end;
+
+    if v_cost <> v_default_cost or v_policy.slot_renewal_days <> 30 then
+        raise exception 'CLIENT_UPDATE_REQUIRED: Phí hoặc thời hạn slot đã thay đổi. Vui lòng cập nhật ứng dụng.';
+    end if;
+
+    return public.unlock_or_renew_slot_v2(p_slot_number, gen_random_uuid(), v_default_cost, null);
+end;
+$$;

+RETURNS trigger
+LANGUAGE plpgsql

+SET search_path TO 'public'
+AS $$
+declare
+    v_vn_today date := (clock_timestamp() at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date;
+    v_policy public.business_policies;
+    v_welcome_credits integer := 100;
+    v_inserted_id uuid;
+begin
+    v_policy := public._get_effective_business_policy_row(v_vn_today);
+    if v_policy.id is not null then
+        v_welcome_credits := v_policy.welcome_credits;
+    end if;
+
+    insert into public.profiles (
+        id, email, display_name, avatar_url, credits,
+        last_active_date, missed_streak, role, is_locked
+    )
+    values (
+        new.id,
+        new.email,
+        coalesce(
+            new.raw_user_meta_data ->> 'full_name',
+            new.raw_user_meta_data ->> 'name',
+            new.raw_user_meta_data ->> 'display_name',
+            split_part(coalesce(new.email, ''), '@', 1)
+        ),
+        coalesce(
+            new.raw_user_meta_data ->> 'avatar_url',
+            new.raw_user_meta_data ->> 'picture'
+        ),
+        v_welcome_credits,
+        v_vn_today,
+        0,
+        'member',
+        false
+    )
+    on conflict (id) do nothing
+    returning id into v_inserted_id;
+
+    if v_inserted_id is not null then
+        insert into public.credit_logs (user_id, amount, action, note, balance)
+        values (

+            v_welcome_credits,
+            'welcome',
+            format('Thưởng %s Credit khi mở tài khoản', v_welcome_credits),

+-- 7.3 push_campaign_v2 (Financial push operation with CAS & RequestID replay)
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.push_campaign_v2(
+    p_campaign_id uuid,
+    p_client_request_id uuid,
+    p_expected_cost integer DEFAULT NULL::integer,
+    p_expected_revision text DEFAULT NULL::text
+)
+RETURNS jsonb
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path TO 'public'
+AS $$
+declare
+    v_uid               uuid := auth.uid();
+    v_existing_receipt  record;
+    v_camp              public.campaigns%rowtype;
+    v_profile           public.profiles%rowtype;
+    v_now               timestamptz;
+    v_business_date     date;
+    v_expires_at        timestamptz;
+    v_push_order        bigint;
+    v_balance_after     int;
+    v_credit_log_id     uuid;
+    v_receipt_id        uuid;
+    v_note              text;
+    v_policy            public.business_policies;
+    v_cost              int;
+    v_current_rev       text;
+begin
+    if v_uid is null then
+        raise exception 'NOT_AUTHENTICATED';
+    end if;
+
+    if p_client_request_id is null then
+        raise exception 'INVALID_REQUEST_ID';
+    end if;
+
+    if p_campaign_id is null then
+        raise exception 'INVALID_CAMPAIGN_ID';
+    end if;
+
+    -- Replay check before locking
+    select * into v_existing_receipt
+    from public.campaign_push_receipts
+    where user_id = v_uid and client_request_id = p_client_request_id;
+
+    if v_existing_receipt.id is not null then
+        if coalesce(v_existing_receipt.target_campaign_id, v_existing_receipt.campaign_id) is distinct from p_campaign_id then
+            raise exception 'REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT: Yêu cầu bị trùng lặp với campaign khác';
+        end if;
+        if p_expected_cost is not null and v_existing_receipt.cost_credits <> p_expected_cost then
+            raise exception 'REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT: Yêu cầu bị trùng lặp với giá khác';
+        end if;
+        return jsonb_build_object(
+            'success', true,
+            'receipt_id', v_existing_receipt.id,
+            'client_request_id', v_existing_receipt.client_request_id,
+            'campaign_id', p_campaign_id,
+            'charged_credits', v_existing_receipt.cost_credits,
+            'balance_after', v_existing_receipt.balance_after,
+            'business_date', to_char(v_existing_receipt.business_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
+            'expires_at', to_char(v_existing_receipt.expires_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"'),
+            'push_order', v_existing_receipt.push_order,
+            'replayed', true
+        );
+    end if;
+
+    -- Consistent lock ordering: campaigns, then profiles
+    select * into v_camp
+    from public.campaigns
+    where id = p_campaign_id
+    for update;
+
+    if v_camp.id is null then
+        raise exception 'CAMPAIGN_NOT_FOUND';
+    end if;
+
+    select * into v_profile
+    from public.profiles
+    where id = v_uid
+    for update;
+
+    if v_profile.id is null then
+        raise exception 'PROFILE_NOT_FOUND';
+    end if;
+
+    -- Re-check receipt under lock
+    select * into v_existing_receipt
+    from public.campaign_push_receipts
+    where user_id = v_uid and client_request_id = p_client_request_id;
+
+    if v_existing_receipt.id is not null then
+        if coalesce(v_existing_receipt.target_campaign_id, v_existing_receipt.campaign_id) is distinct from p_campaign_id then
+            raise exception 'REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT: Yêu cầu bị trùng lặp với campaign khác';
+        end if;
+        if p_expected_cost is not null and v_existing_receipt.cost_credits <> p_expected_cost then
+            raise exception 'REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT: Yêu cầu bị trùng lặp với giá khác';
+        end if;
+        return jsonb_build_object(
+            'success', true,
+            'receipt_id', v_existing_receipt.id,
+            'client_request_id', v_existing_receipt.client_request_id,
+            'campaign_id', p_campaign_id,
+            'charged_credits', v_existing_receipt.cost_credits,
+            'balance_after', v_existing_receipt.balance_after,
+            'business_date', to_char(v_existing_receipt.business_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
+            'expires_at', to_char(v_existing_receipt.expires_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"'),
+            'push_order', v_existing_receipt.push_order,
+            'replayed', true
+        );
+    end if;
+
+    if v_camp.owner_id is distinct from v_uid then
+        raise exception 'NOT_OWNER';
+    end if;
+
+    if coalesce(v_profile.is_locked, false) = true then
+        raise exception 'ACCOUNT_LOCKED';
+    end if;
+
+    if v_camp.status <> 'open' then
+        raise exception 'CAMPAIGN_NOT_OPEN';
+    end if;
+
+    v_now := clock_timestamp();
+    v_business_date := (v_now at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date;
+    v_expires_at := (date_trunc('day', v_now at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh') + interval '1 day') at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh';
+
+    if v_camp.created_at <= v_now - interval '30 days' then
+        raise exception 'CAMPAIGN_WINDOW_EXPIRED';
+    end if;
+
+    if v_camp.slot_number > 1 then
+        if not exists (
+            select 1 from public.user_slots
+            where user_id = v_camp.owner_id
+              and slot_number = v_camp.slot_number
+              and expires_at > v_now
+        ) then
+            raise exception 'SLOT_EXPIRED';
+        end if;
+    end if;
+
+    v_policy := public._get_effective_business_policy_row(v_business_date);
+    v_cost := v_policy.push_fee;
+    v_current_rev := public._get_business_policy_revision();
+
+    if p_expected_cost is not null and p_expected_cost <> v_cost then
+        raise exception 'BUSINESS_POLICY_PRICE_MISMATCH: Phí đẩy ứng dụng đã thay đổi (hiện tại: %s Credit)', v_cost;
+    end if;
+
+    if p_expected_revision is not null and p_expected_revision <> v_current_rev then
+        raise exception 'BUSINESS_POLICY_CONFLICT: Chính sách hệ thống đã thay đổi';
+    end if;
+
+    if coalesce(v_profile.credits, 0) < v_cost then
+        raise exception 'INSUFFICIENT_CREDITS';
+    end if;
+
+    perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext('campaign_push_order_lock'));
+
+    v_push_order := nextval('public.campaign_push_order_seq');
+
+    update public.profiles
+    set credits = credits - v_cost
+    where id = v_uid
+    returning credits into v_balance_after;
+
+    v_note := format('Đẩy ứng dụng "%s" lên đầu danh sách (hạn đến hết %s)',
+                     coalesce(nullif(v_camp.app_name, ''), 'của bạn'),
+                     to_char(v_business_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY'));
+
+    insert into public.credit_logs (user_id, amount, action, note, balance)
+    values (v_uid, -v_cost, 'campaign_push', v_note, v_balance_after)
+    returning id into v_credit_log_id;
+
+    perform set_config('app.allow_push_metadata_write', 'true', true);
+
+    update public.campaigns
+    set push_business_date = v_business_date,
+        push_expires_at = v_expires_at,
+        push_order = v_push_order
+    where id = p_campaign_id;
+
+    perform set_config('app.allow_push_metadata_write', 'false', true);
+
+    insert into public.campaign_push_receipts (
+        user_id, campaign_id, target_campaign_id, client_request_id,
+        cost_credits, balance_after, business_date, pushed_at,
+        expires_at, push_order, credit_log_id
+    ) values (
+        v_uid, p_campaign_id, p_campaign_id, p_client_request_id,
+        v_cost, v_balance_after, v_business_date, v_now,
+        v_expires_at, v_push_order, v_credit_log_id
+    )
+    returning id into v_receipt_id;
+
+    return jsonb_build_object(
+        'success', true,
+        'receipt_id', v_receipt_id,
+        'client_request_id', p_client_request_id,
+        'campaign_id', p_campaign_id,
+        'charged_credits', v_cost,
+        'balance_after', v_balance_after,
+        'business_date', to_char(v_business_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
+        'expires_at', to_char(v_expires_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"'),
+        'push_order', v_push_order,
+        'replayed', false
+    );
+end;
+$$;
+
+-- 7.4 push_campaign (Legacy wrapper with fail-closed check)
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.push_campaign(p_campaign_id uuid, p_client_request_id uuid)
+RETURNS jsonb
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path TO 'public'
+AS $$
+declare
+    v_uid uuid := auth.uid();

+    v_policy public.business_policies;

+    if v_uid is null then
+        raise exception 'NOT_AUTHENTICATED';

+
+    if p_client_request_id is null then
+        raise exception 'INVALID_REQUEST_ID';
+    end if;
+
+    -- Prior replay across policy change succeeds
+    select * into v_existing_receipt

+    if v_existing_receipt.id is not null then

+    end if;

+-- 7.5 unlock_or_renew_slot_v2 (Financial slot operation with CAS & RequestID replay)
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.unlock_or_renew_slot_v2(
+    p_slot_number integer,
+    p_client_request_id uuid,
+    p_expected_cost integer DEFAULT NULL::integer,
+    p_expected_revision text DEFAULT NULL::text
+)
+RETURNS jsonb
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path TO 'public'
+AS $$
+declare
+    v_user_id uuid := auth.uid();
+    v_cost int;
+    v_balance int;
+    v_locked boolean;
+    v_current_expires timestamptz;
+    v_prev_expires timestamptz;
+    v_new_expires timestamptz;
+    v_policy public.business_policies;
+    v_renewal_days int;
+    v_existing_receipt record;
+    v_receipt_id uuid;
+    v_current_rev text;
+begin
+    if v_user_id is null then
+        raise exception 'NOT_AUTHENTICATED';
+    end if;
+
+    if p_client_request_id is null then
+        raise exception 'INVALID_REQUEST_ID';
+    end if;
+
+    if p_slot_number < 2 or p_slot_number > 6 then
+        raise exception 'INVALID_SLOT_NUMBER';
+    end if;
+
+    -- Replay check before CAS
+    select * into v_existing_receipt
+    from public.slot_purchase_receipts
+    where user_id = v_user_id and client_request_id = p_client_request_id;
+
+    if v_existing_receipt.id is not null then
+        if v_existing_receipt.slot_number <> p_slot_number then
+            raise exception 'REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT: Yêu cầu bị trùng với slot khác';
+        end if;
+        if p_expected_cost is not null and v_existing_receipt.cost_credits <> p_expected_cost then
+            raise exception 'REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT: Yêu cầu bị trùng với giá khác';
+        end if;
+        return jsonb_build_object(
+            'success', true,
+            'slot_number', v_existing_receipt.slot_number,
+            'cost', v_existing_receipt.cost_credits,
+            'balance', v_existing_receipt.balance_after,
+            'expires_at', to_char(v_existing_receipt.expires_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"'),
+            'replayed', true,
+            'receipt_id', v_existing_receipt.id
+        );
+    end if;
+
+    -- Lock profile
+    select credits, coalesce(is_locked, false)
+    into v_balance, v_locked
+    from public.profiles
+    where id = v_user_id
+    for update;
+
+    if v_locked = true then
+        raise exception 'ACCOUNT_LOCKED: Tài khoản của bạn đã bị khóa';
+    end if;
+
+    -- Re-check receipt after lock
+    select * into v_existing_receipt
+    from public.slot_purchase_receipts
+    where user_id = v_user_id and client_request_id = p_client_request_id;
+
+    if v_existing_receipt.id is not null then
+        if v_existing_receipt.slot_number <> p_slot_number then
+            raise exception 'REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT: Yêu cầu bị trùng với slot khác';
+        end if;
+        if p_expected_cost is not null and v_existing_receipt.cost_credits <> p_expected_cost then
+            raise exception 'REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT: Yêu cầu bị trùng với giá khác';
+        end if;
+        return jsonb_build_object(
+            'success', true,
+            'slot_number', v_existing_receipt.slot_number,
+            'cost', v_existing_receipt.cost_credits,
+            'balance', v_existing_receipt.balance_after,
+            'expires_at', to_char(v_existing_receipt.expires_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"'),
+            'replayed', true,
+            'receipt_id', v_existing_receipt.id
+        );
+    end if;
+
+    v_policy := public._get_effective_business_policy_row();
+    v_cost := case
+        when p_slot_number = 2 then v_policy.slot_fee_2
+        when p_slot_number = 3 then v_policy.slot_fee_3
+        else v_policy.slot_fee_4_plus
+    end;
+    v_renewal_days := v_policy.slot_renewal_days;
+    v_current_rev := public._get_business_policy_revision();
+
+    if p_expected_cost is not null and p_expected_cost <> v_cost then
+        raise exception 'BUSINESS_POLICY_PRICE_MISMATCH: Phí slot đã thay đổi (hiện tại: %s Credit)', v_cost;
+    end if;
+
+    if p_expected_revision is not null and p_expected_revision <> v_current_rev then
+        raise exception 'BUSINESS_POLICY_CONFLICT: Chính sách hệ thống đã thay đổi';
+    end if;
+
+    if v_balance is null or v_balance < v_cost then
+        raise exception 'INSUFFICIENT_CREDITS';
+    end if;
+
+    -- Slot N (N > 2) chỉ mở được khi Slot N - 1 đang còn hoạt động
+    if p_slot_number > 2 then
+        select expires_at into v_prev_expires
+        from public.user_slots
+        where user_id = v_user_id and slot_number = p_slot_number - 1
+        for update;
+
+        if v_prev_expires is null or v_prev_expires <= now() then
+            raise exception 'PREVIOUS_SLOT_NOT_ACTIVE';
+        end if;
+    end if;
+
+    -- Lock current slot if exists
+    select expires_at into v_current_expires
+    from public.user_slots
+    where user_id = v_user_id and slot_number = p_slot_number
+    for update;
+
+    if v_current_expires is not null and v_current_expires > now() then
+        v_new_expires := v_current_expires + (v_renewal_days || ' days')::interval;
+    else
+        v_new_expires := now() + (v_renewal_days || ' days')::interval;
+    end if;
+
+    insert into public.user_slots (user_id, slot_number, unlocked_at, expires_at)
+    values (v_user_id, p_slot_number, now(), v_new_expires)
+    on conflict (user_id, slot_number)
+    do update set
+        unlocked_at = now(),
+        expires_at = v_new_expires;
+
+    update public.profiles
+    set credits = credits - v_cost
+    where id = v_user_id
+    returning credits into v_balance;
+
+    insert into public.credit_logs (user_id, amount, action, note, balance)
+    values (
+        v_user_id,
+        -v_cost,
+        'unlock_slot',
+        format('Mở khóa / Gia hạn Slot %s (thời hạn %s ngày)', p_slot_number, v_renewal_days),
+        v_balance
+    );
+
+    insert into public.slot_purchase_receipts (
+        user_id, client_request_id, slot_number, cost_credits, balance_after, expires_at, created_at
+    ) values (
+        v_user_id, p_client_request_id, p_slot_number, v_cost, v_balance, v_new_expires, clock_timestamp()
+    ) returning id into v_receipt_id;
+
+    return jsonb_build_object(
+        'success', true,
+        'slot_number', p_slot_number,
+        'cost', v_cost,
+        'balance', v_balance,
+        'expires_at', to_char(v_new_expires at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"'),
+        'renewal_days', v_renewal_days,
+        'receipt_id', v_receipt_id,
+        'replayed', false
+    );
+end;
+$$;
+
+-- 7.6 unlock_or_renew_slot (Legacy wrapper with fail-closed check)
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.unlock_or_renew_slot(p_slot_number integer)
+RETURNS jsonb
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path TO 'public'
+AS $$
+declare
+    v_policy public.business_policies;
+    v_default_cost integer;
+    v_cost integer;
+begin
+    if p_slot_number < 2 or p_slot_number > 6 then
+        raise exception 'INVALID_SLOT_NUMBER';
+    end if;
+
+    v_default_cost := case when p_slot_number = 2 then 50 when p_slot_number = 3 then 100 else 200 end;
+    v_policy := public._get_effective_business_policy_row();
+    v_cost := case
+        when p_slot_number = 2 then v_policy.slot_fee_2
+        when p_slot_number = 3 then v_policy.slot_fee_3
+        else v_policy.slot_fee_4_plus
+    end;
+
+    if v_cost <> v_default_cost or v_policy.slot_renewal_days <> 30 then
+        raise exception 'CLIENT_UPDATE_REQUIRED: Phí hoặc thời hạn slot đã thay đổi. Vui lòng cập nhật ứng dụng.';
+    end if;
+
+    return public.unlock_or_renew_slot_v2(p_slot_number, gen_random_uuid(), v_default_cost, null);
+end;
+$$;
+

+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.handle_new_user() FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated, service_role;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.handle_new_user() TO PUBLIC, anon, authenticated, service_role;

// 8. Admin RequestID Replay, Mismatch, Finite Bounds & Bounded List
await runStep('8. Admin RequestID replay, mismatch detection, finite bounds & cursor list', async () => {
  const reqId1 = '88888888-8888-8888-8888-888888888881';
  const reqId2 = '88888888-8888-8888-8888-888888888882';
  const curCfg = (await asActor(adminId, 'select public.admin_get_business_policy_config() as cfg;')).rows[0].cfg;
  const d3 = (await db.query("select to_char((clock_timestamp() at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date + 15, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as d;")).rows[0].d;

  // 8.1 Schedule with request_id
  const sched1 = (await asActor(
    adminId,
    `select public.admin_schedule_business_policy('${d3}', 'Note 8', '${curCfg.revision}', 100, 1, 2, 5, 10, 100, 50, 100, 200, 30, 10, 2, 2, 6, 20, '${reqId1}') as cfg;`
  )).rows[0].cfg;
  assert.ok(sched1.revision);

  // 8.2 Replay same request_id with same payload returns cached result (even with old revision!)
  const replaySched = (await asActor(
    adminId,
    `select public.admin_schedule_business_policy('${d3}', 'Note 8', 'stale_or_wrong_rev', 100, 1, 2, 5, 10, 100, 50, 100, 200, 30, 10, 2, 2, 6, 20, '${reqId1}') as cfg;`
  )).rows[0].cfg;
  assert.equal(replaySched.revision, sched1.revision, 'Replay must return exact same config');

  // 8.3 Mismatched payload with same request_id throws REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT
  await assert.rejects(
    asActor(
      adminId,
      `select public.admin_schedule_business_policy('${d3}', 'DIFFERENT NOTE', 'any_rev', 100, 1, 2, 5, 10, 100, 50, 100, 200, 30, 10, 2, 2, 6, 20, '${reqId1}');`
    ),
    /REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT/
  );

  // 8.4 Finite future bounds (> 3650 days) rejected
  await assert.rejects(
    asActor(
      adminId,
      `select public.admin_schedule_business_policy((clock_timestamp() at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date + 4000, 'Too far', '${sched1.revision}');`
    ),
    /BUSINESS_POLICY_FUTURE_DATE_REQUIRED/
  );

  // 8.5 Cancel with request_id and replay
  const cancel1 = (await asActor(
    adminId,
    `select public.admin_cancel_business_policy('${d3}', 'Cancel Note 8', '${sched1.revision}', '${reqId2}') as cfg;`
  )).rows[0].cfg;

  // Replay cancel
  const replayCancel = (await asActor(
    adminId,
    `select public.admin_cancel_business_policy('${d3}', 'Cancel Note 8', 'wrong_rev', '${reqId2}') as cfg;`
  )).rows[0].cfg;
  assert.equal(replayCancel.revision, cancel1.revision);

  // Mismatched cancel payload
  await assert.rejects(
    asActor(
      adminId,
      `select public.admin_cancel_business_policy('${d3}', 'DIFFERENT CANCEL NOTE', 'any', '${reqId2}');`
    ),
    /REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT/
  );

  // 8.6 Bounded list with cursor
  const listP1 = (await asActor(adminId, 'select public.admin_list_business_policies(1) as lst;')).rows[0].lst;
  assert.ok(listP1.future_policies.length <= 1, 'Bounded to limit 1');
});

+// 9. Consumer: Welcome Credits
+await runStep('9. Consumer: handle_new_user with policy credits, ledger consistency & 0 credits', async () => {

+  // 9.1 Default welcome credits (100)
+  await db.exec(`insert into auth.users (id, email) values ('${newU1}', 'new1@test.local');`);

+  assert.equal(prof1.credits, 100, 'New user receives 100 credits');
+
+  const log1 = (await db.query(`select amount, note, balance from public.credit_logs where user_id = '${newU1}' and action = 'welcome';`)).rows[0];
+  assert.equal(log1.amount, 100);
+  assert.equal(log1.balance, 100);
+  assert.equal(log1.note, 'Thưởng 100 Credit khi mở tài khoản');
+
+  // 9.2 Existing user untouched on duplicate trigger fire
+  await db.exec(`update public.profiles set credits = 555 where id = '${newU1}';`);
+  await db.exec(`
+    set local role authenticated;
+    select public.handle_new_user() from (select '${newU1}'::uuid as id, 'new1@test.local' as email, '{}'::jsonb as raw_user_meta_data) new;
+  `);

+  await db.exec(`insert into auth.users (id, email) values ('${newU2}', 'new2@test.local');`);

+  const pushReq2 = '99999999-9999-9999-9999-999999999992';

+  await db.exec(`
+    insert into public.campaigns (id, owner_id, app_name, package_name, status, target_testers, slot_number, created_at)

+      ('${campOther}', '${memberId}', 'Test App 2', 'com.test.app2', 'open', 10, 1, now() - interval '2 days')
+    on conflict (id) do nothing;
+    update public.profiles set credits = 1000 where id = '${memberId}';
+  `);

+  // 10.1 Legacy push with default fee (100)

+  assert.equal(pushRes1.replayed, false);

+  const bal1 = (await db.query(`select credits from public.profiles where id = '${memberId}';`)).rows[0].credits;
+  assert.equal(bal1, 900);
+
+  // 10.2 Replay same push_campaign returns cached receipt
+  const pushReplay = (await asActor(memberId, `select public.push_campaign('${campId}', '${pushReq1}') as res;`)).rows[0].res;
+  assert.equal(pushReplay.success, true);
+  assert.equal(pushReplay.replayed, true);
+  assert.equal(pushReplay.charged_credits, 100);

+  assert.equal(pushV2Res.balance_after, 750);

221: ### 4.2 Mở khóa / Gia hạn Slot (`unlock_or_renew_slot` vs `unlock_or_renew_slot_v2`)
222: - **`unlock_or_renew_slot(p_slot_number integer)` (Legacy):**
223:   - Nếu phí slot hiện hành khớp với mặc định (Slot 2=50, Slot 3=100, Slot 4..6=200, thời hạn 30 ngày): Thực thi bình thường.
224:   - Nếu phí hoặc thời hạn đã thay đổi so với mặc định: Ném lỗi `CLIENT_UPDATE_REQUIRED: Phí hoặc thời hạn slot đã thay đổi. Vui lòng cập nhật ứng dụng.`
225: - **`unlock_or_renew_slot_v2(p_slot_number integer, p_client_request_id uuid, p_expected_cost integer DEFAULT NULL, p_expected_revision text DEFAULT NULL)`:**
226:   - Bắt buộc `p_client_request_id`.
227:   - Lưu và tra cứu biên lai qua bảng `slot_purchase_receipts` (idempotency ledger cho slot).
228:   - Replay idempotent: Nếu đã xử lý, trả lại kết quả cũ kèm `replayed: true`. Nếu khác `p_slot_number`, ném `REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT`.
229:   - Kiểm tra khớp giá `p_expected_cost` và khớp `p_expected_revision`.
230:   - Gia hạn theo `v_policy.slot_renewal_days`.
231: 
232: ### 4.3 Đăng ký phiên bản mới (`publish_app_update` vs `publish_app_update_v2`)
233: - **`publish_app_update(p_campaign_id uuid, p_version_name text, p_target_version_code bigint, p_release_notes text, p_client_operation_id text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_expected_current_release_id uuid DEFAULT 'ffffffff-ffff-ffff-ffff-ffffffffffff'::uuid)` (Legacy):**
234:   - Nếu ngân sách giữ trước bằng 120 (mặc định 6 * 20): Giữ nguyên tương thích cũ.
235:   - Nếu chính sách thay đổi ngân sách khác 120: Ném lỗi `CLIENT_UPDATE_REQUIRED: Chính sách ngân sách cập nhật ứng dụng đã thay đổi (%s Credit). Vui lòng cập nhật ứng dụng để xác nhận.`.
236: - **`publish_app_update_v2(p_campaign_id uuid, p_version_name text, p_target_version_code bigint, p_release_notes text, p_client_operation_id text, p_expected_budget integer DEFAULT NULL, p_expected_revision text DEFAULT NULL, p_expected_current_release_id uuid DEFAULT 'ffffffff-ffff-ffff-ffff-ffffffffffff'::uuid)`:**
237:   - Bắt buộc kiểm tra `p_expected_budget` khớp với `reward_per_claim * max_claims` khi được truyền.
238:   - Kiểm tra `p_expected_revision` khớp với revision CAS của chính sách khi được truyền.
239:   - Tạo đợt release với snapshot `reward_per_claim`, `max_claims`, `reserved_credits`.
240:   - Các đợt release cũ đang active vẫn bảo lưu nguyên vẹn giá trị đã snapshot khi tạo (không bị đổi số dư hoặc số tiền hoàn lại).

244: ## 5. Quy tắc các nhánh tiêu thụ khác (Consumers)
245: 
246: 1. **Khởi tạo tài khoản (`handle_new_user`):**
247:    - Đọc `welcome_credits` từ chính sách có hiệu lực tại ngày tạo tài khoản.
248:    - Thưởng credit và ghi ledger note với đúng số credit được cấp: `Thưởng %s Credit khi mở tài khoản`.

## 1. Các thành phần đã hoàn tất trong lượt C2

### 1.1 Khắc phục lỗ hổng Tầng Nền tảng (Foundation Gaps)
1. **Sổ cái Idempotency Request ID cho Quản trị viên (`business_policy_admin_requests`):**
   - Đã thêm bảng `business_policy_admin_requests` với khóa chính `(actor_id, operation, id)` và kiểm tra payload hash canonical MD5.
   - Thao tác `admin_schedule_business_policy` và `admin_cancel_business_policy` nhận thêm tham số tùy chọn `p_request_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid`.
   - **Xác thực trước -> Replay trước CAS:** Khi client gửi lại `p_request_id` đã từng thành công (ví dụ retry sau khi mất mạng), backend trả lại kết quả cũ ngay lập tức mà không bị từ chối bởi kiểm tra CAS revision. Nếu payload hash khác nhau, ném lỗi `REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT`.
2. **Giới hạn thời gian tương lai hữu hạn (Finite Day Bounds):**
   - Chặn lập lịch chính sách quá xa trong tương lai (`p_effective_from > current_date_vn + 3650 days`), tránh tràn số hoặc rác dữ liệu.
3. **Phân trang danh sách lịch tương lai (Bounded Future List with Cursor):**
   - `admin_get_business_policy_config(p_future_limit integer DEFAULT 20)`: Giới hạn số lượng future policies trả về ở trang đầu, cung cấp `future_has_more` và `future_next_cursor`.
   - `admin_list_business_policies(p_limit integer DEFAULT 20, p_cursor_date date DEFAULT NULL::date)`: Hỗ trợ nạp các trang tiếp theo theo con trỏ ngày.
4. **Tích hợp Audit chung với Migration 070:**
   - Trong `admin_schedule_business_policy` và `admin_cancel_business_policy`, tự động kiểm tra sự tồn tại của hàm `public.record_admin_action_event(...)` từ Migration 070. Nếu có, ghi thêm sự kiện vào `admin_action_events` với `request_id`, bảo toàn nguyên vẹn bảng audit riêng `business_policy_changes`. Không nuốt lỗi audit trong toàn chuỗi.

---

### 1.2 Triển khai các Consumer Nghiệp vụ thực tế (Active Consumers)

1. **Welcome Credits Consumer (`handle_new_user`):**
   - Tự động đọc `v_policy.welcome_credits` từ chính sách có hiệu lực tại ngày tạo tài khoản theo giờ Việt Nam.
   - Khi tài khoản mới được tạo, cấp đúng số credit từ chính sách (hỗ trợ cả trường hợp chính sách đặt `welcome_credits = 0`).
   - Ghi log `credit_logs` với `action = 'welcome'`, số tiền và ghi chú hoàn toàn đồng nhất: `format('Thưởng %s Credit khi mở tài khoản', v_welcome_credits)`.
   - Người dùng đã tồn tại (`ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING`) được bảo toàn tuyệt đối, không bị ghi đè số dư hoặc ghi thêm log thừa.

2. **Push Campaign Consumer (`push_campaign` & `push_campaign_v2`):**
   - **Nới lỏng ràng buộc biên lai:** Thay thế `campaign_push_receipts_cost_credits_check` từ cứng `cost_credits = 100` thành `CHECK (cost_credits >= 1 AND cost_credits <= 10000)`.
   - **Tương thích ngược an toàn (Fail-closed):** Khi chính sách đang kích hoạt có `push_fee = 100`, hàm legacy `push_campaign(p_campaign_id, p_client_request_id)` tiếp tục hoạt động bình thường. Khi chính sách đổi sang phí khác 100, hàm legacy từ chối với lỗi rõ ràng: `CLIENT_UPDATE_REQUIRED: Phí đẩy ứng dụng đã thay đổi (%s Credit). Vui lòng cập nhật ứng dụng.`.
   - **Replay qua thời điểm đổi chính sách:** Nếu một request ID đã từng thanh toán trước khi đổi chính sách, việc replay lại `push_campaign` hoặc `push_campaign_v2` vẫn trả về đúng receipt cũ với đúng số tiền đã trừ lịch sử, không bị chặn bởi kiểm tra giá mới.
   - **RPC V2 (`push_campaign_v2`):**
     - Bắt buộc `p_client_request_id`.
     - Nhận `p_expected_cost` và `p_expected_revision` để bảo đảm client không bao giờ bị trừ tiền sai so với báo giá hiển thị.
     - Kiểm tra xung đột request ID: nếu dùng lại `p_client_request_id` cho campaign khác hoặc giá khác, ném lỗi `REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT`.

enum class NotificationAdminTab {
    HISTORY, COMPOSER, MONITOR
}

sealed interface NotificationActionDialog {
    data class Schedule(
        val campaign: AdminNotificationCampaign,
        val scheduledDate: String = "",
        val scheduledTime: String = "",
        val reason: String = "",
    ) : NotificationActionDialog

    data class SendNow(
        val campaign: AdminNotificationCampaign,
        val reason: String = "",
    ) : NotificationActionDialog

    data class Cancel(
        val campaign: AdminNotificationCampaign,
        val reason: String = "",
    ) : NotificationActionDialog

    data object ProcessDue : NotificationActionDialog
}

data class AdminNotificationCampaignUiState(
    val currentAdminId: String? = null,
    val activeTab: NotificationAdminTab = NotificationAdminTab.HISTORY,
    val error: String? = null,
    val infoMessage: String? = null,
    val isActionInProgress: Boolean = false,

    // Tab 1: History List
    val campaigns: List<AdminNotificationCampaign> = emptyList(),
    val isHistoryLoading: Boolean = false,
    val isHistoryLoadingMore: Boolean = false,
    val historyHasMore: Boolean = false,

    val filterStatus: String? = null,
    val filterAudience: String? = null,

    // Tab 2: Composer / Draft Editor
    val editingCampaignId: String? = null,
    val editingRevision: Int = 1,
    val draftTitleVi: String = "",
    val draftTitleEn: String = "",
    val draftBodyVi: String = "",
    val draftBodyEn: String = "",
    val draftLocale: String = "vi",
    val draftAudienceType: String = "all",
    val draftTargetRole: String = "member",
    val selectedUsers: List<AdminMemberItem> = emptyList(),
    val draftReason: String = "",
    val isDraftSaving: Boolean = false,
    val draftMutationRequestId: String = "",

    // User Search for Selected Users
    val userSearchQuery: String = "",
    val userSearchResults: List<AdminMemberItem> = emptyList(),
    val isUserSearching: Boolean = false,
    val isUserSearchLoadingMore: Boolean = false,
    val userSearchHasMore: Boolean = false,
    val userSearchNextCreatedAt: String? = null,
    val userSearchNextId: String? = null,

    // Live Preview
    val previewRecipientCount: Int = 0,
    val previewViTitle: String = "",
    val previewViBody: String = "",
    val previewEnTitle: String = "",
    val previewEnBody: String = "",
    val previewEffectiveTitle: String = "",
    val previewEffectiveBody: String = "",
    val isPreviewLoading: Boolean = false,

    // Campaign Details
    val selectedDetailCampaign: AdminNotificationCampaignDetailResponse? = null,

    val isDetailRecipientsLoadingMore: Boolean = false,
    val detailRecipientsHasMore: Boolean = false,

    val detailRecipientsFilterStatus: String? = null,

    val activeDialog: NotificationActionDialog? = null,

open class AdminNotificationCampaignViewModel(
    private val repository: AdminNotificationCampaignRepository,
    private val authRepository: AuthRepository,
) : ViewModel() {

    private val _uiState = MutableStateFlow(
        AdminNotificationCampaignUiState(
            draftMutationRequestId = UUID.randomUUID().toString()
        )
    )
    val uiState: StateFlow<AdminNotificationCampaignUiState> = _uiState.asStateFlow()

    private val historyGen = AtomicLong(0)
    private val userSearchGen = AtomicLong(0)
    private val recipientGen = AtomicLong(0)
    private val actionGen = AtomicLong(0)

    private var previewJob: Job? = null
    private var searchJob: Job? = null

    init {
        val uid = authRepository.currentUserId
        _uiState.update { it.copy(currentAdminId = uid) }
        loadHistory()
        loadSchedulerHealth()
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- Navigation & Tabs
    fun selectTab(tab: NotificationAdminTab) {
        _uiState.update { it.copy(activeTab = tab, error = null, infoMessage = null) }
        when (tab) {
            NotificationAdminTab.HISTORY -> loadHistory()
            NotificationAdminTab.COMPOSER -> triggerPreview()
            NotificationAdminTab.MONITOR -> loadSchedulerHealth()
        }
    }

    fun dismissMessage() {
        _uiState.update { it.copy(error = null, infoMessage = null) }
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- History Stream
    fun setHistoryFilters(status: String?, audience: String?) {
        _uiState.update {
            it.copy(
                filterStatus = status,
                filterAudience = audience,
                historyNextCursor = null,
                historyHasMore = false,
            )
        }
        loadHistory()
    }

    fun loadHistory() {
        val gen = historyGen.incrementAndGet()
        val status = _uiState.value.filterStatus
        val audience = _uiState.value.filterAudience

        _uiState.update { it.copy(isHistoryLoading = true, error = null) }
        viewModelScope.launch {
            try {
                val envelope = repository.listCampaigns(
                    status = status,
                    audienceType = audience,
                    limit = 20,
                    cursor = null,
                )
                if (gen != historyGen.get()) return@launch

                _uiState.update {
                    it.copy(
                        campaigns = envelope.items,
                        historyHasMore = envelope.hasMore,
                        historyNextCursor = envelope.nextCursor,
                        isHistoryLoading = false,
                    )
                }
            } catch (ce: CancellationException) {
                throw ce
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                if (gen != historyGen.get()) return@launch
                _uiState.update {
                    it.copy(
                        isHistoryLoading = false,
                        error = e.message ?: "Failed to load notification campaigns history",
                    )
                }
            }
        }
    }

    fun loadMoreHistory() {
        val state = _uiState.value
        if (state.isHistoryLoading || state.isHistoryLoadingMore || !state.historyHasMore) return
        val cursor = state.historyNextCursor ?: return

        val gen = historyGen.get()
        val status = state.filterStatus
        val audience = state.filterAudience

        _uiState.update { it.copy(isHistoryLoadingMore = true) }
        viewModelScope.launch {
            try {
                val envelope = repository.listCampaigns(
                    status = status,
                    audienceType = audience,
                    limit = 20,
                    cursor = cursor,
                )
                if (gen != historyGen.get()) return@launch

                _uiState.update {
                    it.copy(
                        campaigns = it.campaigns + envelope.items,
                        historyHasMore = envelope.hasMore,
                        historyNextCursor = envelope.nextCursor,
                        isHistoryLoadingMore = false,
                    )
                }
            } catch (ce: CancellationException) {
                throw ce
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                if (gen != historyGen.get()) return@launch
                _uiState.update {
                    it.copy(
                        isHistoryLoadingMore = false,
                        error = e.message ?: "Failed to load more campaigns",
                    )
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- Composer & Form Editing
    fun onTitleViChange(v: String) {
        _uiState.update { it.copy(draftTitleVi = v) }
        invalidateDraftIdempotency()
        triggerPreviewDebounced()
    }

    fun onTitleEnChange(v: String) {
        _uiState.update { it.copy(draftTitleEn = v) }
        invalidateDraftIdempotency()
        triggerPreviewDebounced()
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- Live Preview
    private fun triggerPreviewDebounced() {
        previewJob?.cancel()
        previewJob = viewModelScope.launch {
            delay(400)
            triggerPreview()
        }
    }

    fun triggerPreview() {
        val state = _uiState.value
        val audience = state.draftAudienceType
        val role = if (audience == "role") state.draftTargetRole else null
        val selectedIds = if (audience == "selected_users") state.selectedUsers.map { it.id } else null

        _uiState.update { it.copy(isPreviewLoading = true) }
        viewModelScope.launch {
            try {
                val preview = repository.previewCampaign(
                    campaignId = state.editingCampaignId,
                    audienceType = audience,
                    targetRole = role,
                    selectedUserIds = selectedIds,
                    defaultLocale = state.draftLocale,
                    titleVi = state.draftTitleVi,
                    titleEn = state.draftTitleEn,
                    bodyVi = state.draftBodyVi,
                    bodyEn = state.draftBodyEn,
                )

                _uiState.update {
                    it.copy(
                        previewRecipientCount = preview.recipientCount,
                        previewViTitle = preview.previewVi?.title.orEmpty(),
                        previewViBody = preview.previewVi?.body.orEmpty(),
                        previewEnTitle = preview.previewEn?.title.orEmpty(),
                        previewEnBody = preview.previewEn?.body.orEmpty(),
                        previewEffectiveTitle = preview.previewEffective?.title.orEmpty(),
                        previewEffectiveBody = preview.previewEffective?.body.orEmpty(),
                        isPreviewLoading = false,
                    )
                }
            } catch (ce: CancellationException) {
                throw ce
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                _uiState.update { it.copy(isPreviewLoading = false) }
            }
        }
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- Draft Mutations
    fun saveDraft() {
        val state = _uiState.value
        if (state.isActionInProgress || state.isDraftSaving) return

        if (state.draftTitleVi.isBlank() || state.draftTitleEn.isBlank()) {
            _uiState.update { it.copy(error = "Title (VI and EN) cannot be empty") }
            return
        }
        if (state.draftBodyVi.isBlank() || state.draftBodyEn.isBlank()) {
            _uiState.update { it.copy(error = "Message Body (VI and EN) cannot be empty") }
            return
        }
        if (state.draftAudienceType == "selected_users" && state.selectedUsers.isEmpty()) {
            _uiState.update { it.copy(error = "Selected users audience requires at least one user") }
            return
        }

        val token = actionGen.incrementAndGet()
        val requestId = state.draftMutationRequestId.ifBlank { UUID.randomUUID().toString() }
        val isEditing = state.editingCampaignId != null

        _uiState.update { it.copy(isActionInProgress = true, isDraftSaving = true, error = null) }

        viewModelScope.launch {
            try {
                val resp = if (isEditing) {
                    repository.updateCampaign(
                        requestId = requestId,
                        campaignId = state.editingCampaignId!!,
                        expectedRevision = state.editingRevision,
                        titleVi = state.draftTitleVi,
                        titleEn = state.draftTitleEn,
                        bodyVi = state.draftBodyVi,
                        bodyEn = state.draftBodyEn,
                        defaultLocale = state.draftLocale,
                        audienceType = state.draftAudienceType,
                        targetRole = if (state.draftAudienceType == "role") state.draftTargetRole else null,
                        selectedUserIds = if (state.draftAudienceType == "selected_users") state.selectedUsers.map { it.id } else null,
                        reason = state.draftReason.ifBlank { null },
                    )
                } else {
                    repository.createCampaign(
                        requestId = requestId,
                        titleVi = state.draftTitleVi,
                        titleEn = state.draftTitleEn,
                        bodyVi = state.draftBodyVi,
                        bodyEn = state.draftBodyEn,
                        defaultLocale = state.draftLocale,
                        audienceType = state.draftAudienceType,
                        targetRole = if (state.draftAudienceType == "role") state.draftTargetRole else null,
                        selectedUserIds = if (state.draftAudienceType == "selected_users") state.selectedUsers.map { it.id } else null,
                        reason = state.draftReason.ifBlank { null },
                    )
                }

                if (token != actionGen.get()) return@launch

                _uiState.update {
                    it.copy(
                        isActionInProgress = false,
                        isDraftSaving = false,
                        editingCampaignId = resp.campaign.id,
                        editingRevision = resp.campaign.revision,
                        draftMutationRequestId = UUID.randomUUID().toString(),
                        infoMessage = if (resp.replayed) "Draft saved (replayed from previous request)" else "Draft saved successfully",
                    )
                }
                loadHistory()
            } catch (ce: CancellationException) {
                throw ce
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                if (token != actionGen.get()) return@launch
                val errMsg = e.message ?: "Failed to save draft"
                val isCas = errMsg.contains("REVISION_CONFLICT", ignoreCase = true)
                _uiState.update {
                    it.copy(
                        isActionInProgress = false,
                        isDraftSaving = false,
                        error = if (isCas) {
                            "Campaign was modified by another administrator. Your current draft was preserved; please re-verify."
                        } else {
                            errMsg
                        },
                    )
                }
                if (isCas) loadHistory()
            }
        }
    }

    fun executeSchedule(campaign: AdminNotificationCampaign, scheduledForIso: String, reason: String?) {
        val state = _uiState.value
        if (state.isActionInProgress) return
        val token = actionGen.incrementAndGet()
        val reqId = UUID.randomUUID().toString()

        _uiState.update { it.copy(isActionInProgress = true, activeDialog = null, error = null) }

        viewModelScope.launch {
            try {
                val resp = repository.scheduleCampaign(
                    requestId = reqId,
                    campaignId = campaign.id,
                    expectedRevision = campaign.revision,
                    scheduledForIso = scheduledForIso,
                    reason = reason,
                )
                if (token != actionGen.get()) return@launch
                _uiState.update {
                    it.copy(
                        isActionInProgress = false,
                        infoMessage = "Campaign scheduled successfully for ${resp.campaign.scheduledFor}",
                    )
                }
                loadHistory()
                refreshDetailIfOpen(campaign.id)
            } catch (ce: CancellationException) {
                throw ce
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                if (token != actionGen.get()) return@launch
                _uiState.update {
                    it.copy(isActionInProgress = false, error = e.message ?: "Failed to schedule campaign")
                }
                loadHistory()
            }
        }
    }

                SELECT COUNT(*)

Considering these patterns, designing the UI state and view model requires aligning with these observed architectural components.


Initial state design involves distinct sections for global admin state, history tab, and composer/draft editor. Global state includes user context, session information, and general UI status flags. History tab state captures campaigns list, loading status, pagination, and filter parameters. Composer state focuses on draft content, audience selection, and user search features for targeting selected users.


History, composer, and monitor states are now defined with detailed properties to track data such as campaign lists, loading statuses, pagination details, and various UI parameters. User search functionality includes loading indicators, pagination flags, and cursors for continuous data retrieval. Added live preview state parameters capture recipient counts, titles, and body content for English and Vietnamese versions. Detail dialog or view properties are added to track loading status, selected campaign details, and recipient lists with pagination support, while scheduler health and processing status are also incorporated.


Observing the code reveals that draft mutation requests utilize UUIDs for idempotency and form field changes trigger new UUID generation to ensure unique requests. Retry mechanisms preserve the existing draft mutation request ID, while successful completion resets it. Conflict resolution triggers a fresh data fetch with a conflict message, preserving the draft. Action gating is managed with a mutex, ensuring only the latest action token proceeds, preventing duplicate submissions.

The code snippet instantiates a `AdminNotificationCampaignViewModel`. It uses a `LocalContext` to access the application context and casts it to `TestCheoApp`. This suggests the intention is to use the application context to initialize the view model. Further examination reveals that a `AdminNotificationCampaignRepository` is being constructed and passed into the `AdminNotificationCampaignViewModel`, along with an `authRepository`.


Initial design focuses on `AdminNotificationCampaignScreen.kt`, including top bar, tab row, and tab contents. The history tab requires filter chips for status and audience, along with a pull-to-refresh list of campaigns within a lazy column. Card UI elements will display campaign details and action buttons dependent on campaign status, including logic for draft, queued, sending, completed, cancelled, and failed states.


Focus is shifting to the second tab for composer content, specifically designing the UI elements for campaign creation/editing. Text fields are needed for various campaign details, supporting both Vietnamese and English locales. Logic for audience selection will include dropdowns and potential filter chips, accounting for different audience types like roles and selected users, with dynamic search and selection UI for individual users. The plan incorporates a live preview card to display the expected recipient count and preview the campaign content in different locales, with save/update and schedule actions at the bottom.


Scheduler tab UI includes a health card displaying `pg_cron` status, an automated scheduler readiness indicator, backlog metrics (pending, in-flight campaigns, last worker run time, and lifetime stats), and an action button to process due batches. The schedule dialog requests date, time (future validation), and reason, triggering `executeSchedule()`. Send Now and Cancel dialogs provide warnings, reason input, and confirmation, triggering `executeSendNow()` and `executeCancel()`, respectively.
